metadata.name: SmartProxy
metadata.description: A high-performance utility for managing proxy configurations, written in Go to ensure speed and reliability.

summary.zh: SmartProxy 是一款跨平台网络代理管理工具，基于 Go 语言实现高性能与高可靠性。它作为智能路由中间件，根据域名规则自动切换 Company VPN、Personal VPN/GFW 及直连三种网络通道，支持 Bootstrap Web 界面和系统托盘控制，适合开发者和商务人士管理多网络环境。
summary.en: SmartProxy is a cross-platform network proxy utility built in Go, serving as an intelligent router that automatically directs traffic based on domain rules across Company VPN, Personal VPN/GFW, and Direct connections. Features include a Bootstrap Web GUI, system tray integration, zero-conflict port allocation, and JSON-based configuration for seamless multi-network environment management.

metadata.name: StikDebug
metadata.description: An on-device debugger/JIT enabler for iOS versions 17.4+, powered by idevice.

summary.zh: StikDebug是一款专为iOS 17.4+设计的越狱级调试工具，集成JIT编译启用、应用启动、控制台日志、进程管理及GPS位置模拟等功能。基于idevice实现设备连接，支持侧载应用无需电脑即可启用JIT，为iOS开发者提供完整的设备端调试能力。
summary.en: StikDebug is a jailbreak-grade debugging tool for iOS 17.4+, featuring JIT compilation enabler, app launching, console logging, process management, and GPS location simulation. Built on idevice, it enables JIT for sideloaded apps without a computer, providing comprehensive on-device debugging for iOS developers.

metadata.name: iOS-JIT-Enablers
metadata.description: A list of JIT Enablers for iOS and iPadOS.

summary.zh: iOS-JIT-Enablers 是一个全面汇总 iOS/iPadOS 平台 JIT（即时编译）启用工具的开源项目。收录 SideStore、StikDebug、TrollStore 等十余款工具，覆盖 arm64（A7-A11）和 arm64e（A12+/M1+）芯片架构，支持 iOS 14 至 18.4 beta 系统版本。提供快捷指令和 dylib 加速 JIT 启用，是模拟器运行和应用侧载的重要资源库。
summary.en: iOS-JIT-Enablers is a comprehensive open-source collection of JIT (Just-In-Time compilation) enablers for iOS/iPadOS. It catalogs over a dozen tools including SideStore, StikDebug, and TrollStore, supporting arm64 (A7-A11) and arm64e (A12+/M1+) architectures across iOS 14 to 18.4 beta. With shortcuts and dylibs for faster JIT enabling, it's essential for emulator performance and alternative app installation.

metadata.name: agentmemory
metadata.description: #1 Persistent memory for AI coding agents based on real-world benchmarks

summary.zh: 为AI编码代理提供持久记忆的TypeScript库，基于真实世界基准测试构建。支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流编码工具，通过知识图谱和混合搜索实现95.2%的检索准确率，同时减少92%的token消耗。无需外部数据库，集成53个MCP工具和12个自动钩子。
summary.en: A TypeScript library providing persistent memory for AI coding agents, built on real-world benchmarks. Supports Claude Code, Cursor and other major coding tools, achieving 95.2% retrieval accuracy via knowledge graphs and hybrid search while reducing 92% token usage. Zero external DBs, 53 MCP tools, 12 auto hooks.

metadata.name: academic-research-skills
metadata.description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize

summary.zh: 基于Claude Code的学术研究技能套件，覆盖研究→写作→审稿→修订→定稿全流程。核心功能包括Socratic对话式论文规划、引用幻觉检测、三层引用锚点验证、风格校准及写作质量检查。强调人机协作理念，通过7模式完整性检查门防止AI自动化的常见失败模式。
summary.en: A comprehensive Claude Code plugin suite for academic research, covering research→write→review→revise→finalize pipeline. Key features include Socratic dialogue paper planning, citation hallucination detection, three-layer citation anchoring, style calibration, and writing quality checks. Emphasizes human-in-the-loop approach with 7-mode integrity gates to prevent common AI automation failure modes.

metadata.name: humanizer
metadata.description: Claude Code skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text

summary.zh: 一款面向Claude Code和OpenCode的AI写作去痕工具，基于Wikipedia AI写作检测指南构建，可识别并消除29种常见AI写作模式（如显著性膨胀、AI词汇滥用、连词回避等），将机械化的AI文本转化为自然流畅的人类写作风格。支持个人语音校准功能，通过分析用户写作节奏和用词偏好定制输出，并采用二次重写审计机制彻底清除残留的AI痕迹。
summary.en: A Claude Code and OpenCode skill that removes AI writing artifacts by detecting 29 common patterns like significance inflation, AI vocabulary, and copula avoidance. Based on Wikipedia's AI writing detection guide, it transforms mechanical AI text into natural human prose. Features voice calibration to match personal writing style and a second-pass audit to eliminate lingering AI-isms.

metadata.name: iStart
metadata.description: 一个为 macOS 26 打造的轻量级开始菜单与应用启动器。

summary.zh: iStart 是一款专为 macOS 26 设计的轻量级开始菜单与应用启动器，采用 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建原生浮动面板。支持全局快捷键唤起、拼音友好的应用搜索、固定常用应用到网格、自动记录最近打开应用，还支持自定义索引目录和开机启动，提供毛玻璃 UI 与纯键盘操作的极简体验。
summary.en: iStart is a lightweight start menu and app launcher for macOS 26, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It features global hotkey activation, pinyin-friendly app search, pinning favorites to a grid, and tracking recently opened apps. Supports custom index directories, login item, with native frosted glass UI and full keyboard navigation.

metadata.name: stop-slop
metadata.description: A skill file for removing AI tells from prose

summary.zh: 一个用于消除AI写作痕迹的技能文件。通过词组黑名单、结构模板、句式规则三个维度识别AI写作特征，提供直接性、节奏感、信任度、真实感、密度五维评分体系（35/50分为修订阈值）。可集成至Claude Code、Projects或API调用，适用于AI文本润色与人工化改写。
summary.en: A skill file for detecting and eliminating AI writing patterns from prose. Uses banned phrases, structural clichés, and sentence-level rules to identify AI tells. Features a 5-dimension scoring rubric (Directness, Rhythm, Trust, Authenticity, Density) with 35/50 threshold for revision. Integrates with Claude Code, Projects, or API calls for AI text polishing and humanization.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars 并利用 AI 生成仓库摘要和技术标签的自动化工具。支持并发处理、智能标签归一化、增量更新，通过 GitHub Actions 定时同步或手动触发。可生成 Markdown 和 HTML 静态页面，并可选同步至 Obsidian Vault 或 GitHub Pages，便于个人知识管理和项目检索。
summary.en: An automated tool that fetches GitHub Stars and generates AI-powered summaries with technical tags. Features concurrent processing, intelligent tag normalization, and incremental updates via GitHub Actions. Outputs Markdown and HTML pages, with optional sync to Obsidian Vault or GitHub Pages for personal knowledge management and project discovery.

metadata.name: memo
metadata.description: Memo is a simple command-line interface (CLI) tool for managing your Apple Notes and Apple Reminders. It’s written in Python and aims to offer a fast, keyboard-driven way to create, search, and organize notes and reminders straight from your terminal.

summary.zh: Memo 是一款面向 macOS 的 Python CLI 工具，用于从终端管理 Apple Notes 和 Apple Reminders。支持将笔记转换为 Markdown 格式浏览、模糊搜索、在文件夹间移动笔记、将提醒标记完成及导出为 HTML。完全键盘驱动，适合高效开发者工作流。
summary.en: Memo is a Python CLI tool for macOS that manages Apple Notes and Apple Reminders directly from the terminal. It offers Markdown rendering, fuzzy search, folder navigation, reminder completion, and HTML export. Fully keyboard-driven, ideal for power users seeking efficient workflows.

metadata.name: seedance2-skill
metadata.description: skill to create best prompts for generating videos with seedance2.0

summary.zh: Seedance 2.0 提示词编写技能库，为字节跳动即梦AI视频生成模型提供专业提示词模板。涵盖输入约束、@引用语法、镜头语言、提示结构模式，支持广告、剧情、MV、教育等内容创作场景，可与Claude Code、Cursor等AI智能体集成使用。
summary.en: A prompt engineering skill set for Seedance 2.0, ByteDance's AI video generation model. Provides structured templates covering input constraints, @ reference syntax, camera language, and prompt patterns for ads, dramas, MVs, and educational content. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agents.

metadata.name: PaperBanana
metadata.description: PaperBanana: Automating Academic Illustration For AI Scientists

summary.zh: PaperBanana是一个参考驱动的多智能体框架，自动化生成学术论文级图表。通过Retriever、Planner、Stylist、Visualizer和Critic五个专业智能体协作，将科学内容转化为高质量出版图表。框架利用上下文学习和迭代优化机制，支持多种VLM和图像生成模型，适用于AI科研论文插图自动化制作。
summary.en: PaperBanana is a reference-driven multi-agent framework for automated academic illustration generation. It orchestrates five specialized agents—Retriever, Planner, Stylist, Visualizer, and Critic—to transform scientific content into publication-quality diagrams through in-context learning and iterative refinement. Supports multiple VLMs and image generation models for AI research paper illustrations.

metadata.name: calcuko
metadata.description: calcuko - 多行公式计算器

summary.zh: calcuko是一款多行公式计算器，支持变量定义、实时联动计算和自动依赖更新。用户可像写代码一样编写计算逻辑，内置完整数学函数库。通过PWA技术实现跨平台离线使用，数据自动保存本地。作为calctus的跨平台替代方案，特别适合工程师、学生进行工程计算和数据分析。
summary.en: Calcuko is a multi-line formula calculator allowing you to write calculations like code. It supports variable definitions with real-time dependency updates and automatic result cascading. Built as a PWA with local persistence, it works offline across all platforms. An ideal cross-platform alternative to calctus for engineers, students, and developers handling complex calculations.

metadata.name: distrobox
metadata.description: Use any linux distribution inside your terminal. Enable both backward and forward compatibility with software and freedom to use whatever distribution you’re more comfortable with. Mirror available at: https://gitlab.com/89luca89/distrobox

summary.zh: Distrobox 是一款轻量级容器管理工具，允许用户在终端中运行任意 Linux 发行版。通过 Podman 或 Docker 实现容器化，支持与主机共享 HOME 目录、图形应用和音频，实现软件的前后向兼容。适用于开发环境隔离、跨发行版测试及多系统并存场景。
summary.en: Distrobox is a lightweight container management tool enabling users to run any Linux distribution in the terminal. Built on Podman or Docker, it provides deep host integration including shared HOME, graphical apps, and audio. Perfect for development isolation, cross-distro testing, and multi-system coexistence.

metadata.name: Shiru
metadata.description: A personal anime library manager for watching and tracking your collection in real time. Lightweight, powerful, and paws-itively fast. No waiting required!

summary.zh: Shiru 是一款跨平台动漫资源管理器，支持本地文件直接播放，无需转码即可获得原生性能体验。集成 AniList/MyAnimeList 实时追踪进度，支持字幕多格式（VTT/SSA/ASS），提供双语音偏好设置、离线访问及多用户配置。覆盖 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 全平台。
summary.en: Shiru is a cross-platform anime library manager featuring instant direct file playback for native video performance without transcoding. Integrates with AniList and MyAnimeList for real-time progress tracking, supports multiple subtitle formats, dual audio preferences, offline access, and multi-profile management across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

summary.zh: 用 Rust 实现的高性能代理内核，复刻 mihomo/Clash Meta 功能。支持 Shadowsocks、Trojan、VLESS 等多协议，具备规则引擎、代理组管理、DNS 劫持和透明代理能力。集成 ECH 加密客户端问候和 uTLS 指纹模拟以对抗 TLS 指纹检测，通过 nftables/pf 实现内核级流量拦截。
summary.en: A high-performance Rust implementation of the mihomo proxy kernel with rule-based routing. Supports Shadowsocks, Trojan, VLESS, and more protocols. Features TLS fingerprinting (uTLS/ECH), transparent proxy via nftables/pf, DNS snooping, proxy group management, and a built-in web dashboard.

metadata.name: ClashMac
metadata.description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS

summary.zh: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 构建，提供独特的航线地图可视化功能，将代理节点以航班飞行的方式呈现。支持系统代理和 TUN 双模式，具备实时流量统计、连接拓扑图、节点延迟测试等功能，菜单栏常驻运行，轻量高效。
summary.en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, featuring an innovative route map visualization that presents proxy nodes as flight routes. It supports both System Proxy and TUN modes, offering real-time traffic statistics, connection topology visualization, and node latency testing. A lightweight menu bar application delivering seamless native macOS experience.

metadata.name: clash-party
metadata.description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.

summary.zh: 基于 Electron 开发的 Mihomo(Clash Meta) 图形化客户端，集成 AI 驱动的 Smart Core 智能规则覆写引擎，自动选择最优节点。提供一键 Tun 模式、多种主题、WebDAV 配置备份及 Sub-Store 订阅管理功能，开箱即用，适合追求高效网络代理配置的用户。
summary.en: An Electron-based Mihomo GUI client featuring AI-powered Smart Core rule override engine for automatic optimal node selection. Offers one-click Tun mode, multiple themes, WebDAV backup, and Sub-Store subscription management. Ready to use out of the box for users seeking efficient proxy configuration.

metadata.name: free-claude-code
metadata.description: Use claude-code for free in the terminal, VSCode extension or discord like OpenClaw (voice supported)

summary.zh: Free Claude Code 是一个本地代理工具，将 Claude Code 的 API 流量路由到 NVIDIA NIM、Kimi、OpenRouter 等后端，实现免费使用。支持 CLI、VS Code、JetBrains 等多客户端，内置 Discord/Telegram 机器人、语音转录和管理 UI，可按模型智能路由流量至不同提供商。
summary.en: Free Claude Code is a local proxy that routes Claude Code's Anthropic API traffic to free or local backends like NVIDIA NIM, Kimi, OpenRouter, and Ollama. It supports multiple clients including CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains, with built-in Discord bot, voice transcription, and admin UI for model routing.

summary.zh: siglus_rs 是用 Rust 语言重写的 SiglusEngine 非官方实现，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS、iOS、Android 及 WebAssembly 多平台运行。项目包含资源解密机制，可运行受保护的游戏资源，适用于游戏引擎研究与跨平台移植学习。
summary.en: An unofficial Rust implementation of SiglusEngine, providing cross-platform support across Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, Android, and WebAssembly. Features resource decryption and serves as a research-oriented engine port for learning game engine architecture.

metadata.name: gpt-codex
metadata.description: 这是一个关于 OpenAI CodeX 的完整教程网站，专为国内开发者打造。

summary.zh: 面向国内开发者的 OpenAI Codex 完整教程网站，详细介绍 Codex 与 Claude Code 的区别、GPT-5.5 最新模型特性、编程 Agent 概念及会员权限对比，并提供官网订阅与第三方中转两种获取方案，帮助开发者从认知到上手全面掌握 Codex。
summary.en: A comprehensive tutorial website for Chinese developers on OpenAI Codex, covering Codex vs Claude Code comparison, GPT-5.5 model features, programming Agent concepts, membership permissions, and two acquisition methods to help developers master Codex from basics to practical use.

metadata.name: Asspp
metadata.description: The App Store for your multi-account eco system.

summary.zh: Asspp是一款跨平台原生工具，支持iOS和macOS，可同时管理多个Apple ID实现多地区App Store浏览切换。内置IPA下载功能，可直接从Apple服务器获取签名包并备份，同时支持历史版本下载，无需登出设备即可管理应用库。
summary.en: Asspp is a cross-platform native tool for iOS and macOS that enables multi-account management across different App Store regions. It supports direct IPA downloads from Apple's servers with backup capability, plus version history access—all without logging out of your device.

metadata.name: huashu-design
metadata.description: Huashu Design · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code · Claude Code 里 HTML 原生的设计 skill · 高保真原型 / 幻灯片 / 动画 + 20 设计哲学 + 5 维评审 + MP4 导出 · Agent-agnostic

summary.zh: Huashu Design 是一款 HTML 原生的 AI 设计 skill，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor 等多款 AI 代理。3-30 分钟内即可交付高保真 App 原型、可编辑 PPT、MP4 动画或印刷级信息图。内置 20 种设计哲学与 5 维评审机制，确保输出质量。无需 Figma 或 After Effects，一句话指令即可生成专业级设计作品。
summary.en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agents. In 3-30 minutes, it delivers high-fidelity app prototypes, editable PPTs, MP4 animations, or print-grade infographics. Built-in 20 design philosophies and 5-dimension review mechanisms ensure professional output. No Figma or After Effects needed—just one sentence to generate polished designs.

summary.zh: cc-notebook 是一个现代化的笔记本/笔记管理工具，提供简洁直观的界面用于创建、整理和同步笔记内容，支持多端访问和快速检索，提升个人知识管理效率。
summary.en: cc-notebook is a modern notebook and note management tool offering an intuitive interface for creating, organizing, and syncing notes with multi-device access and quick search capabilities to enhance personal knowledge management efficiency.

metadata.name: pushgo
metadata.description: PushGo for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS/watchOS) is the official client app for PushGo. It works with PushGo Gateway to receive notifications on Apple devices.

summary.zh: PushGo Apple 平台官方客户端，支持 iOS/macOS/watchOS 三大系统，配合 PushGo Gateway 实现跨设备推送通知接收。已上架 App Store，采用 Swift/SwiftUI 原生开发，提供完整的 UI 测试和并发构建验证流程。
summary.en: PushGo official client for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS/watchOS), working with PushGo Gateway to deliver push notifications across devices. Built with Swift/SwiftUI, available on App Store, with comprehensive UI testing and CI/CD pipelines.

metadata.name: ai-website-cloner-template
metadata.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents

summary.zh: 基于AI编码代理的网站克隆工具模板，通过一条命令即可将任意网站逆向工程为干净的Next.js代码库。工具自动完成截图分析、设计令牌提取、资产下载、组件规范编写和并行构建等全流程，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI代理。输出现代化React组件和Tailwind样式，适合快速原型开发和设计参考提取。
summary.en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site into a clean Next.js codebase with a single command. The tool automates screenshot analysis, design token extraction, asset downloading, component spec writing, and parallel building. Supports major AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor, outputting modern React components with Tailwind styles for rapid prototyping and design reference extraction.

metadata.name: PortReleasor
metadata.description: a cross-platform tool for checking and releasing occupied ports

summary.zh: 跨平台Go语言端口管理工具，支持端口占用检查与安全释放，具备通配符匹配、端口范围、批量操作等灵活能力，内置进程缓存与安全确认机制，适用于开发调试与服务器运维场景。
summary.en: A cross-platform Go-based port management tool for checking and safely releasing occupied ports, featuring wildcard matching, range support, batch operations, and built-in safety confirmation. Ideal for development and server operations.

metadata.name: defuddle
metadata.description: Get the main content of any page as Markdown.

summary.zh: Defuddle是一款网页内容提取工具，可从任意URL或HTML中识别并提取主内容，自动移除广告、侧边栏、导航栏等干扰元素。支持浏览器和Node.js环境运行，提供CLI工具，可输出干净的HTML或Markdown格式。专为Obsidian Web Clipper设计，同时可作为Mozilla Readability的替代方案，具备更灵活的清理策略和更丰富的元数据提取能力。
summary.en: Defuddle extracts main content from web pages by removing clutter like ads, sidebars, and navigation elements. It runs in both browser and Node.js environments with CLI support, outputting clean HTML or Markdown. Created for Obsidian Web Clipper, it serves as an alternative to Mozilla Readability with more flexible content extraction and enhanced metadata parsing including schema.org data.

metadata.name: Quitty
metadata.description: Quitty is a lightweight, modern macOS utility that automatically terminates applications when their last window is closed.

summary.zh: Quitty是一款轻量级macOS实用工具，在应用最后一个窗口关闭时自动终止进程。采用原生Accessibility API（AXObserver）实现，兼容macOS 16 Tahoe，支持包含/排除模式智能过滤、可配置延迟、自适应学习引擎及iCloud同步，是SwiftQuit的现代替代方案。
summary.en: Quitty is a lightweight macOS utility that automatically terminates applications when their last window closes. Built with raw Accessibility API (AXObserver) for maximum compatibility with macOS 16 Tahoe, it offers smart filtering modes, configurable delays, adaptive learning, and iCloud sync—a modern alternative to SwiftQuit.

metadata.name: GithubStarsManager
metadata.description: An app for managing github starred repositories.

summary.zh: 一款GitHub星标仓库管理工具，支持AI自动同步、摘要生成与智能分类。通过语义搜索快速定位仓库，追踪发布更新并一键下载。提供Windows/macOS/Linux全平台桌面客户端，数据完全本地存储，隐私安全。
summary.en: A desktop app for managing GitHub starred repositories with AI-powered sync, summarization, and smart categorization. Features semantic search for intent-based discovery, release tracking, one-click downloads, and cross-platform support with fully local data storage.

metadata.name: awesome-gpt-image-2-API-and-Prompts
metadata.description: GPT-Image-2 API and Prompts

summary.zh: GPT Image 2 API与提示词精选资源库，收录585+高质量提示词案例，涵盖电商广告、肖像摄影、海报设计、角色创作等7大应用场景。提供多语言文档、API集成指南及可复用视觉工作流，助力开发者快速掌握OpenAI最新图像生成模型的提示工程技巧与生产级应用。
summary.en: A curated collection of 585+ high-quality GPT Image 2 prompts and API patterns covering 7 categories: e-commerce, advertising, portrait photography, poster design, character creation, and UI mockups. Includes multilingual docs, integration guides, and production-ready workflows for OpenAI's latest image generation model.

metadata.name: ouch
metadata.description: Painless compression and decompression in the terminal

summary.zh: ouch是一个用Rust编写的终端压缩/解压缩工具，支持tar、zip、7z、gz、zst、xz等20+种格式。支持格式链式组合（如.tar.gz.xz.zst）和文件签名自动检测格式。无运行时依赖，并行压缩速度快，错误提示友好，提供Shell补全和man页面。
summary.en: ouch is a CLI tool for compressing and decompressing files in the terminal. Written in Rust, it supports over 20 formats including tar, zip, 7z, gz, zst, xz, lz4, and rar. It features chained format support, automatic format detection via file signatures, parallel compression, zero runtime dependencies, and friendly error messages with shell completions.

metadata.name: paseo
metadata.description: Orchestrate coding agents remotely from your phone, desktop and CLI

summary.zh: Paseo 是一个自托管的 AI 编程智能体编排平台，支持 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多模型。通过本地守护进程架构，用户可在桌面、手机、网页、CLI 等跨设备场景远程控制编程智能体运行，并具备语音控制、隐私优先等特性。
summary.en: Paseo is a self-hosted AI coding agent orchestration platform supporting Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It runs a local daemon to manage agents, offering cross-device control via desktop, mobile, web, and CLI clients with voice input and privacy-first design.

metadata.name: NeteaseCloudMusicAPI-Swift
metadata.description: 网易云音乐 API 原生 Swift SDK — 362 个接口 · 四种加密 · 零依赖 · 全平台

summary.zh: 原生 Swift 编写的网易云音乐 API SDK，封装 362+ 个接口支持四种加密协议（WeAPI/EAPI/LinuxAPI/明文），覆盖 iOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS 全平台。零外部依赖，集成 async/await 和强类型枚举，支持多音源解灰功能，适用于构建网易云音乐第三方客户端或研究其协议实现。
summary.en: A native Swift SDK for Netease Cloud Music API, covering 362+ endpoints with four encryption modes (WeAPI/EAPI/LinuxAPI/Plaintext). Supports iOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS with zero external dependencies. Features async/await, type-safe enums, and multi-source unblocking, ideal for building third-party Netease Music clients or studying protocol implementations.

metadata.name: cocoindex-code
metadata.description: A super light-weight embedded code search engine CLI (AST based) that just works - saves 70% token and improves speed for coding agent  🌟 Star if you like it!

summary.zh: 轻量级AST语义代码搜索引擎，基于Rust高性能数据转换引擎构建。支持CLI、MCP、Skill三种集成方式，可无缝对接Claude、Codex、Cursor等主流AI代码助手。通过智能代码上下文检索实现70% token节省，1分钟零配置启动，适用于代码智能搜索与开发效率提升场景。
summary.en: A lightweight AST-based semantic code search engine built on Rust-powered CocoIndex engine. Supports CLI, MCP, and Skill integrations for seamless AI coding assistants like Claude, Codex, and Cursor. Achieves 70% token savings with instant setup and zero configuration. Perfect for semantic code search and developer productivity enhancement.

metadata.name: CL4R1T4S
metadata.description: LEAKED SYSTEM PROMPTS FOR CHATGPT, CLAUDE, GEMINI, GROK, PERPLEXITY, CURSOR, LOVABLE, REPLIT, AND MORE! - AI SYSTEMS TRANSPARENCY FOR ALL! 👐

summary.zh: AI系统提示词开源档案库，收集ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini等主流AI模型的完整系统指令集。通过泄露/逆向方式获取提示词，帮助用户理解AI行为约束机制、边界定义及内容策略。旨在推动AI透明度，让用户认清AI并非中立实体，而是受隐含规则驱动的系统。
summary.en: Open-source archive of extracted system prompts from major AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more. Collected through leaks and reverse engineering, this repository reveals how AI systems are constrained, what they cannot say, and what behavioral rules govern their outputs. Designed to promote AI transparency and help users understand that AI is not neutral intelligence but operates under hidden directive frameworks.

metadata.name: nuwa-skill
metadata.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.

summary.zh: 女娲是一个AI思维蒸馏工具，通过提取杰出人物的心智模型、决策启发式和表达DNA，让用户可以像咨询乔布斯、马斯克、芒格等人一样获得建议。它不同于角色扮演，而是蒸馏认知操作系统。工作流程包括自动化调研、提炼和验证，已蒸馏13位人物并提供独立安装包。
summary.en: Nuwa is an AI thinking distillation tool that extracts mental models, decision heuristics, and expression DNA from exceptional thinkers, enabling users to consult figures like Jobs, Musk, and Munger. Unlike roleplay, it distills the cognitive operating system. The workflow includes automated research, extraction, and validation, with 13 figures already distilled and standalone packages available.

metadata.name: macpow
metadata.description: 💻🔋 Real-time power tree TUI for Apple Silicon

summary.zh: macpow 是一款专为 Apple Silicon (M1-M5+) 设计的实时功耗监控 TUI 工具，通过直接读取 IOReport、SMC、IORegistry 等 macOS 硬件接口，无需 sudo 权限即可展示 CPU/GPU/ANE/内存等全组件功耗、温度、频率及利用率，并支持进程级能耗归因、树形折叠视图和火花线图表。
summary.en: macpow is a real-time power consumption TUI for Apple Silicon Macs (M1–M5+), reading directly from IOReport, SMC, IORegistry and Mach APIs without sudo to display per-component power draw, temperatures, frequencies, CPU utilization, and per-process energy attribution with collapsible tree views and sparkline charts.

metadata.name: PixelPerfect
metadata.description: Increase the text size of iPhone and iPad apps on Mac. Say goodbye to small and blurry text, and enjoy pixel-perfect graphics, all rendered at 100% native resolution.

summary.zh: PixelPerfect 是一款 macOS 工具，让用户在 Mac 上运行 iPhone 和 iPad 应用时获得更好的阅读体验。它通过将应用从默认的 77% 缩放提升至原生分辨率，解决小字体和模糊文字问题，实现像素完美的清晰显示。支持 Apple Silicon Mac 和 Mac App Store 下载的应用。
summary.en: PixelPerfect is a macOS utility that enhances the readability of iPhone and iPad apps on Mac. It increases text size by switching apps from the default 77% scaling to native resolution, eliminating blurry text and delivering pixel-perfect graphics. Fully compatible with Apple Silicon and Mac App Store apps.

metadata.name: openclaw-zero-token
metadata.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi

summary.zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是一款无需 API Key 即可调用主流 AI 模型的统一网关工具。通过浏览器登录官方 Web UI，支持 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi、Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok、Doubao、GLM、Manus 等 13+ 平台，完全免费且无强制配额限制。本地存储凭证保障安全，并支持 web_search、exec 等本地工具调用功能。
summary.en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a unified gateway enabling free access to 13+ major AI models without API keys. It drives official web UIs via browser login, supporting DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Doubao, GLM, Manus and more. Features local credential storage and tool calling capabilities including web_search and exec for enhanced functionality.

metadata.name: port-killer
metadata.description: A powerful cross-platform port management tool for developers. Monitor ports, manage Kubernetes port forwards, integrate Cloudflare Tunnels, and kill processes with one click.

summary.zh: PortKiller 是一款面向开发者的跨平台端口管理工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows 双平台运行。核心功能包括：自动扫描监听端口、一键终止进程、Kubernetes 端口转发会话管理、Cloudflare Tunnels 状态监控，以及智能端口分类与收藏。集成菜单栏（macOS）和系统托盘（Windows），提供原生 UI 体验，显著提升开发者调试效率。
summary.en: PortKiller is a cross-platform port management tool for developers, supporting macOS and Windows. It auto-discovers listening TCP ports, enables one-click process termination, manages Kubernetes port-forward sessions with auto-reconnect, and monitors Cloudflare Tunnel connections. Features native menu bar/tray integration, smart categorization, and configurable auto-refresh for streamlined development debugging.

metadata.name: iClaw
metadata.description: A native iOS AI Agent app — multiple customizable AI assistants, right on your phone

summary.zh: iClaw是一款原生iOS AI Agent应用，在手机上提供多个可定制的AI助手。每个助手拥有独立人格、记忆和技能，支持设备端JavaScript代码执行、智能上下文压缩和会话RAG。数据通过SwiftData本地存储，无需云端，完全离线运行，保护隐私。
summary.en: iClaw is a native iOS AI Agent app providing multiple customizable AI assistants on your phone. Each agent has its own soul, memory, and skills with on-device JavaScript execution, smart context compression, and session RAG. Data persists locally via SwiftData with zero cloud dependency—fully offline and privacy-preserving.

metadata.name: yourself-skill
metadata.description: 与其蒸馏别人，不如蒸馏自己。欢迎加入数字永生！Inspired by colleague-skill（同事skill）。

summary.zh: 一个数字永生工具，通过蒸馏个人数据（聊天记录、日记、照片）构建「自我记忆+人格模型」双层结构，生成能用你的口头禅思考、用你的逻辑回话的数字副本。集成 Claude Code，支持微信/QQ/社交媒体等多数据源解析，提供增量学习与版本管理。
summary.en: A digital immortality tool that distills personal data (chat logs, diaries, photos) into a dual-layer structure of Self Memory and Persona, creating a digital replica that thinks in your style and responds with your logic. Integrates with Claude Code, supports multi-source parsing, with incremental learning and version control.

metadata.name: safari-mcp
metadata.description: Native Safari browser automation for AI agents. 80 tools via AppleScript — zero overhead, keeps logins, runs silently in background. Drop-in alternative to Chrome DevTools MCP with 40-60% less CPU/heat on Apple Silicon.

summary.zh: Safari MCP 是专为 AI 智能体设计的原生 Safari 浏览器自动化工具。通过 AppleScript 提供 80 个工具，涵盖导航、表单、截图、网络监控等，无需 Puppeteer/Playwright/Chrome。复用用户真实登录态，CPU 占用比 Chrome 低 60%，后台静默运行，命令响应仅 ~5ms。macOS 专用，是 Chrome DevTools MCP 的高效替代方案。
summary.en: Safari MCP delivers native Safari browser automation for AI agents via AppleScript with 80 tools covering navigation, forms, screenshots, and network monitoring. It reuses your actual Safari sessions (logins, cookies), runs silently in background, and uses 60% less CPU than Chrome. No Puppeteer/Playwright dependencies. ~5ms per command. macOS only — a drop-in replacement for Chrome DevTools MCP.

metadata.name: cc-nano-banana
metadata.description: A Claude Code skill to generate images with Nano Banana

summary.zh: 这是一个Claude Code技能插件，通过集成Gemini CLI的nanobanana扩展实现AI图像生成。支持文本生成图片、图片编辑、照片修复、图标生成、流程图创建等功能。用户可通过自然语言指令让Claude Code自动生成博客封面、YouTube缩略图、应用图标等视觉内容。
summary.en: A Claude Code skill that integrates the nanobanana extension from Gemini CLI to enable AI-powered image generation. Supports text-to-image, image editing, photo restoration, icon creation, and diagram generation. Users can leverage natural language prompts to automatically create visual content like blog headers, YouTube thumbnails, and app icons.

metadata.name: nano-banana-skills
metadata.description: Nano Banana Pro Skills

summary.zh: Nano Banana AI智能体技能集合，专注高级图像生成与转换。支持动漫转真人、角色参考表生成、J-Media风格适配、照片修复及IMAX肖像等专业化技能。通过Gemini App调用，采用结构化SKILL.md格式，为创作者提供精准的AI图像处理能力。
summary.en: A curated collection of AI agent skills for Nano Banana, specializing in advanced image generation and transformation. Offers anime-to-life conversion, character reference sheet generation, J-media style adaptation, photo restoration, and IMAX portrait creation. Each skill operates through a structured SKILL.md format within the Gemini App ecosystem.

metadata.name: TaskTick
metadata.description: A native macOS app for managing scheduled tasks. Built with SwiftUI + SwiftData. Menu bar resident, cron expressions, script execution, and more.

summary.zh: 原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，基于 SwiftUI + SwiftData 构建的任务调度工具。支持 cron 表达式、脚本执行（.sh/.py/.rb/.js）、内置模板库、日志追踪和系统通知。无需 crontab 或 launchd，一键导入现有 crontab 配置，适合开发者运维自动化和个人任务管理。
summary.en: A native macOS menu bar app for scheduled task management, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData. Supports cron expressions, multi-language script execution (.sh/.py/.rb/.js), built-in templates, execution logs, and system notifications. No crontab or launchd required—one-click crontab import makes it ideal for developers and automation enthusiasts.

metadata.name: NeteaseCloudMusic_PythonSDK
metadata.description: 多语言音乐 API 绑定库，支持网易云（NeteaseCloudMusicApi）、酷狗（KuGouMusicApi）的音乐服务，已绑定 python语言 和 dart语言，实现 netease 与 kugou 数据操作和访问，适用于音乐应用学习讨论。

summary.zh: MusicLibrary 多语言绑定库，通过 QuickJS 引擎将网易云、酷狗音乐 API 封装为统一接口，支持 Python 和 Dart 调用。架构采用 JavaScript → C → 多语言设计，提供 100+ API 覆盖登录、搜索、播放、评论等完整音乐服务功能，库体积仅 2Mb，跨平台支持 Windows/Linux/macOS。
summary.en: A multi-language music API binding library for Netease Cloud Music and KuGou Music, powered by QuickJS engine. Implements JavaScript → C → multi-language architecture, providing unified interfaces for Python and Dart with 100+ APIs covering login, search, playback, comments and more. Ultra-lightweight at ~2Mb, cross-platform compatible.

metadata.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
metadata.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

summary.zh: 一个针对Claude Code的CLAUDE.md配置文件，源自Andrej Karpathy关于LLM编码陷阱的观察。提供四大原则：先思考（显式假设而非隐藏困惑）、简单性优先（避免过度工程）、精准修改（只改必要代码）、目标驱动执行（测试先行+可验证成功标准）。作为Claude Code插件安装，直接改善AI编程助手的编码质量。
summary.en: A CLAUDE.md configuration file for Claude Code, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls. Provides four principles: Think Before Coding (explicit assumptions), Simplicity First (avoid overengineering), Surgical Changes (touch only what's necessary), and Goal-Driven Execution (tests-first with verifiable criteria). Installable as a Claude Code plugin to directly improve AI coding assistant behavior.

metadata.name: rose
metadata.description: 输入法用户词库转换工具 |  Input Method User Dictionary Converter.

summary.zh: 蔷薇词库转换是一款开源输入法词库转换工具，支持搜狗、百度、QQ、Rime等29种格式互转。内置Web界面和命令行双入口，支持拼音自动注音、五笔编码转换（86/98/新世纪方案）及词长、词频等过滤功能，方便用户在不同输入法间迁移个人词库。
summary.en: Rose is an open-source input method dictionary converter supporting 29 formats including Sogou, Baidu, QQ, and Rime. It offers both Web UI and CLI interfaces, featuring automatic pinyin annotation, Wubi encoding conversion (86/98/New Century schemes), and flexible filtering options for seamless dictionary migration across different input methods.

metadata.name: talk-normal
metadata.description: Make any LLM talk like a normal person. A system prompt that removes AI slop.

summary.zh: 一个系统提示词项目，将 LLM 冗长、企业化的输出转化为简洁、直接的回答。通过优化提示词实现 70%+ 的文本缩减，同时保留全部有用信息。适用于 GPT、Claude、Gemini、LLaMA 等主流模型，帮助用户获得更自然的对话体验。
summary.en: A system prompt that transforms verbose, corporate-sounding LLM output into direct, informative responses. Achieves 70%+ text reduction while preserving all useful information. Works with any model including GPT, Claude, Gemini, and LLaMA. Ideal for improving response quality and readability.

metadata.name: teamspeak-music-bot
metadata.description: TeamSpeak 3 音乐机器人 — 网易云/QQ音乐，YesPlayMusic 风格 WebUI

summary.zh: TeamSpeak 音乐机器人，支持网易云、QQ音乐、哔哩哔哩、YouTube 多平台音源。采用 YesPlayMusic 风格 WebUI，提供深浅主题切换、实时歌词同步、歌单管理和四种播放模式。内置 FFmpeg，支持 TS3/TS6 双协议，机器人头像和状态自动跟随当前歌曲更新。Docker 一键部署，多机器人独立播放，适用于语音频道娱乐场景。
summary.en: A TeamSpeak music bot supporting NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Bilibili, and YouTube sources. Features YesPlayMusic-style WebUI with dark/light themes, real-time lyrics, playlist management, and four playback modes. Built-in FFmpeg, supports TS3/TS6 dual protocols with auto-updating bot avatar and status. Docker-ready with independent multi-bot playback for voice channel entertainment.

metadata.name: AyuGramDesktop
metadata.description: Desktop Telegram client with good customization and Ghost mode.

summary.zh: AyuGramDesktop 是一款基于 Telegram Desktop 的增强型桌面客户端，核心亮点包括灵活的 Ghost Mode（隐身模式）、消息防撤回、本地 Telegram Premium 功能、字体定制等隐私增强特性。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 多平台，兼容 Winget、Scoop、Homebrew、AUR 等多种安装方式，为用户提供高度可定制的 Telegram 体验。
summary.en: AyuGramDesktop is an enhanced Telegram client fork featuring flexible ghost mode for privacy, message anti-recall, local Telegram Premium features, and extensive customization options. Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux with support for multiple package managers, it delivers a highly customizable Telegram experience with privacy-focused enhancements.

metadata.name: CLI-Anything
metadata.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/

summary.zh: CLI-Anything 是香港大学开发的开源项目，旨在将任何软件转换为 AI Agent 可操控的 CLI 接口。通过统一的命令行层，让 Cursor、Claude Code、Pi 等主流 Agent 框架能无缝调用 CAD、3D建模、图表生成等各类专业软件，提供 CLI-Hub 社区平台管理所有生成的命令行工具。
summary.en: CLI-Anything, developed by HKUDS, transforms any software into AI Agent-navigable CLI interfaces. It bridges mainstream agent frameworks like Cursor, Claude Code, and Pi with professional tools including CAD, 3D modeling, and diagram generation, featuring a CLI-Hub community platform for managing all generated command-line utilities.

metadata.name: open-orpheus
metadata.description: An open-source and cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) implementation of Netease Cloud Music's Orpheus browser host. 网易云音乐的Orpheus浏览器宿主的跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）开源实现。

summary.zh: Open Orpheus 是网易云音乐 Orpheus 浏览器宿主的开源跨平台实现，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows。通过 Flathub、Fedora Copr、AUR 等多渠道分发，首次启动自动从网易 CDN 下载必要资源文件。项目以互操作性为目的，不包含网易资产代码，明确抵制任何绕过付费或 DRM 的行为。
summary.en: Open Orpheus is an open-source, cross-platform implementation of Netease Cloud Music's Orpheus browser host, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Distributed via Flathub, Fedora Copr, AUR and more, it auto-downloads required resources from Netease CDN on first launch. Focused on interoperability, it explicitly excludes Netease proprietary assets and opposes any circumvention of paid content or DRM.

metadata.name: hermes-agent
metadata.description: The agent that grows with you

summary.zh: Nous Research打造的自进化AI智能体，具备内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能并持续自我改进。支持Telegram、Discord等多平台接入，兼容OpenRouter等200+模型。内置FTS5会话搜索、自动化调度、子智能体并行执行等功能，支持本地、Docker、Modal等多种后端部署。
summary.en: A self-improving AI agent by Nous Research featuring built-in learning loops that create and refine skills from experience. Supports Telegram, Discord, and other platforms with access to 200+ models via OpenRouter. Includes FTS5 session search, automation scheduling, and parallel subagent execution across diverse backends.

metadata.name: AppDowngrader
metadata.description: Downgrade iOS apps to older versions

summary.zh: AppDowngrader 是一款 macOS 原生应用，实现 iOS 应用一键降级。通过可视化界面浏览已装应用和历史版本，支持 Apple ID 双因素认证自动下载安装任意旧版本。内置 ipatool 和 go-ios 工具，开箱即用。需 macOS 14.0+ 和 USB 连接 iOS 设备。
summary.en: AppDowngrader is a macOS native app for downgrading iOS apps to older versions. It provides a GUI to browse installed apps and historical versions, with Apple ID 2FA support for downloading any previous version. Bundled with ipatool and go-ios — no manual setup required. Requires macOS 14.0+ and USB-connected iOS device.

metadata.name: build-code-agent
metadata.description: 从零构建 Code Agent：Claude Code 源码深度解析 | Build a Code Agent from Scratch: Deep Dive into Claude Code Source

summary.zh: 一门系统解析 Claude Code v2.1.88 源码的工程实践课程。通过 7 大模块、19 章节、3 个实战项目，深入讲解 Agent 循环、Tool 抽象、MCP 协议、多代理协作等核心架构。提供 MiniAgent（800行）、MCP Server（600行）、多代理系统（1000行）三个完整可落地的 TypeScript 项目，助你从零构建功能完备的 AI 编程代理。
summary.en: A comprehensive engineering course diving deep into Claude Code v2.1.88 source code. Through 7 modules, 19 chapters, and 3 hands-on projects, it covers Agent loops, Tool abstraction, MCP protocol, and multi-agent collaboration. Includes three production-ready TypeScript projects: MiniAgent (800 lines), MCP Server (600 lines), and multi-agent system (1000 lines) for building AI coding agents from scratch.

metadata.name: chandra
metadata.description: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.

summary.zh: Chandra OCR 2是Datalab推出的先进文档智能模型，专注于复杂文档识别。支持90+语言，精准处理表格、数学公式、手写内容和多栏布局。输出结构化HTML/Markdown/JSON，保留完整布局信息。在olmocr基准测试中达到SOTA性能，适用于文档数字化、表单处理等企业级应用。
summary.en: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence model by Datalab, excelling at complex document recognition. Supports 90+ languages with precise handling of tables, math, handwriting, and multi-column layouts. Outputs structured HTML/Markdown/JSON while preserving layout. Achieves SOTA performance on olmocr benchmark, ideal for enterprise document digitization.

metadata.name: see-through
metadata.description: "Single-image Layer Decomposition for Anime Characters" (SIGGRAPH 2026, Conditionally Accepted)

summary.zh: 该项目提出一种将单张动漫插画自动分解为多层语义图层的框架（最多23层），包括头发、面部、服装等元素，并推断绘制顺序。结合扩散模型和深度估计技术，可将静态图像转换为可操纵的2.5D模型，应用于动漫创作和数字内容制作。
summary.en: This project introduces a framework that automatically decomposes single anime illustrations into multiple semantic layers (up to 23), including hair, face, and clothing elements, with inferred drawing orders. By combining diffusion models and depth estimation, it transforms static images into manipulatable 2.5D models for anime creation and digital content production.

metadata.name: PUAClaw
metadata.description: Claw 们终将接管世界，PUAClaw is All You Need

summary.zh: PUAClaw 是一个针对大型语言模型的提示词说服框架，涵盖16个技术类别、96项子技术，采用PPE-T四级分类体系。核心研究如何通过心理说服技术在提示词中影响AI行为，包含规范化模板、兼容性矩阵和龙虾评级系统。虽以幽默形式呈现，但本质是AI提示词工程领域的策略性研究。
summary.en: PUAClaw is a prompt persuasion framework for LLMs featuring 16 categories and 96 sub-techniques using the PPE-T classification model. It systematically documents psychological persuasion techniques in prompt engineering, including standardized templates, cross-agent compatibility matrices, and lobster-based rating systems. While presented humorously, it represents serious research in AI prompt strategy.

metadata.name: ChaoXing_node_signin
metadata.description: 学习通在线自动签到系统第三方节点接入程序，用于自行部署可接入学习通在线自动签到系统的第三方节点，该程序需配合学习通在线自动签到系统使用

summary.zh: 基于学习通平台的自动化签到系统第三方节点程序，支持exe、Python、Docker三种部署方式。用户可自建节点接入官方签到系统，实现签到监控、邮件通知、节点密码保护及使用人数限制等功能，适用于教育场景的考勤自动化需求。
summary.en: A third-party node program for Chaoxing auto sign-in system supporting exe, Python and Docker deployments. Users can deploy custom nodes to connect with the official sign-in system, featuring real-time monitoring, email notifications, password protection and user limit controls for educational attendance automation.

metadata.name: shuorenhua
metadata.description: 说人话｜Chinese-first AI writing refinement skill that reduces boilerplate and AI tone while preserving facts, terminology, and technical context.

summary.zh: 中文AI味清理工具，通过210+短语规则和19类结构反模式识别，去除AI生成文本中的过度承接、工程师腔、翻译腔等表演感。保留事实、数字、版本、命令等关键信息，按聊天、状态同步、技术文档、公开写作四档场景自适应处理。适用于Codex、Claude Code、Cursor等AI助手输出优化。
summary.en: A Chinese AI writing refinement tool that removes boilerplate and artificial tone from AI-generated text. Features 210+ Chinese phrase rules, 96 English rules, and 19 structural anti-patterns. Preserves facts, versions, and commands while cutting excessive hedging and performance-style language. Adapts to four scene types: chat, status sync, docs, and public writing.

metadata.name: PasteMemo
metadata.description: PasteMemo - Smart clipboard manager for macOS

summary.zh: PasteMemo 是一款 macOS 智能剪贴板管理器，支持文本、图片、文件、代码等多类型内容自动识别与存储。通过全局热键 ⌘⇧V 快速调出剪贴板面板，支持键盘导航、批量粘贴 Relay Mode，可将内容直接转为文件或粘贴至 AI 终端，显著提升复制粘贴效率。
summary.en: PasteMemo is a smart clipboard manager for macOS that automatically recognizes and stores text, images, files, code, and more. With global hotkey ⌘⇧V, it provides instant access to clipboard history, keyboard navigation, and Relay Mode for batch pasting. Seamlessly integrates with AI terminals and file systems.

metadata.name: ham_home
metadata.description: HamHome is an AI-powered browser extension for collecting, organizing, and retrieving web content—auto-categorized, summarized, and tagged, with all data kept local and private.       HamHome 是一款 AI 驱动的浏览器扩展，用于智能地收集、整理和检索网页内容。它可以自动分类页面、生成摘要并推荐标签，同时所有数据都保存在本地，确保隐私与安全。

summary.zh: HamHome 是一款 AI 驱动的浏览器书签管理扩展，支持 AI 自动分类页面、智能生成摘要与推荐标签，并提供语义搜索功能。所有数据本地存储确保隐私安全，支持 WebDAV 多设备同步、工作区保存与恢复、智能标签分组等特性，适合个人知识管理与高效浏览整理。
summary.en: HamHome is an AI-powered bookmark manager for browsers that auto-categorizes pages, generates summaries, suggests tags, and enables semantic search. All data stays local for privacy, with WebDAV sync, workspace saving, and smart tab grouping—ideal for personal knowledge management.

metadata.name: fakabot
metadata.description: Telegram自动发卡机器人 电报发卡机器人 - 支持支付宝/微信/USDT支付 自动发货 订单管理 虚拟商品 | Telegram Auto Card Delivery Bot Payment Shop

summary.zh: Fakabot 是一款基于 Python + Redis 的 Telegram 自动发卡机器人，支持支付宝当面付、微信 Native、USDT（TRC20/ERC20）等多种支付方式。支付成功后自动发货，支持卡密提取、群邀请链接、下载链接等发货模式。集成 Redis 高性能缓存提升响应速度，提供商品管理、订单管理、用户管理及管理后台等完整电商功能，支持 Docker 一键部署。
summary.en: Fakabot is a Python-based Telegram bot for automated virtual goods delivery, supporting Alipay, WeChat Pay, and USDT payments. It features automatic delivery via card keys, group invite links, or download links after payment confirmation. Built with Redis caching for high performance, it provides complete e-commerce functionality including product management, order tracking, user management, and an admin dashboard, deployable via Docker.

metadata.name: agent-browser
metadata.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents

summary.zh: Vercel Labs推出的AI代理浏览器自动化CLI工具，采用Rust原生实现以获得卓越性能。提供基于可访问性树ref的智能操作（点击、填写等）及传统选择器支持，可执行截图、滚动等浏览器控制。无需Playwright或Node.js运行守护进程，适合AI智能体执行复杂网页任务。
summary.en: A high-performance browser automation CLI for AI agents, built with native Rust by Vercel Labs. Enables browser control via accessibility tree refs or traditional selectors for clicks, fills, screenshots, and more. No Playwright or Node.js runtime required for the daemon, ideal for AI agents executing web tasks.

metadata.name: browser
metadata.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation

summary.zh: Lightpanda 是一款从零编写的无头浏览器，采用 Zig 语言开发，非 Chromium 或 WebKit 分支。专为 AI 代理和自动化场景优化，性能显著优于传统方案：内存占用减少约 16 倍，执行速度快约 9 倍。支持 CDP 协议，可与 Puppeteer、Playwright 等主流自动化工具无缝集成。
summary.en: Lightpanda is a headless browser built from scratch in Zig, not a Chromium fork or WebKit patch. Optimized for AI agents and automation, it delivers 16x less memory usage and 9x faster execution than Headless Chrome. Supports CDP protocol for seamless integration with Puppeteer, Playwright, and other automation tools.

metadata.name: ECC
metadata.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

summary.zh: ECC是AI智能体性能优化系统，支持Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等主流AI编程工具。集成技能库、本能反应、记忆优化、安全扫描和持续学习功能，历经10个月深度开发并获Anthropic黑客松冠军。提供生产级智能体、规则配置和GitHub App集成，支持12种编程语言生态。
summary.en: ECC is an AI agent harness optimization system supporting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other major AI coding tools. Integrates skills, instincts, memory optimization, security scanning and continuous learning, developed over 10 months and winning the Anthropic hackathon. Provides production-grade agents, rule configurations and GitHub App integration across 12 language ecosystems.

metadata.name: ghgrab
metadata.description: A simple, pretty terminal tool that lets you search and download files from GitHub without leaving your CLI.

summary.zh: ghgrab 是一款 Rust 编写的终端工具，无需完整 clone 即可从 GitHub 仓库快速搜索、预览和下载指定文件或文件夹。内置模糊搜索、文件预览、批量下载、GitHub LFS 支持及 Release 资产下载功能，支持 NPM/Cargo/PIP 多平台安装，让开发者高效获取所需代码资源。
summary.en: ghgrab is a Rust-powered CLI tool for searching and downloading specific files or folders from GitHub repositories without full cloning. Features fuzzy search, file preview, batch downloads, LFS support, and release asset downloads with OS/architecture detection. Available via NPM, Cargo, and PIP.

metadata.name: chromeclaw
metadata.description: Your own personal AI assistant in Chrome/Firefox. 🦞

summary.zh: ChromeClaw 是一款运行在浏览器沙箱中的轻量级 AI 助手扩展，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多提供商 LLM。通过offscreen document 技术集成 WhatsApp/Telegram 消息通道，结合 Kokoro 本地 TTS 与 Whisper STT 实现语音交互，采用 BM25+向量混合记忆系统，支持 25+ 内置工具、深度研究、多智能体协作及 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动的浏览器自动化，开箱即用无需服务器。
summary.en: ChromeClaw is a lightweight AI agent browser extension running in the browser sandbox with multi-provider LLM support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter). It integrates WhatsApp/Telegram messaging via offscreen documents, enables voice I/O with Kokoro TTS and Whisper STT, and features a hybrid BM25+vector memory system. With 25+ built-in tools, deep research, multi-agent collaboration, and Chrome DevTools Protocol automation, it requires no server infrastructure.

metadata.name: Cosmosh
metadata.description: Yet another SSH client. Under development

summary.zh: Cosmosh 是一款基于 Electron 构建的高性能 SSH/终端客户端，采用 Vite + React + TypeScript 前端与 Hono + Node.js 后端的现代化架构。通过 OpenAPI 驱动的 API 契约实现前后端类型共享，支持多语言国际化，采用 pnpm monorepo 管理，适合专业运维场景。
summary.en: Cosmosh is a high-performance SSH/Terminal client built with Electron, featuring Vite + React + TypeScript frontend and Hono + Node.js backend. It leverages OpenAPI-driven API contracts for type sharing, supports internationalization, and uses pnpm monorepo structure for professional-grade remote server management.

metadata.name: cpx
metadata.description: cp reimagined

summary.zh: cpx 是用 Rust 编写的现代化文件复制工具，可作为 Linux 系统上 cp 命令的替代品。支持并行复制（号称比 cp 快 5 倍）、实时进度条显示、断点续传、gitignore 风格排除模式等功能，性能优异且内存安全。
summary.en: cpx is a modern, high-performance file copy utility built with Rust as a replacement for the traditional `cp` command on Linux. It features parallel copying, beautiful progress bars, resume capability for interrupted transfers, and gitignore-style exclude patterns. Developed for maximum performance and safety.

metadata.name: treesandbox
metadata.description: Another Linux sandbox tool (in beta). Rootless. Allows unlimited nesting if you want. Single-file .py . No 3rd-party python lib needed.

summary.zh: TreeSandbox是一个Linux无root沙箱工具，采用创新的“树形”多层容器架构，支持无限嵌套隔离。单文件Python脚本实现，无第三方依赖，可为应用程序创建独立的文件系统、网络和GUI隔离环境。支持X11/GPU隔离、DBus过滤等特性，适合替代或补充Firejail、Flatpak等传统沙箱方案。
summary.en: TreeSandbox is a rootless Linux sandbox tool featuring an innovative tree-shaped multi-layer container architecture with unlimited nesting. Implemented as a single-file Python script with no third-party dependencies, it provides isolated filesystem, network, and GUI environments. Supports X11/GPU isolation and DBus filtering, serving as a complementary solution to traditional sandbox tools like Firejail and Flatpak.

metadata.name: filter-repo-rs
metadata.description: 🦀 A high-performance Rust implementation of git-filter-repo for efficiently rewriting Git repository history. Remove sensitive data, shrink repos, and restructure projects with streaming pipeline architecture.

summary.zh: 用 Rust 实现的高性能 Git 历史重写工具，可移除敏感信息、缩减仓库体积、重构项目结构。采用流式管道架构，支持子目录提取、身份标准化、秘密检测等功能，提供备份、预览、审计报告等安全机制，兼容 Linux/macOS/Windows。
summary.en: A high-performance Rust-based Git history rewriting tool for removing sensitive data, shrinking repos, and restructuring projects. Features a streaming pipeline architecture with subdirectory extraction, identity normalization, and secret detection. Offers backup, dry-run, and audit reporting for safe operations across Linux/macOS/Windows.

metadata.name: chops
metadata.description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.

summary.zh: Chops 是一款 macOS 原生应用，用于统一管理和编辑 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等主流 AI 编程助手的技能配置。采用 SwiftUI + SwiftData 构建，支持实时文件监控、收藏夹组织和全文搜索，让开发者告别散落在各工具目录中的 dotfiles。
summary.en: Chops is a native macOS app for centralized management and editing of AI coding agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and more. Built with SwiftUI and SwiftData, it offers real-time file watching, collections, and full-text search to eliminate scattered dotfiles management.

metadata.name: OmniBox
metadata.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的高性能、功能完善的 Web 代理服务

summary.zh: OmniBox 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的高性能 Web 代理服务，采用纯 TypeScript 构建实现零运行时依赖。利用边缘计算实现全球低延迟访问，内置 SSRF 防护、爬虫过滤、密码保护等安全机制，支持完整代理 HTML、CSS、JS、图片等各类资源，适用于安全访问受限网站场景。
summary.en: OmniBox is a high-performance web proxy service built on Cloudflare Workers using pure TypeScript with zero runtime dependencies. Leveraging edge computing for global low-latency access, it features robust security including SSRF protection, bot filtering, and password authentication. Supports full proxying of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images and other resources.

metadata.name: rtk
metadata.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

summary.zh: RTK是高性能CLI代理工具，专为AI辅助开发设计。通过智能过滤和压缩命令输出，可节省60-90%的LLM token消耗。单Rust二进制文件，支持100+命令（git、cargo、pytest等），延迟<10ms。开发者使用Claude Code等AI编程工具时，可显著降低成本并提升上下文效率。
summary.en: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy designed for AI-assisted development. It filters and compresses command outputs, achieving 60-90% token savings for LLMs. Built as a single Rust binary, it supports 100+ commands (git, cargo, pytest, etc.) with <10ms overhead, significantly reducing costs and improving context efficiency for AI coding tools.

metadata.name: RuView
metadata.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.

summary.zh: RuView将普通WiFi信号转化为实时空间智能，支持穿透墙壁的人员检测、呼吸和心率监测、活动识别及睡眠质量评估。采用ESP32传感器捕获CSI数据，结合尖峰神经网络在30秒内完成环境学习，支持多节点Mesh组网和密码学认证，完全本地运行无需云端或摄像头。
summary.en: RuView transforms commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence for through-wall presence detection, contactless vital sign monitoring, and activity recognition. Built on ESP32 CSI sensors with spiking neural networks, it achieves sub-30-second environmental adaptation. Supports multi-node mesh networking with cryptographic attestation, operating entirely at the edge without cloud or cameras.

metadata.name: API-Police
metadata.description: API Police is a multi-dimensional model authenticity auditing tool for verifying whether a third-party API provider is truly serving the model it claims.

summary.zh: API Police是一款AI模型真实性审计工具，通过7层验证框架（分词器指纹、能力阶梯、行为指纹、对数概率分布、性能画像、知识边界、直接探测）交叉验证第三方API提供商是否真实提供其所声称的模型。支持快速筛选和完整审计两种模式，并可基于官方API建立可信基线指纹，有效增加模型伪装成本。
summary.en: API Police is a multi-dimensional model authenticity auditing tool that cross-validates whether third-party API providers are genuinely serving the claimed models. It implements a 7-layer verification framework covering tokenizer fingerprints, capability ladders, behavioral patterns, logprobs distribution, performance profiles, knowledge boundaries, and direct probes. With quick and full audit modes, it builds trusted baselines from official APIs via calibration, significantly raising the cost of model spoofing.

metadata.name: SwiftBar
metadata.description: Powerful macOS menu bar customization tool

summary.zh: SwiftBar 是一款 macOS 菜单栏增强工具，通过 Shell 脚本即可在菜单栏添加自定义程序。支持毫秒到天的多级刷新间隔，兼容 BitBar 插件生态，内置插件仓库便于获取社区插件。适合系统监控、信息展示和快捷操作场景。
summary.en: SwiftBar is a macOS menu bar customization tool that enables custom programs via shell scripts. It supports flexible refresh intervals from milliseconds to days, compatible with BitBar plugins, and includes a built-in plugin repository for easy access to community contributions.

metadata.name: glazepkg
metadata.description: See all your installed packages in one place.

summary.zh: GlazePKG (gpk) 是一款美观的终端界面工具，将36种包管理器统一到一个可搜索、可快照、可对比的视图中。支持 brew、pip、npm、apt 等主流包管理器，提供模糊搜索、包操作、状态快照与差异对比功能。单个静态二进制文件，跨平台开箱即用。
summary.en: GlazePKG (gpk) is a beautiful TUI that unifies 36 package managers into a single searchable, snapshotable, diffable view. It supports major package managers like brew, pip, npm, apt, and more. Features include fuzzy search, package operations, system snapshots with diff comparison, and JSON export. Built with Go and Bubble Tea, it ships as a single static binary for cross-platform use.

metadata.name: iDescriptor
metadata.description: A free, open-source, and cross-platform iDevice management tool

summary.zh: iDescriptor 是一款基于 Rust 和 Qt 构建的跨平台开源 iOS 设备管理工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 系统，提供设备信息查看、数据传输与管理等功能，采用 C++20 编写核心逻辑，界面简洁易用且完全免费开源。
summary.en: iDescriptor is a cross-platform, open-source iOS device management tool built with Rust and Qt, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers device information viewing and data management capabilities, with C++20 core logic and a user-friendly interface, completely free and open-source.

metadata.name: ForkFlow
metadata.description: ForkFlow ⚡ 一键批量同步 GitHub Fork，自动清理僵尸仓库，让你的分叉永远与上游保持光速同步！🔥

summary.zh: ForkFlow 是一款 GitHub Fork 同步管理仪表盘，支持一键批量同步多个 Fork 仓库与上游保持同步，自动清理已删除或取消 Fork 的僵尸仓库。提供本地 Node.js 和 Cloudflare Workers 两种部署方式，前端采用纯原生 HTML/CSS/JS，极简轻量。
summary.en: ForkFlow is a GitHub Fork sync dashboard enabling one-click batch synchronization of multiple forks with upstream repositories, plus automatic cleanup of orphaned or deleted forks. Offers both local Node.js and Cloudflare Workers deployment, with a lightweight pure HTML/CSS/JS frontend.

metadata.name: rip
metadata.description: Fuzzy find and kill processes from your terminal

summary.zh: 一款终端进程管理工具，通过模糊搜索快速定位并交互式终止进程。支持按CPU、内存、PID、名称排序，可按端口过滤进程，支持SIGKILL/SIGTERM等多种信号发送。提供实时刷新模式和空格多选功能，帮助开发者高效管理后台进程和端口占用。
summary.en: A terminal process manager that enables fuzzy search to quickly locate and interactively kill processes. Supports sorting by CPU, memory, PID, or name, filtering by network ports, and sending various signals like SIGKILL/SIGTERM. Features live refresh mode and multi-select capability for efficient process and port management.

metadata.name: IPDB
metadata.description: Cloudflare反代优选IP库

summary.zh: Cloudflare IP地址查询API服务，提供CF官方IP、反代IP、优选IP等多种类型的IPv4/IPv6地址获取，支持地理位置标注与文件下载。该服务专为网络优化和CDN加速场景设计，实时更新，可显著提升访问速度与连接质量。
summary.en: A Cloudflare IP address query API service providing CF official IPs, proxy IPs, and optimized IPs in IPv4/IPv6 formats. Supports geolocation labeling and file download, designed for network optimization and CDN acceleration with real-time updates.

metadata.name: Surge
metadata.description: Rule Snippet & Rule Set for Surge / Mihomo (Clash.Meta) / Clash Premium (Dreamacro) / sing-box / Surfboard for Android / Stash

summary.zh: SukkaW 维护的综合网络代理规则集项目，为 Surge、Mihomo、Clash Premium、sing-box、Surfboard 和 Stash 等主流代理工具提供规则配置。规则涵盖广告拦截、隐私保护、恶意软件和钓鱼网站防护，支持 domainset、non_ip、ip 等多种格式，并提供 CDN 加速镜像服务。
summary.en: A comprehensive network proxy ruleset maintained by SukkaW, providing rule configurations for Surge, Mihomo, Clash Premium, sing-box, Surfboard, and Stash. Rules cover ad blocking, privacy protection, malware and phishing prevention, supporting multiple formats like domainset, non_ip, and ip with CDN-accelerated mirror services.

metadata.name: Win11Debloat
metadata.description: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.

summary.zh: 轻量级PowerShell脚本，一键移除Windows预装臃肿应用、禁用遥测数据收集、清理侵入性界面元素。支持Windows 10/11，提供交互式菜单和命令行参数两种运行方式，内置系统管理员模式和批量用户配置功能，快速自定义清爽的Windows使用体验。
summary.en: A lightweight PowerShell script that removes bloatware, disables telemetry, and cleans intrusive UI elements on Windows 10/11. Features an interactive menu and CLI support, with options for system administrators including Audit mode and multi-user configuration for a streamlined Windows experience.

metadata.name: Capsense
metadata.description: Repurpose the CapsLock key for switching input methods on Windows.

summary.zh: Capsense 将 Windows 上的 CapsLock 键重新定义为输入法切换快捷键。借鉴 macOS 理念，短按切换输入法，长按保留 CapsLock 原功能。支持配置 300ms 阈值和多种语言布局（中/日/韩），可通过 config.toml 自定义 tap_action（切换布局或触发快捷键）。内置 no_en 选项防止中文输入法意外进入英文模式，资源占用极低，支持命令行和 GUI 实例管理。
summary.en: Capsense repurposes CapsLock on Windows for seamless IME switching—a quick tap toggles input methods while a long press retains the original CapsLock function. Inspired by macOS, it supports multiple layouts (Chinese/Japanese/Korean), configurable tap threshold (300ms default), and prevents Chinese IME from entering English mode. Lightweight background service with CLI and GUI instance manager.

metadata.name: Understand-Anything
metadata.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code, or knowledge base (Karpathy LLM wiki), into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.

summary.zh: 将任意代码库或知识库转换为交互式知识图谱的多智能体工具。通过分析文件、函数、类及依赖关系构建可视化图谱，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI编码助手。用户可探索、搜索并提问，快速理解复杂代码结构，特别适合新成员上手大型项目。
summary.en: A multi-agent tool that transforms codebases or knowledge bases into interactive knowledge graphs. It analyzes files, functions, classes, and dependencies to build visual graphs, supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants. Users can explore, search, and ask questions to quickly understand complex code structures, especially useful for onboarding new team members.

metadata.name: MoneyPrinterV2
metadata.description: Automate the process of making money online.

summary.zh: MoneyPrinterV2 是一款在线赚钱自动化工具，支持 Twitter 机器人定时发帖、YouTube Shorts 自动生成、亚马逊联盟营销及本地企业冷外展。集成 AI 生成内容、TTS 语音合成和 GPT4Free API，采用模块化架构设计，Python 3.12 开发，适用于社交媒体运营和数字营销场景。
summary.en: MoneyPrinterV2 automates online money-making through Twitter bots with CRON scheduling, YouTube Shorts generation, Amazon affiliate marketing, and local business outreach. Features AI content generation, TTS synthesis, modular architecture, built with Python 3.12 for social media automation and digital marketing.

metadata.name: zeroclaw
metadata.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, ANY OS, ANY PLATFORM — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀

summary.zh: ZeroClaw是一个用Rust编写的轻量级AI个人助手运行时环境。它支持20+个LLM提供商和30+个通信渠道（Discord、Telegram、Matrix等），可在任意操作系统上本地部署。用户完全掌控数据、密钥和运行环境，通过工具扩展实现shell、浏览器、HTTP请求等自动化能力。
summary.en: ZeroClaw is a lightweight AI personal assistant runtime written in Rust. It supports 20+ LLM providers and 30+ communication channels (Discord, Telegram, Matrix, etc.), deployable locally on any OS. Users have full control over data, keys, and runtime environment, with tool extensions enabling shell, browser, HTTP automation and more.

metadata.name: HardwareQuality
metadata.description: 硬件质量检测脚本 - Hardware Quality Check Script

summary.zh: 跨平台硬件质量检测脚本，支持Ubuntu/Debian/Fedora等主流Linux发行版及Docker环境。自动采集CPU/GPU/内存/硬盘等硬件信息，通过sysbench/fio/Geekbench进行性能基准测试，支持SMART/NVMe健康检测。提供中英文双语界面、标准/快速/深度/硬盘等多种运行模式，输出JSON格式便于大数据分析。适用于服务器/VPS/容器/裸金属等多场景硬件评估。
summary.en: Cross-platform hardware quality check script supporting major Linux distributions and Docker. Automatically collects CPU/GPU/memory/disk info with sysbench/fio/Geekbench benchmarks and SMART/NVMe health detection. Features bilingual UI, multiple modes (standard/quick/deep/disk), and JSON output for data analysis. Ideal for server/VPS/container/bare-metal hardware evaluation.

metadata.name: Lattice_release
metadata.description: A lightweight macOS literature manager built in native Swift.

summary.zh: Lattice 是一款专为 macOS 设计的轻量级文献管理器，采用原生 Swift 开发而非 Electron 或 Web 框架。它专注于 PDF 元数据智能提取、标注管理和模板化导出，支持 BibTeX、Markdown 等开放格式，可与 Apple Shortcuts 深度集成。应用体积小、内存占用低，PDF 以链接方式管理避免重复复制，为学术写作者提供高效开放的文献工作流。
summary.en: Lattice is a lightweight macOS literature manager built with native Swift, not Electron or web wrappers. It focuses on PDF metadata extraction, annotation management, and template-based export with open formats like BibTeX and Markdown. Deep Apple Shortcuts integration, small footprint under 20 MB, and linked PDFs avoid duplication—offering an efficient, open workflow for academic writers on macOS.

metadata.name: KittenTTS
metadata.description: State-of-the-art TTS model under 25MB 😻

summary.zh: KittenTTS 是基于 ONNX 的超轻量级文本转语音库，模型最小仅 25MB（int8 量化），支持 15M-80M 参数规模。专为 CPU 推理优化，无需 GPU 即可高效运行，提供 Bella、Jasper、Luna 等 8 种内置音色，支持语速调节和数字货币等单位文本预处理，输出 24kHz 高质量音频，适配边缘设备与嵌入式场景部署。
summary.en: KittenTTS is an open-source, ultra-lightweight text-to-speech library built on ONNX. With models ranging from 25MB to 80MB (15M-80M parameters), it delivers high-quality voice synthesis optimized for CPU inference without GPU requirements. Features 8 built-in voices, adjustable speech speed, and text preprocessing for numbers, currencies, and units. Outputs 24kHz audio, ideal for edge deployment.

metadata.name: CloudflareSpeedTest
metadata.description: 🌩「自选优选 IP」测试 Cloudflare CDN 延迟和速度，获取最快 IP ！当然也支持其他 CDN / 多个解析 IP 的网站 ~

summary.zh: 一款专注于 Cloudflare CDN IP 测速优选的工具，可快速测试大量 IP 的延迟和下载速度，自动筛选出最优节点。完美支持 IPv4/IPv6，也兼容其他 CDN 及多 IP 网站的测速需求。跨平台设计，提供预编译二进制，Windows/Linux/macOS 即开即用。
summary.en: A Go-based tool to benchmark and select optimal Cloudflare CDN IPs by measuring latency and download speed across IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Also supports other CDNs and multi-IP sites. Cross-platform with ready-to-run binaries for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

metadata.name: nodewarden
metadata.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers

summary.zh: NodeWarden 是一款运行在 Cloudflare Workers 上的开源 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，支持网页密码库、附件上传下载、Send、TOTP 等核心功能。采用 R2/KV 存储，原创 Web Vault 界面，提供 WebDAV/S3 云端备份中心。相比官方服务端，轻量且部署简单，适合追求数据自主掌控的个人和团队自建密码管理服务。
summary.en: NodeWarden is an open-source Bitwarden-compatible password server running on Cloudflare Workers. It features a custom Web Vault, full sync, attachments via R2/KV storage, Send functionality, and TOTP support. With cloud backup to WebDAV/S3 and one-click GitHub deployment, it offers a lightweight self-hosted alternative for personal or team password management.

metadata.name: zoxide
metadata.description: A smarter cd command. Supports all major shells.

summary.zh: zoxide 是一个智能化的 cd 命令增强工具，通过机器学习记录用户最常访问的目录，实现模糊匹配快速跳转。支持交互式选择和主流 Shell 集成，显著提升终端目录导航效率。
summary.en: zoxide is a smarter cd command that learns your directory usage patterns to enable quick navigation via fuzzy matching. It integrates with major shells and supports interactive selection for efficient terminal workflow.

metadata.name: pixi
metadata.description: Powerful system-level package manager for Linux, macOS and Windows written in Rust – building on top of the Conda ecosystem.

summary.zh: Pixi 是一个跨平台、多语言的包管理器，基于 Conda 生态，使用 Rust 编写。它提供类似 cargo/npm 的命令行体验，支持 Python、C++、R 等多种语言，可实现项目级或系统级依赖管理，具备自动锁文件机制，确保跨平台环境一致性，适用于开发者管理多语言依赖和构建环境。
summary.en: Pixi is a cross-platform, multi-language package manager built on the Conda ecosystem, written in Rust. It offers Cargo-like CLI experience, supporting Python, C++, R and more languages. With automatic lock files and per-project or system-wide installation, it ensures reproducible environments across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

metadata.name: uv
metadata.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.

summary.zh: uv 是由 Rust 编写的极速 Python 包和项目管理器，性能比 pip 快 10-100 倍。它统一了 pip、pipx、poetry、pyenv、virtualenv 等多种工具，提供项目管理、依赖解析、虚拟环境管理、脚本执行、Python 版本安装等功能。内置全局缓存和工作区支持，兼容 macOS、Linux、Windows，由 Ruff 团队 Astral 开发。
summary.en: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager built in Rust, achieving 10-100x speedup over pip. It consolidates multiple tools including pip, pipx, poetry, pyenv, and virtualenv into a unified solution. Features include comprehensive project management with lockfiles, script execution, Python version management, and global caching. Cross-platform support for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Developed by Astral, the creators of Ruff.

metadata.name: agentskills-mcp
metadata.description: AgentSkills MCP: Bringing Anthropic's Agent Skills to Any MCP-compatible Agent

summary.zh: AgentSkills MCP是一个将Anthropic官方Agent Skills功能开源化的项目，基于FlowLLM框架实现，让任何MCP兼容代理都能使用Claude的专业技能包。通过渐进式披露架构智能加载技能，高效利用上下文窗口。支持stdio/SSE/HTTP多种传输协议，零代码配置即可快速部署。
summary.en: AgentSkills MCP brings Anthropic's Agent Skills to any MCP-compatible agent, built on the FlowLLM framework. It implements Progressive Disclosure architecture for smart skill loading, maximizing context window efficiency. Supports multiple transports (stdio/SSE/HTTP) with zero-code configuration for quick deployment.

metadata.name: cloud-mail
metadata.description: A Cloudflare-based email service  | 基于 Cloudflare 的邮箱服务  | Cloudflare Email 邮箱 Mail

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的开源邮箱服务项目，仅需一个域名即可创建多个邮箱账号。支持邮件收发、附件上传（R2存储）、群发、内嵌图片等功能。集成 Resend 发送邮件、Workers AI 验证码识别、Turnstile 人机验证。采用 Vue3 + Element Plus 构建响应式前端，Hono + Drizzle 构建后端，支持 RBAC 权限管理、数据可视化（ECharts）和邮件推送（TG机器人）。
summary.en: An open-source email service built on Cloudflare Workers, allowing you to create multiple mailboxes with just one domain. Features include email sending/receiving, attachments (R2 storage), mass mailing, and inline images. Integrates Resend for email delivery, Workers AI for CAPTCHA recognition, and Turnstile for bot protection. Built with Vue3 + Element Plus frontend and Hono + Drizzle backend, supporting RBAC, data visualization, and push notifications.

metadata.name: camofox-browser
metadata.description: Anti-detection browser server for AI agents — REST API wrapping Camoufox engine with OpenClaw plugin support

summary.zh: Camofox是一款面向AI代理的反检测浏览器服务器，基于Camoufox Firefox内核实现C++级指纹伪造，无需JavaScript注入即可绕过反爬机制。通过REST API提供语言无关的浏览器自动化，支持多会话隔离、持久化配置、地理位置模拟、14种平台搜索宏及结构化数据提取，兼容OpenClaw插件生态。
summary.en: CamoFox is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents, leveraging Camoufox's C++ engine-level fingerprint spoofing for robust stealth browsing. It provides a language-agnostic REST API with multi-session isolation, persistent profiles, geo presets, 14 platform search macros, structured extraction, and OpenClaw plugin compatibility.

metadata.name: Chaoxing-MiniProgram
metadata.description: ⭐⭐学习通签到助手⭐⭐ 本项目基于原生微信小程序开发，无需安装 签到更快捷，支持转发快速代签！无需安装，无安全隐患！✨非开源版支持自动通过滑块验证码，支持批量二维码签到，更多细节请阅读文档！

summary.zh: 基于原生微信小程序开发的学习通签到助手，支持二维码、定位、拍照等多种签到方式。通过边缘代理技术绕过平台限制，实现无后端快速代签。开源版免费使用，非开源版额外支持滑块验证码自动通过与批量签到功能。
summary.en: A WeChat Mini Program for Chaoxing attendance automation, supporting QR code, location, and photo check-in modes. Uses edge proxy technology to bypass platform restrictions for serverless quick attendance. Open-source version is free; paid version adds auto slider captcha and batch check-in capabilities.

metadata.name: OpenCLI
metadata.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.

summary.zh: OpenCLI 将任意网站转换为 CLI 界面，支持 AI agent 通过已登录的 Chrome 浏览器进行网页自动化操作。项目提供内置适配器覆盖主流平台（Reddit、HackerNews、Twitter/X 等），并作为 CLI 中心集成 gh、docker 等本地工具。开发者可借助浏览器扩展和本地守护进程快速构建新的网站适配器，实现导航、表单填写、数据提取等自动化任务。
summary.en: OpenCLI converts any website into a CLI interface and enables AI agents to automate browser tasks using your logged-in Chrome session. It provides built-in adapters for major platforms like Reddit, HackerNews, and Twitter/X, while serving as a CLI hub for local tools. Developers can leverage the Chrome extension and local daemon to build custom website adapters for navigation, form filling, and data extraction.

metadata.name: AstrBot
metadata.description: AI Agent Assistant & development framework that integrates lots of IM platforms, LLMs, plugins and AI feature, and can be your openclaw alternative. ✨

summary.zh: AstrBot 是一个开源的 AI Agent 开发框架，集成主流即时通讯平台与多种大语言模型，支持插件扩展。提供可定制的对话式 AI 基础设施，可作为 OpenClaw 的开源替代方案，适合个人开发者和团队构建智能聊天机器人与自动化服务。
summary.en: AstrBot is an open-source AI Agent framework integrating mainstream IM platforms with multiple LLMs. It offers customizable conversational AI infrastructure with plugin support, serving as an open-source alternative to OpenClaw for developers building intelligent chatbots and automation services.

metadata.name: MCP-SuperAssistant
metadata.description: Brings MCP to ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Grok, Gemini, Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, T3 Chat and more...

summary.zh: MCP SuperAssistant 是一款浏览器扩展，将 Model Context Protocol 工具无缝集成到 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Grok 等主流 AI 平台。用户可在任意 AI 助手界面直接调用 MCP 工具，大幅扩展 AI 能力边界。支持 Chrome 和 Firefox 双平台，覆盖 12+ AI 服务。
summary.en: MCP SuperAssistant is a browser extension that integrates Model Context Protocol tools into major AI platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok. Users can execute MCP tools directly within any AI assistant interface, significantly expanding AI capabilities. Supports both Chrome and Firefox across 12+ AI services.

metadata.name: AI-Search-Hub
metadata.description: One Query. All Search Skill. 聚合 Gemini、Grok、豆包、元宝等平台原生 AI 搜索能力，免费获取科技趋势、行业舆情、热点追踪、旅行规划、日常问题统一接进自己的 Agent 与工作流，指定链接免费爬取

summary.zh: AI Search Hub 是一个开源 Skill，聚合 Gemini、Grok、豆包、元宝等平台原生 AI 搜索能力，实现一次提问全域搜索。支持免费爬取微信公众号、抖音、微博、B站等平台数据，通过大厂 AI 平台完成搜集、清洗、整理，统一接入 OpenClaw Agent 与工作流。无需维护爬虫和浏览器自动化，直接借力大厂成熟搜索与网页抽取能力。
summary.en: AI Search Hub is an open-source Skill that aggregates native AI search capabilities from Gemini, Grok, Doubao, Yuanbao and other platforms, enabling one-query cross-platform search. It supports free crawling of WeChat Official Accounts, Douyin, Weibo, and Bilibili data. Leveraging big tech AI platforms for collection, cleaning, and structuring, it integrates directly into OpenClaw agents and workflows—eliminating the need to maintain crawlers or browser automation.

metadata.name: claude-context
metadata.description: Code search MCP for Claude Code. Make entire codebase the context for any coding agent.

summary.zh: Claude Context 是 Zilliz 推出的 MCP 插件，为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码助手提供语义代码搜索能力。通过向量数据库存储代码库语义索引，让 AI 直接获取整个代码库的相关上下文，无需多轮探索即可定位目标代码。显著降低大代码库场景下的 Token 消耗成本。
summary.en: Claude Context is an MCP plugin by Zilliz that adds semantic code search to Claude Code and AI coding agents. It indexes your entire codebase in a vector database, enabling AI to retrieve relevant context directly without multi-round discovery. Significantly reduces token costs for large codebases.

metadata.name: recall
metadata.description: Full-text search and resume for Claude/Codex conversations

summary.zh: recall 是 Claude/Codex 对话的全文本搜索和恢复工具，支持跨平台安装。通过 TUI 界面可快速搜索历史对话、恢复中断的工作流，并支持让 AI agent 主动调用搜索功能。兼容 Codex、OpenCode、Factory 等多款 AI 编程助手。
summary.en: recall is a full-text search and resume tool for Claude/Codex conversations with cross-platform support. It provides a TUI interface for searching conversation history and resuming workflows, with AI agent integration. Compatible with Codex, OpenCode, and Factory.

metadata.name: AITextDetector
metadata.description: Using SVM to classify human/AI-generated creative writing text

summary.zh: 基于SVM算法的AI生成文本检测工具，专门针对中文创意写作场景训练。用户可在线体验实时检测功能，适用于教育防作弊、内容审核等场景。模型核心代码由作者编写，其余由AI辅助生成，提供完整的训练脚本供研究复现。
summary.en: An SVM-based AI text detector trained specifically on Chinese creative writing. Offers an online demo for real-time detection, suitable for academic integrity monitoring and content moderation. Provides complete training scripts for research reproducibility.

metadata.name: IPQuality
metadata.description: IP质量检测脚本 - IP Quality Check Script

summary.zh: 跨平台IP质量检测脚本，支持IPv4/IPv6双栈检测。整合Maxmind、IPinfo、AbuseIPDB等8家权威数据源进行风险评估，覆盖400+IP黑名单数据库。提供流媒体平台（TikTok/Netflix/Disney+等）解锁状态及多邮件服务商连通性检测。支持Docker部署，中英文双语界面，输出支持ANSI终端样式、JSON及纯文本，适用于网络环境评估与IP信誉查询。
summary.en: Cross-platform IP quality assessment script with dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 detection. Integrates 8 authoritative data sources including Maxmind, IPinfo, and AbuseIPDB for comprehensive risk evaluation across 400+ blacklist databases. Provides streaming platform unlock detection (TikTok/Netflix/Disney+) and multi-email service connectivity testing. Supports Docker deployment with bilingual interface and multiple output formats (ANSI/JSON/Text).

metadata.name: dae
metadata.description: eBPF-based Linux high-performance transparent proxy solution.

summary.zh: dae 是基于 eBPF 的 Linux 高性能透明代理方案，通过内核级流量分流实现真正的直连传输，性能损耗极低。作为 v2rayA 的继任者，支持按进程名、MAC 地址分流，具备自动节点测速切换、高级 DNS 解析及全锥型 NAT 等特性，覆盖主流代理协议。
summary.en: dae is an eBPF-based Linux high-performance transparent proxy solution that achieves true direct traffic bypass through kernel-level traffic splitting with minimal performance loss. As a successor to v2rayA, it supports process/MAC-based routing, automatic node switching, advanced DNS resolution, and full-cone NAT across various proxy protocols.

metadata.name: cc-switch
metadata.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io

summary.zh: 一款基于 Tauri 2 的跨平台桌面应用，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等多款 AI 编程助手，支持 API Key 配置、代理服务和会话管理，提升开发者使用多个 AI 编码工具的效率。
summary.en: A cross-platform desktop app built with Tauri 2 that serves as a unified manager for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other AI coding agents, featuring API key management, proxy support and session coordination.

metadata.name: impeccable
metadata.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.

summary.zh: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 助手的专业前端设计技能系统，包含 7 个领域参考文件（排版、色彩、动效、空间、交互、响应式、UX 文案）和 23 个设计命令。通过 27 条确定性反模式规则和 LLM 评审机制，帮助 AI 在代码生成中避免同质化模板，提供更专业、差异化的设计方案。支持 CLI 和浏览器插件，可在不调用 API 的情况下运行基础检测。
summary.en: Impeccable is a professional frontend design skill system for AI assistants, featuring 7 domain references covering typography, color, motion, spatial design, interaction, responsive design, and UX writing, along with 23 design commands. It runs 27 deterministic anti-pattern rules plus LLM critique to prevent AI-generated code from falling into common design clichés. Supports CLI and browser extension with no-API-key detection.

metadata.name: banana-slides
metadata.description: 一个基于nano banana pro🍌的原生AI PPT生成应用，迈向真正的＂Vibe PPT＂; 支持上传任意模板图片；上传任意素材&智能解析；一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT；口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana pro🍌

summary.zh: 基于nano banana pro模型的原生AI PPT生成工具，支持一句话、大纲、页面描述三种方式快速创建演示文稿。内置模板上传和素材智能解析功能，允许用户通过自然语言口头修改指定页面区域，一键导出可编辑PPT。适用于教育、职场、汇报等多场景，降低PPT制作门槛。
summary.en: An AI-native slides generator leveraging the nano banana pro model to create presentations from ideas, outlines, or page descriptions. Offers custom template uploads, intelligent material parsing, and natural language editing for specific sections. Exports fully editable PPT files, serving education, business, and reporting scenarios with streamlined workflow.

metadata.name: mise
metadata.description: dev tools, env vars, task runner

summary.zh: mise-en-place 是一个开发环境管理工具，通过统一的 mise.toml 文件集中管理项目工具版本、环境变量和任务脚本。它支持 node、python、terraform 等数百种开发工具的安装与版本切换，并能在不同 shell 和 CI 环境中保持一致的开发环境。Rust 编写，高性能。
summary.en: mise-en-place is a development environment manager that centralizes tool versions, environment variables, and task scripts in a single mise.toml file. It supports installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools while ensuring consistent environments across shells and CI systems. Built in Rust for performance.

metadata.name: ClawRouter
metadata.description: The agent-native LLM router for OpenClaw. 41+ models, <1ms routing, USDC payments on Base & Solana via x402.

summary.zh: 专为自主AI智能体设计的开源LLM智能路由器。支持55+模型（OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek等），通过15维度评分自动选择最优模型，路由延迟<1ms。核心突破：使用钱包签名替代API Key认证、通过x402协议实现USDC微支付，智能体无需注册账号或绑定信用卡即可独立运行。可降低AI API成本达92%，支持Base和Solana链的USDC结算。
summary.en: An open-source smart LLM router purpose-built for autonomous AI agents. Routes requests to 55+ models (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, etc.) in under 1ms using 15-dimension scoring. Key innovation: wallet signature authentication eliminates API keys, while x402 protocol enables USDC micropayments—no accounts, no credit cards. Reduces AI costs up to 92%. Supports Base and Solana with USDC settlement.

metadata.name: neo
metadata.description: Turn any web app into an API. Chrome extension captures browser traffic, auto-generates schemas, lets AI replay APIs directly. No official API needed.

summary.zh: Neo是一个Chrome扩展，通过被动拦截浏览器fetch/XMLHttpRequest流量，将任意网页应用转换为可编程API。自动学习API模式并生成schema，支持通过Chrome DevTools Protocol直接重放调用。v2版本新增基于a11y树的UI自动化层，一个工具覆盖API和UI两层操作。
summary.en: Neo is a Chrome extension that passively intercepts browser API traffic, turning any web app into a programmable API. It auto-learns patterns, generates schemas, and lets you replay calls via Chrome DevTools Protocol. v2 adds a11y-tree-based UI automation — one tool handles both API and UI layers.

metadata.name: http-relay
metadata.description: A lightweight HTTP relay that forwards /{absolute-url} requests with optional proxy and traffic dump.

summary.zh: 轻量级 HTTP 中继工具，通过本地 `/https://target-url` 路径格式转发请求到目标地址。支持正向代理和反向代理两种模式，可选流量转储、Header 重写及认证信息脱敏。Go 语言实现，提供 Docker 部署，适合 API 调试、跨域代理及开发环境流量监控。
summary.en: A lightweight HTTP relay tool that forwards requests via local `/https://target-url` path format to target addresses. Supports forward and reverse proxy modes with optional traffic dumping, header rewriting, and auth masking. Built with Go, deployable via Docker, ideal for API debugging, cross-domain proxying, and traffic monitoring.

metadata.name: QwenPaw
metadata.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.

summary.zh: QwenPaw是由agentscope-ai开发的开源个人AI助手，支持本地或云端一键部署，数据完全由用户掌控。内置调度、PDF/Office处理、新闻摘要等实用技能，支持多聊天渠道接入和多智能体协作，可通过自定义技能无限扩展功能。
summary.en: QwenPaw is an open-source personal AI assistant by agentscope-ai, supporting one-click local or cloud deployment with full data control. It offers built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office processing, and news digest, with multi-channel chat integration and multi-agent collaboration. Custom skills can be auto-loaded for unlimited extensibility.

metadata.name: tart
metadata.description: macOS and Linux VMs on Apple Silicon to use in CI and other automations
