summary.zh: Tart 是基于 Apple 原生 Virtualization.Framework 的虚拟化工具，可在 Apple Silicon 上运行 macOS 和 Linux 虚拟机。提供近乎原生的性能，支持从 OCI 容器镜像仓库推送/拉取 VM，并可通过 Packer Plugin 自动化创建。专为 CI 场景设计，已被 Atlassian、Figma、Expo 等企业用于自动化测试和开发环境。
summary.en: Tart is a virtualization toolkit for running macOS and Linux VMs on Apple Silicon using Apple's native Virtualization.Framework for near-native performance. It supports push/pull VMs from OCI-compatible registries and includes a Packer Plugin for automated VM creation. Built by CI engineers, it integrates seamlessly with CI systems and is used by companies like Atlassian, Figma, and Expo.

metadata.name: frontend-slides
metadata.description: Create beautiful slides on the web using Claude's frontend skills

summary.zh: Frontend Slides 是一款基于 Claude Code 的网页演示文稿创建工具，支持从零创建或转换 PPT 文件。它采用"先展示后选择"的可视化流程，让非设计师也能生成精美的 HTML 演示。核心亮点包括零依赖（单文件内联）、多种精选防 AI 俗套风格、PPT 内容自动提取重建，以及生产级可访问性和响应式设计。
summary.en: Frontend Slides is a Claude Code skill that creates stunning web presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. It uses a visual discovery approach where users pick from generated style previews instead of describing preferences. Key features include zero dependencies (single HTML with inline CSS/JS), anti-AI-slop curated styles, PPT-to-HTML conversion, and production-ready accessible code.

metadata.name: humanize
metadata.description: From Automated Idea Factory to Realization

summary.zh: Humanize 是基于 Claude Code 的 AI 开发插件，通过 RLCR（代码审查强化学习）工作流实现迭代式开发。Claude 负责实现，Codex 独立审查，形成持续反馈循环。支持从想法到实现的完整流程，包括创意生成、计划制定、计划优化和循环执行，并可集成 Gemini 进行深度网络研究。
summary.en: Humanize is a Claude Code plugin enabling iterative development through RLCR (Reinforcement Learning with Code Review) workflow. Claude implements while Codex independently reviews, creating continuous feedback loops. It supports the full journey from idea to implementation, including generation, planning, refinement, and loop execution, with optional Gemini integration for web research.

metadata.name: pure
metadata.description: Pretty, minimal and fast ZSH prompt

summary.zh: Pure 是一款极简、快速、美观的 ZSH 提示符主题，解决传统提示符杂乱缓慢的痛点。核心功能包括：Git 分支状态显示与异步检查、命令执行耗时提示、错误状态红色警示、SSH/容器环境识别、终端标题栏动态更新及 VI 模式指示。支持 npm、Homebrew 多方式安装，是 ZSH 用户提升终端体验的首选。
summary.en: Pure is a pretty, minimal and fast ZSH prompt that solves the clutter and slowness of traditional prompts. Key features include async git branch status checking, command execution time display, error state indication in red, SSH/container detection, dynamic terminal title updates, and VI-mode indication. Supports npm and Homebrew installation for easy setup.

metadata.name: zerobrew
metadata.description: A 5-20x faster experimental Homebrew alternative

summary.zh: zerobrew是一个实验性Homebrew替代工具，通过内容寻址存储和APFS clonefiles技术实现5-20倍性能提升。它复用Homebrew的formula定义和预编译bottles，保持生态兼容性。支持macOS和Linux，提供install/uninstall/bundle等命令，建议与Homebrew共存使用。
summary.en: zerobrew is an experimental Homebrew alternative bringing uv-style architecture to package management. It achieves 5-20x speedup via content-addressable storage and APFS clonefiles while reusing Homebrew's formula definitions and bottles for ecosystem compatibility. Supports macOS and Linux with install/uninstall/bundle commands.

metadata.name: Feather
metadata.description: Free on-device iOS/iPadOS application manager/installer, using certificates part of the Apple Developer Program.

summary.zh: Feather是一款免费的iOS/iPadOS设备端应用安装管理器，通过Apple开发者证书对应用进行签名实现侧载。支持AltStore仓库，提供可配置的签名选项，可查看应用和证书详情。内置Ellekit tweak注入功能，支持.deb和.dylib文件注入，开源无追踪。
summary.en: Feather is a free on-device iOS/iPadOS application manager that signs and installs apps using Apple Developer Program certificates. It supports AltStore repositories, configurable signing options, and tweak injection via Ellekit for .deb and .dylib files. Open source with no tracking.

metadata.name: GalIsland
metadata.description: 本地galgame可视化管理

summary.zh: GalIsland是一款专为galgame玩家设计的本地游戏库可视化管理工具。基于Python/Qt开发，集成VNDB数据库自动获取游戏信息、封面和评分，通过ggbases获取中文标签，并利用DeepSeek AI翻译游戏简介。支持自定义分类、截图管理和转区运行功能，提供游戏存档地址一键直达，是galgame玩家整理和管理本地游戏收藏的实用桌面应用。
summary.en: GalIsland is a visual management tool for galgame enthusiasts to organize their local game library. Built with Python/Qt, it integrates VNDB for game metadata, ggbases for Chinese tags, and DeepSeek AI for translation. Features include custom categorization, screenshot management, region switching via LE, and Magpie upscaling. A practical desktop app for galgame collectors seeking streamlined library management.

metadata.name: styles
metadata.description: Official repository for Citation Style Language (CSL) citation styles.

summary.zh: CSL引用样式官方仓库，通过XML格式自动化学术文献的引用和参考文献格式化。该仓库被数十个第三方软件产品使用，由社区贡献并经过严格质量审核，为学术写作和出版提供标准化引用解决方案。
summary.en: Official repository for Citation Style Language (CSL) citation styles that automate formatting of citations and bibliographies using XML-based schemas. Trusted by dozens of third-party applications, it provides crowd-sourced, curated styles for scholarly communication.

metadata.name: PiliPlus
metadata.description: PiliPlus

summary.zh: 基于 Flutter 构建的跨平台 B 站第三方客户端，兼容 Android/iOS/Windows/Linux/Pad 全端。支持弹幕、离线缓存、DLNA 投屏、AI 原声翻译、超分辨率、会员弹幕等进阶功能，提供完整的推荐、搜索、动态、评论与私信体验，是 B 站用户的轻量替代方案。
summary.en: A cross-platform Bilibili third-party client built with Flutter, supporting Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, and Pad. It features advanced capabilities like danmaku, offline caching, DLNA casting, AI translation, super resolution, and VIP-colored danmaku, offering a comprehensive alternative for daily Bilibili usage.

metadata.name: gemini-voyager
metadata.description: An all-in-one enhancement suite for Google Gemini & AI Studio - timeline navigation, folder management, prompt library, and chat export in one powerful extension. / Google Gemini & AI Studio 全能增强插件：集成时间轴导航、文件夹管理、提示词库及聊天导出等众多功能。

summary.zh: Gemini Voyager 是一款专为 Google Gemini 和 AI Studio 打造的全能浏览器扩展插件，集成时间轴导航、文件夹管理、提示词库及聊天导出等核心功能，显著提升 AI 对话体验与效率。支持 Chrome、Edge、Firefox、Safari 等六大主流浏览器。
summary.en: Gemini Voyager is an all-in-one browser extension enhancing Google Gemini & AI Studio with timeline navigation, folder management, prompt library, and chat export features. It boosts AI conversation efficiency and supports six major browsers including Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari.

metadata.name: openchamber
metadata.description: Desktop and web interface for OpenCode AI agent

summary.zh: OpenChamber 是 OpenCode AI 编程助手的跨平台桌面与网页客户端，支持桌面端、浏览器和移动端访问。提供代码差异审查、智能体管理、开发服务器运行等核心功能，通过图形化界面提升 AI 编程协作体验，并支持 VS Code 扩展集成与深浅色主题切换。
summary.en: OpenChamber is a cross-platform desktop and web interface for OpenCode AI coding agent, supporting desktop, browser, and mobile access. It provides diff review, agent management, and dev server execution capabilities, enhancing AI-powered coding collaboration through a rich GUI with VS Code extension integration and theme support.

metadata.name: TS3AudioBot-CloudMusic-plugin
metadata.description: Teamspeak 3 流媒体音乐插件

summary.zh: 这是一个Teamspeak 3音频机器人的音乐插件，支持网易云音乐和QQ音乐两大平台。提供完整的播放控制命令，包括歌单播放、专辑播放、歌曲搜索及四种播放模式。插件支持二维码、验证码、Cookie等多种登录认证方式，并可通过配置文件自定义API服务器、自动暂停等参数，适合语音聊天群组共享音乐。
summary.en: A music streaming plugin for Teamspeak 3 Audio Bot supporting Netease Cloud Music and QQ Music. Features comprehensive playback controls including playlist/album/song playback with four play modes. Supports multiple authentication methods (QR code, SMS, Cookie) and configurable settings like API server and auto-pause, ideal for sharing music in voice chat groups.

metadata.name: awesome-nanobanana-pro
metadata.description: 🚀 An awesome list of curated Nano Banana pro prompts and examples. Your go-to resource for mastering prompt engineering and exploring the creative potential of the Nano banana pro(Nano banana 2) AI image model.

summary.zh: 这是一个专注于 Nano Banana Pro/Nano Banana 2 AI 图像模型的精选提示词库，汇集了来自 Twitter、微信、Replicate 等平台的高质量提示词。涵盖超写实人像、创意实验、电商虚拟场景、室内设计等多个应用场景，帮助用户充分发挥该 AI 模型的图像生成潜力。
summary.en: A curated collection of high-quality prompts for the Nano Banana Pro AI image model, sourced from social platforms and expert prompt engineers. Covers photorealistic portraits, creative experiments, e-commerce visuals, and interior design use cases, enabling users to maximize the model's image generation capabilities.

metadata.name: opencode
metadata.description: The open source coding agent.

summary.zh: OpenCode是一个开源AI编码助手，同时提供终端界面和桌面应用。它具备智能代码补全、任务自动化和多语言支持功能，可通过npm、brew、scoop等多种包管理器安装。跨平台支持macOS、Windows和Linux系统，旨在帮助开发者提升编程效率和自动化开发流程。
summary.en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent offering both terminal and desktop interfaces. It provides intelligent code completion, task automation, and multilingual support with flexible installation via npm, brew, scoop, and more. Cross-platform compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux, designed to enhance developer productivity and streamline development workflows.

metadata.name: fresh
metadata.description: Terminal based IDE & text editor: easy, powerful and fast

summary.zh: Fresh 是一款现代化的终端文本编辑器，实现 VS Code/Sublime 级别的 IDE 功能却无需任何配置。具备命令面板、多光标编辑、LSP 语言服务、TypeScript 插件系统等高级特性，零学习曲线。支持大文件高速处理，多平台安装即用。
summary.en: Fresh is a modern terminal text editor bringing IDE-level features from VS Code and Sublime Text to the command line with zero configuration. Features include command palette, multi-cursor editing, LSP support, and TypeScript plugin system. Handles multi-gigabyte files with low latency.

metadata.name: witr
metadata.description: Why is this running?

summary.zh: witr 是一个进程因果追踪工具，解答「为什么这个进程在运行」。它能追溯进程的来源、启动方式和背后的系统链路（如 systemd、容器、shell 等），支持交互式 TUI 界面和跨平台单二进制部署，适用于系统调试、运维排查等场景。
summary.en: witr is a process causality tracing tool that answers why a process is running by tracing its origin, launch method, and underlying system chain (systemd, containers, shells, etc.). It features an interactive TUI and cross-platform single-binary deployment for system debugging and operations troubleshooting.

metadata.name: hypermind
metadata.description: The High-Availability Solution to a Problem That Doesn't Exist.

summary.zh: Hypermind 是一个完全去中心化的 P2P 节点计数器与临时聊天平台。基于 Hyperswarm DHT 构建，通过分布式 LRU 缓存实现实时在线节点统计，采用 HyperLogLog 概率算法估算历史唯一节点数。提供本地/全局聊天、粒子地图可视化及多主题切换功能，无中心服务器与数据库依赖。
summary.en: Hypermind is a completely decentralized P2P deployment counter and ephemeral chat platform. Built on Hyperswarm DHT, it uses distributed LRU cache for real-time peer counting and HyperLogLog for probabilistic unique peer estimation. Features include local/global chat modes, particle map visualization, and multiple theme options with no central server or database required.

metadata.name: typora-theme-alto
metadata.description: Alto - Typora Theme  - Encounter more elegant thinking.

summary.zh: Alto 是一款 Typora 编辑器界面增强主题，通过 CSS 样式重构 Typora 界面，实现更简洁、美观、灵动的写作体验。它以叠加层形式配合 Lapis、Spring 等母主题使用，提供蓝色、绿色等多组推荐配色，支持亮色与暗色模式，推荐在一体化窗口样式下使用。
summary.en: Alto is a Typora interface enhancement theme that redesigns the editor's UI through CSS to create a cleaner, more elegant, and dynamic writing experience. It works as an overlay on base themes like Lapis and Spring, offering multiple color schemes including blue and green, with support for light and dark modes.

metadata.name: ServerPackCreator
metadata.description: Create a server pack from a Minecraft Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, LegacyFabric or Quilt modpack!

summary.zh: Minecraft modpack 服务器包创建工具，支持 Forge、NeoForge、Fabric、LegacyFabric、Quilt 等多种 mod 加载器，可自动化生成服务器端 mod 包，简化多人游戏服务器的部署与分发流程。
summary.en: A Minecraft modpack server pack creator supporting Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, LegacyFabric, and Quilt loaders. Automates server-side mod package generation, streamlining multiplayer game server deployment and distribution.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-Workers-Proxy
metadata.description: 简单而功能强大的反代服务，允许你将一个网址映射到另一个网址，并处理跨域请求

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级反向代理服务，可将客户端请求转发至目标地址并返回响应。支持路径转换、CORS 跨域请求与重定向处理，提供 Web 界面输入目标 URL，适合需要绕过浏览器同源策略或快速部署代理服务的开发者。
summary.en: A lightweight reverse proxy built on Cloudflare Workers that forwards client requests to target URLs and returns responses. It handles path transformation, CORS headers, and redirects. With a web interface for URL input, it's ideal for developers needing to bypass same-origin restrictions or quickly deploy proxy services.

metadata.name: misskey
metadata.description: 🌎 A completely free and open interplanetary-microblogging platform 🚀

summary.zh: Misskey是一个完全免费开源的联邦社交媒体平台，支持去中心化微博客服务。采用ActivityPub协议与其他Fediverse平台互通，用户可自建实例或加入现有服务器。支持Docker部署、多语言界面，具备时间线、投票、频道等丰富功能，是主流社交平台的开源自托管替代方案。
summary.en: Misskey is a fully open-source, federated social media platform enabling decentralized microblogging. Built on ActivityPub protocol, it interoperates with other Fediverse platforms, allowing users to create instances or join existing servers. Supports Docker deployment, multilingual interfaces, with rich features like timelines, polls, and channels—offering a self-hostable alternative to mainstream social networks.

metadata.name: Mole
metadata.description: 🐹 Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

summary.zh: Mole是一款macOS系统深度清理与优化工具，整合CleanMyMac、AppCleaner、DaisyDisk和iStat Menus的核心功能于单一二进制文件。支持清理缓存、日志、浏览器残留和孤立数据，智能卸载应用及隐藏残留，磁盘可视化分析，实时监控系统CPU/GPU/内存/磁盘/网络状态。提供安全优先的设计，CLI免费开源。
summary.en: Mole is a macOS system maintenance toolkit combining CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus into a single binary. It offers deep cleaning for caches, logs, and orphaned data, smart app uninstallation with hidden remnants, disk visualization, and real-time monitoring of CPU/GPU/memory/disk/network. Security-first design with free CLI.

metadata.name: ebooks
metadata.description: 收藏的一些经典的历史、政治、心理、哲学、数学、计算机方面电子书(约10万本）

summary.zh: 一个规模庞大的开源电子书库，收藏约10万本经典书籍，涵盖历史、政治、心理、哲学、数学、计算机科学等领域。以PDF格式为主，通过Google Drive分发，并配有作者自建的WebApp搜索界面，方便用户快速检索和下载所需资源。
summary.en: A massive open-source ebook library with approximately 100,000 classic books spanning history, politics, psychology, philosophy, mathematics, and computer science. Books are primarily PDF format distributed via Google Drive, accompanied by a custom-built web search interface for quick discovery and download.

metadata.name: Burner-X
metadata.description: Burner X - 浏览器即开即用，AI文献识别、文档批量翻译、阅读与智能分析工具 丨BYOK

summary.zh: Paper Burner X 是一款开源的浏览器端 AI 文献工作站，支持 PDF/DOCX/EPUB 等多格式文档的 OCR 识别、批量翻译与智能分析。采用前端 Agentic RAG 系统，赋予 AI 全局文章结构认知和工具调用能力，实现多步推理与复杂信息提取。具备并发翻译引擎、术语库快速匹配、段落级原译文对照等功能，保留公式图表格式，数据完全本地化存储。
summary.en: Paper Burner X is an open-source browser-based AI workstation for researchers, featuring OCR, batch translation, and intelligent document analysis. It implements a frontend Agentic RAG system with global document structure awareness, enabling multi-step reasoning and complex information extraction. With concurrent translation, terminology matching, and paragraph-level bilingual reading, it preserves formulas and formatting while keeping all data locally stored.

metadata.name: gopl-zh.github.com
metadata.description: :books: Go语言圣经中文版 🇨🇳

summary.zh: 《The Go Programming Language》经典教材的中文翻译项目，由柴树杉等人协作完成。涵盖Go语言基础语法、标准库、并发编程等核心内容，提供在线阅读。适合作为系统学习Go语言的入门教程，采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0协议开源。
summary.en: The Chinese translation of the classic Go programming book 'The Go Programming Language', collaboratively maintained by multiple translators. Covers fundamental syntax, standard library, and concurrent programming. Provides online reading access and serves as a comprehensive tutorial for learning Go.

metadata.name: karakeep
metadata.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search

summary.zh: Karakeep是一款自托管的"收藏一切"应用，支持保存链接、笔记、图片和PDF文档。通过AI实现自动标签和摘要生成，提供全文搜索、浏览器插件和移动端应用，支持本地模型部署。适合个人知识管理、信息归档和团队协作。
summary.en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark-everything app for saving links, notes, images and PDFs. It features AI-powered automatic tagging, summarization, full-text search, browser extensions and mobile apps with local model support. Ideal for personal knowledge management and information archiving.

metadata.name: Nota
metadata.description: A Fast, Modern, Feature Rich and Lightweight Note taking desktop application made with native AI integration

summary.zh: Nota是一款基于Tauri v2 + Svelte 5构建的轻量级笔记应用，采用Rust后端确保极致性能。内置自定义富文本编辑器Edra，支持斜杠命令、Markdown快捷方式、数学公式等丰富功能。创新采用BYOK模式集成AI能力，用户可绑定自有AI密钥，告别订阅费用枷锁。安装包仅约16MB，跨平台支持macOS/Windows/Linux及Web端。
summary.en: Nota is a lightweight note-taking app built with Tauri v2 and Svelte 5, featuring a custom rich text editor called Edra with slash commands, Markdown shortcuts, and math equations. It integrates AI capabilities via a Bring Your Own Key model, eliminating subscription costs. At ~16MB, it offers cross-platform support for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web with a modern dark/light UI.

metadata.name: surf
metadata.description: Personal AI Notebooks. Organize files & webpages and generate notes from them. Open source, local & open data, open model choice (incl. local).

summary.zh: Deta Surf 是一款本地优先的 AI 笔记本应用，支持存储和组织本地文件、网页、PDF、YouTube 等多媒体内容。通过 @提及 语法和 AI 能力自动生成笔记、进行网络搜索、创建交互式应用。数据以开放格式本地存储，支持自定义 AI 模型选择，跨平台运行。
summary.en: Deta Surf is a local-first AI notebook that organizes files, webpages, PDFs, YouTube videos and more into notebooks. Features @-mentions for auto-generating notes, web search, citations, and Surflets for code-free interactive app creation. Data stored locally in open formats with flexible AI model support across MacOS, Windows & Linux.

metadata.name: TrendRadar
metadata.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。

summary.zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控与热点追踪工具，聚合多平台内容与 RSS 订阅源，支持关键词精准筛选。集成 AI 智能筛选、翻译与简报生成功能，通过 MCP 架构实现自然语言对话分析与情感洞察。支持微信、飞书、钉钉、Telegram 等多渠道推送，30 秒即可 Docker 部署，数据本地或云端自持。
summary.en: TrendRadar is an AI-driven public opinion monitor and trend tracker that aggregates multi-platform content and RSS feeds with keyword filtering. It features AI-powered news screening, translation, and briefing generation, plus MCP integration for natural language analysis and sentiment insights. Supports multi-channel notifications via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram and more, with 30-second Docker deployment and local/cloud data storage.

metadata.name: hexo-shiki-plugin
metadata.description: A code highlight plugin,use shiki for better highlight,built for hexo!

summary.zh: 基于 Shiki 的 Hexo 博客代码高亮插件，支持 one-dark-pro、github-light 等多种主题，提供行号显示、代码复制按钮、美化工具栏、颜色化括号等丰富功能。采用 TypeScript + Vite 构建，支持自定义 CSS 样式配置，可替代 Hexo 原生高亮方案，显著提升技术博客代码块的视觉呈现效果。
summary.en: A code syntax highlighting plugin for Hexo blogs powered by Shiki engine. Features include multiple built-in themes, line numbers, copy buttons, beautify toolbar, and colorized brackets. Built with TypeScript and Vite, offering flexible CSS customization to enhance code block aesthetics in technical blogs.

metadata.name: hugo-theme-next
metadata.description: Easily & powerful theme for Hugo engine.

summary.zh: Hugo NexT 是从 Hexo 引擎移植的高质量优雅主题，完美兼容 Hexo NexT 的所有页面布局与配置。它提供 Muse、Mist、Pisces、Gemini 四种视觉方案，支持从 Hexo 无缝迁移到 Hugo，配备实时预览与快速启动脚本，适合技术博主搭建现代化静态博客网站。
summary.en: Hugo NexT is a high-quality elegant theme ported from Hexo's NexT, fully compatible with its page layouts and configurations. It offers four visual schemes (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini) and enables seamless migration from Hexo to Hugo. With live preview and quick-start scripts, it's ideal for tech bloggers to build modern static websites.

metadata.name: hugo-theme-luna
metadata.description: A simple, performance-first, SEO-friendly Hugo theme / 一个轻量，快速，SEO 友好的 Hugo 主题

summary.zh: Luna 是一款基于 Hugo 和 TailwindCSS 构建的高性能静态博客主题，支持暗色模式、PWA、多语言及 LaTeX 数学公式渲染。采用 swup.js 实现无刷新导航，flexsearch 提供本地搜索能力，内置多种实用 Shortcodes，适合搭建快速、SEO 友好的个人博客或技术文档站点。
summary.en: Luna is a performance-first Hugo theme built with TailwindCSS, featuring dark mode, PWA support, multilingual capabilities, and LaTeX rendering via KaTeX. It leverages swup.js for smooth page transitions and flexsearch for local search, making it ideal for building fast, SEO-friendly personal blogs or technical documentation sites.

metadata.name: wechat-selkies
metadata.description: 基于Selkies的Linux网页版微信/QQ/Telegram，支持本地中文输入法，支持三方应用，支持AMD64和ARM64。

summary.zh: 基于Docker和Selkies WebRTC技术，将微信/QQ客户端封装为浏览器可访问的网页应用。无需本地安装客户端，支持中文输入法和文件传输，可部署于服务器实现远程办公。兼容AMD64/ARM64架构，提供硬件加速和数据持久化功能。
summary.en: A Docker-based WeChat/QQ client using Selkies WebRTC for browser access. No local installation required, supports Chinese input methods, file transfer, and hardware acceleration. Compatible with AMD64/ARM64 architectures, ideal for server deployment and remote work scenarios.

metadata.name: claude-relay-service
metadata.description: CRS-自建Claude Code镜像，一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Droid 订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

summary.zh: 自建Claude API中转服务，支持Claude、OpenAI、Gemini等多平台统一接入。采用Node.js+Redis架构，提供多账户轮换、拼车共享、成本透明化等核心功能。内置Web管理面板和详细使用统计，支持HTTP/SOCKS5代理，适合小团队或朋友间分摊Claude Max订阅费用，保护隐私的同时实现稳定访问。
summary.en: Self-hosted Claude API relay service supporting Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and Droid. Built with Node.js and Redis, it offers multi-account rotation, subscription sharing, and transparent cost tracking. Features a web admin panel, usage statistics, and proxy support. Ideal for teams or friends splitting Claude Max subscription costs while maintaining privacy.

metadata.name: xh
metadata.description: Friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests

summary.zh: xh是一个用Rust编写的命令行HTTP请求工具，兼容HTTPie设计理念但性能更优。支持JSON、表单、原始数据等多种请求方式，提供彩色格式化的输出。跨平台支持（Linux/macOS/Windows/Android），可通过多种包管理器或预编译二进制文件安装，适合API调试与Web开发。
summary.en: xh is a Rust-based CLI tool for sending HTTP requests, reimplementing HTTPie's design with a focus on performance. It supports JSON, form, and raw data requests with colorized output. Cross-platform compatible (Linux/macOS/Windows/Android), installable via package managers or pre-built binaries. Ideal for API testing and web development workflows.

metadata.name: NeteaseCloudMusicFlac
metadata.description: 根据网易云音乐的歌单, 下载flac无损音乐到本地. Download the FLAC music from Internet according to your NeteaseCloudMusic playlist.

summary.zh: 基于Python3的网络音乐下载工具，通过解析网易云音乐歌单URL，自动搜索并下载FLAC无损格式音乐。支持批量下载，可选MP3格式。解决Hi-Fi用户逐首查找专辑的繁琐流程，提升音乐获取效率。
summary.en: A Python-based music downloader that fetches FLAC lossless tracks by parsing Netease Cloud Music playlist URLs. It automatically searches and downloads high-quality audio files, solving the tedious process for Hi-Fi enthusiasts who previously had to locate albums individually. Supports batch downloads with optional MP3 format.

metadata.name: RsyncUI
metadata.description: A SwiftUI based macOS GUI for rsync.

summary.zh: RsyncUI 是 rsync 的 macOS 原生图形界面，采用 SwiftUI 构建。它简化了任务组织和参数配置，让用户无需命令行即可高效完成文件同步与备份。支持 Homebrew 安装，应用已通过 Apple 签名公证。
summary.en: RsyncUI is a native macOS GUI for rsync, built with SwiftUI. It simplifies task organization and parameter configuration, enabling efficient file synchronization and backup without touching the command line. Supports Homebrew installation with Apple-signed and notarized binaries.

metadata.name: nerdctl
metadata.description: contaiNERD CTL - Docker-compatible CLI for containerd, with support for Compose, Rootless, eStargz, OCIcrypt, IPFS, ...

summary.zh: nerdctl 是 containerd 的 Docker 兼容 CLI 工具，提供与 Docker 相同的命令行体验。支持 Docker Compose、rootless 无根运行、多种镜像懒加载技术（Stargz/Nydus/OverlayBD）、镜像加密（ocicrypt）和 P2P 分发（IPFS）。作为 containerd 非核心子项目，特别适合需要轻量级容器运行时、Kubernetes 调试及安全容器场景。
summary.en: nerdctl is a Docker-compatible CLI for containerd, providing identical command-line experience to Docker. It supports Docker Compose, rootless execution, lazy image pulling (Stargz/Nydus/OverlayBD), image encryption (ocicrypt), and P2P distribution (IPFS). As a non-core sub-project of containerd, it's ideal for lightweight container runtimes, Kubernetes debugging, and secure container scenarios.

metadata.name: immich
metadata.description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution.

summary.zh: 高性能自托管照片和视频管理方案，支持移动端自动备份、Web端管理及AI智能搜索（人脸识别、物体识别、CLIP）。具备去重、多用户相册、元数据查看、RAW格式支持、OAuth/API认证等功能，替代Google Photos的私有云选择。
summary.en: High-performance self-hosted photo and video management solution with mobile auto-backup, web interface, and AI-powered search (face recognition, object detection, CLIP). Features deduplication, multi-user albums, metadata viewing, RAW format support, OAuth/API authentication as a private cloud alternative to Google Photos.

metadata.name: Electorrent
metadata.description: A remote control client for µTorrent, qBittorrent, rTorrent, Transmission, Synology & Deluge

summary.zh: Electorrent是基于Electron的跨平台BT客户端远程控制工具，支持µTorrent、qBittorrent、rTorrent、Transmission等主流下载客户端。用户可通过桌面应用管理NAS、VPS、Seedbox上的种子任务，支持磁力链接处理、文件拖放、剪贴板粘贴、模糊搜索等功能，提供原生通知和自动更新。
summary.en: Electorrent is a cross-platform desktop application for remote controlling BitTorrent clients including µTorrent, qBittorrent, rTorrent, Transmission, Synology and Deluge. It enables users to manage torrent downloads on NAS, VPS, and seedboxes through magnet link handling, file drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, fuzzy search, and native notifications.

metadata.name: MCHPRS
metadata.description: A multithreaded Minecraft server built for redstone.

summary.zh: MCHPRS 是一款专为红石计算设计的高性能 Minecraft 创意服务器，采用 Rust 语言构建，每个 512x512 地块运行在独立线程上实现高并发低延迟。内置 Redpiler 红石编译器，支持 Velocity 代理和 LuckPerms 权限系统，适用于复杂红石程序运行与大规模红石项目开发。
summary.en: MCHPRS is a high-performance Minecraft creative server tailored for redstone computation, built in Rust with each 512x512 plot running on a separate thread for maximum concurrency. Features Redpiler compiler, Velocity proxy support, and LuckPerms integration, enabling complex redstone programs like running Minecraft on CPUs.

metadata.name: gpt4o-image-prompts
metadata.description: Nano Banana(nanobanana),GPT-5(GPT5),GPT-4o(GPT4o) Image Prompts，Nanobanana Prompts，nanobanana提示词

summary.zh: 这是一个高质量AI图像生成提示词精选库，支持GPT-4o/GPT-5/豆包等多模型，包含1000+精选案例，覆盖时尚摄影、产品广告、3D渲染、国风插画等多元风格。提供配套Web画廊展示、标签筛选搜索及结构化JSON数据集导出功能，方便开发者二次集成。持续更新维护，是AI图像创作的高效提示工程参考资源。
summary.en: A curated AI image generation prompt library supporting GPT-4o/GPT-5/Doubao models with 1000+精选cases. Features diverse styles including fashion photography, product ads, 3D rendering, and Chinese art. Includes a web gallery interface with tag filtering and a structured JSON dataset export. Continuously updated as a valuable prompt engineering resource for AI image creation.

metadata.name: oauth2-proxy
metadata.description: A reverse proxy that provides authentication with Google, Azure, OpenID Connect and many more identity providers.

summary.zh: OAuth2 Proxy 是一个用 Go 编写的开源反向代理，专注于为 Web 应用提供 OAuth2/OIDC 身份认证保护。它支持 Google、Azure、Microsoft Entra ID、GitHub 等多种身份提供商，可作为独立代理或中间件集成到现有基础设施中，并将用户详细信息（如用户名、组）作为 HTTP 头转发给上游应用。
summary.en: OAuth2 Proxy is an open-source reverse proxy written in Go that provides OAuth2/OIDC authentication for web applications. It supports providers like Google, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, and GitHub, functioning as either a standalone proxy or middleware. User details such as usernames and groups can be forwarded as HTTP headers to upstream applications.

metadata.name: Monocraft
metadata.description: A monospaced programming font inspired by the Minecraft typeface

summary.zh: 一款以 Minecraft 游戏界面字体为蓝本设计的等宽编程字体，包含 1500+ 字形。支持编程连字（ligatures）、Minecraft 附魔语言，并提供 Windows、Mac、Linux 及网页端安装方式，适合游戏迷开发者使用。
summary.en: A monospaced programming font inspired by Minecraft UI with 1500+ glyphs, featuring programming ligatures, Minecraft enchantment language support, and cross-platform installation for developers who love gaming aesthetics.

metadata.name: latex-online
metadata.description: Online latex compiler. You give it a link, it gives you PDF

summary.zh: LaTeX.Online是一个在线LaTeX编译器服务，可通过URL、Git仓库或直接提交文本内容生成PDF文档。支持REST API和命令行工具，提供Docker部署和独立部署方案。接收.tex源文件返回编译后的PDF或详细错误日志，适用于文档自动化构建与学术写作流程集成。
summary.en: LaTeX.Online is a web-based LaTeX compiler that converts TeX sources to PDF from URLs, Git repositories, or raw text input. It provides REST API and CLI tools with Docker deployment support, returning compiled PDFs or detailed error logs for automated document processing in academic and technical workflows.

metadata.name: nixos-config
metadata.description: General purpose Nix starter template for macOS or NixOS w/ step-by-step instructions

summary.zh: 跨平台 Nix 配置模板，同时支持 macOS 和 NixOS。采用 Nix Flakes 实现声明式包管理，集成 Home Manager、disko 磁盘管理、agenix 密钥管理等工具。提供详细分步安装指南，适合从零开始搭建可复现开发环境。
summary.en: A cross-platform Nix configuration template for macOS and NixOS using Nix Flakes. Integrates Home Manager, disko for declarative disk management, and agenix for secrets. Includes step-by-step instructions for bootstrapping reproducible development environments from scratch.

metadata.name: LKY_OfficeTools
metadata.description: 一键自动化 下载、安装、激活 Office 的利器。

summary.zh: LKY Office Tools 是一款 Windows 平台的一键自动化工具，可批量下载、安装 Microsoft Office 全套组件（Word、Excel、PPT、Outlook 等），并支持正版模式激活。工具自动识别系统架构，适配 x86/x64 环境，适用于 Windows 10(1703+) 系统。
summary.en: LKY Office Tools is a Windows automation utility for one-click download, installation, and activation of Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PPT, Outlook, etc.). It auto-detects system architecture (x86/x64) and supports Windows 10(1703+).

metadata.name: OsEasy-ToolBox
metadata.description: 噢易多媒体网络教室工具箱 | 简易的课堂学习辅助工具箱

summary.zh: 针对噢易多媒体网络教室学生端的课堂学习辅助工具箱，提供键鼠锁定解除、网络限制破解、远程控制拦截、进程挂起管理及外置屏幕广播配置等功能。需以管理员权限运行，专为V10.8.2.4411及V10.9.0.4881版本设计，仅供教育研究与技术学习使用。
summary.en: A classroom learning assistant tool for OsEasy multimedia network teaching environment, featuring keyboard/mouse lock removal, network restriction bypass, remote control interception, process suspension management, and external screen broadcast configuration. Requires admin privileges, designed for OsEasy Student Client V10.8.2.4411 and V10.9.0.4881. For educational research purposes only.

metadata.name: skm
metadata.description: A simple and powerful SSH keys manager

summary.zh: 简洁强大的SSH密钥管理器，支持通过别名管理多密钥、设置默认密钥、一键备份恢复、导入导出及远程部署。内置密钥审计、强度检测、缺失密码短语检查和环境诊断功能，提供模糊搜索交互界面，跨平台支持。
summary.en: A lightweight yet powerful SSH keys manager that enables alias-based multi-key management, default key switching, backup/restore, import/export, and remote deployment. Features built-in key auditing, strength detection, and environment diagnostics with a fuzzy-search prompt UI across platforms.

metadata.name: CookLikeHOC
metadata.description: 🥢像老乡鸡🐔那样做饭。已添加2026年发布的《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告 2.0中新出现的菜品。主要部分于2024年完工，非老乡鸡官方仓库。文字来自《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》，并做归纳、编辑与整理。CookLikeHOC.

summary.zh: 这个仓库整理了老乡鸡菜品溯源报告中的所有菜品食谱，包含食材来源与烹饪流程。支持Docker部署和网页端访问，还提供AI绘制的手绘图版本。社区可贡献实拍图，是学习连锁餐饮标准化烹饪与食材管理的开源参考资源。
summary.en: This repository documents recipes from Lao Xiang Ji's ingredient traceability report, covering sourcing info and cooking procedures for all dishes. It offers Docker deployment, web interface, and AI-generated illustrations. Community members can contribute real photos, serving as an open-source reference for standardized restaurant cooking and ingredient management.

metadata.name: TimeMachineStatus
metadata.description: TimeMachineStatus is a little menu bar application for macOS which aims to show more useful information than the system default.

summary.zh: TimeMachineStatus 是 macOS 菜单栏工具，弥补系统 Time Machine 默认界面信息不足的痛点。核心功能包括：实时显示备份状态、列出所有备份卷及详情、支持手动触发备份、自定义菜单栏图标。采用 Swift 开发，体积小巧，支持 Homebrew 安装和自动更新，适合需要频繁管理 Time Machine 的用户。
summary.en: TimeMachineStatus is a lightweight macOS menu bar utility that enhances Time Machine backup management beyond the default system interface. It displays real-time backup status, lists all backup destinations with details, supports manual backup triggers, and allows menu bar icon customization. Built with Swift, it supports Homebrew installation and auto-updates.

metadata.name: hurl
metadata.description: Hurl, run and test HTTP requests with plain text.

summary.zh: Hurl是一个命令行工具，使用纯文本格式定义和运行HTTP请求。支持链式请求、值捕获、XPath/JSONPath断言，可测试REST、SOAP、GraphQL等API及HTML内容。具备性能测试、响应验证和CI/CD集成能力，支持多种报告格式输出。由Rust编写的高性能工具。
summary.en: Hurl is a command-line tool that runs HTTP requests defined in plain text format. It supports request chaining, value capture, and assertions via XPath/JSONPath. Ideal for testing REST, SOAP, GraphQL APIs and HTML content with performance testing, response validation, and seamless CI/CD integration. Built with Rust.

metadata.name: claude-code-router
metadata.description: Use Claude Code as the foundation for coding infrastructure, allowing you to decide how to interact with the model while enjoying updates from Anthropic.

summary.zh: 基于 Claude Code 的模型路由工具，支持将请求动态分发至 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Ollama、Gemini 等多种模型提供商。提供请求/响应转换器、动态模型切换、CLI 模型管理及 GitHub Actions 集成功能，让开发者灵活选择交互模型并保持与 Anthropic 更新的同步。
summary.en: A model routing infrastructure built on Claude Code that dynamically routes requests to multiple providers like OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, and Gemini. Features include request/response transformers, dynamic model switching, CLI model management, and GitHub Actions integration, enabling developers to flexibly choose interaction models while staying updated with Anthropic.

metadata.name: NTrace-dev
metadata.description: NextTrace Dev

summary.zh: NextTrace 是一款开源的轻量级可视化路由追踪工具，采用 Go 语言开发。支持多平台（Linux/macOS/BSD/Windows）和多种架构，提供快速的网络路径诊断能力。通过可视化输出帮助用户直观了解网络数据包传输路径，适用于网络故障排查、延迟分析等场景。
summary.en: NextTrace is an open-source lightweight visual routing tool developed in Go. It supports multiple platforms and architectures, providing fast network path diagnostics through visual output. Users can intuitively understand data packet transmission paths, making it ideal for network troubleshooting and latency analysis.

summary.zh: MCP服务器桥接工具，通过wolframscript将Mathematica计算能力接入MCP生态。实现复杂符号计算、数学推导验证及LaTeX表达式生成，支持Cursor、Cline等AI编程助手调用本地Mathematica进行数学推理与验证。
summary.en: MCP server bridge enabling Mathematica computation via wolframscript for AI clients. Provides symbolic math, derivation verification, and LaTeX generation. Integrates with Cursor and Cline for AI-powered mathematical reasoning and validation through local Mathematica installation.

metadata.name: apple-emoji-ttf
metadata.description: Brings Apple's vibrant color emojis to Linux, Windows, and the Web

summary.zh: 将 Apple 彩色 Emoji 字体转换为标准 TTF 格式，使 Linux 和 Windows 用户能使用 Apple 风格的彩色表情符号。支持 Debian、Fedora、Arch 等主流发行版及 Windows 系统，通过 fonttools 处理字体文件并提供 deb/rpm/arch 包安装。
summary.en: Converts Apple's vibrant color emoji font to standard TTF format for use on Linux and Windows. Supports major distributions including Debian, Fedora, and Arch Linux, with platform-specific packages. Uses fonttools for font processing and fontconfig for system integration.

metadata.name: Tvlist-awesome-m3u-m3u8
metadata.description: 直播源相关资源汇总 📺 💯 IPTV、M3U —— 勤洗手、戴口罩，祝愿所有人百毒不侵

summary.zh: 聚合8000+公开IPTV直播源的资源库，覆盖央视、卫视、地方台及全球多国频道。提供M3U/M3U8格式播放列表，支持各地区运营商IPTV直播源（电信、联通、移动、广电），含IPv6、4K高清、组播源及广播电台。适用于智能电视、网络盒子、电脑手机等设备，支持Kodi等播放器插件。
summary.en: A comprehensive IPTV resource repository aggregating 8000+ public live TV sources in M3U/M3U8 format, covering CCTV, provincial satellites, local channels, and global broadcasts. Includes regional ISP IPTV sources (China Telecom/Unicom/Mobile/CABV) with IPv6, 4K, and multicast support. Compatible with smart TVs, set-top boxes, and Kodi players.

metadata.name: N_m3u8DL-RE
metadata.description: Cross-Platform, modern and powerful stream downloader for MPD/M3U8/ISM. English/简体中文/繁體中文.

summary.zh: N_m3u8DL-RE是一款跨平台流媒体下载工具，支持DASH/HLS/MSS协议，可下载点播和直播内容。它具备多线程并发下载、自动选择最佳音视频轨道、内置ffmpeg合并等功能，支持批量下载和自定义命名规则，兼容Windows/Linux/macOS。
summary.en: N_m3u8DL-RE is a cross-platform stream downloader supporting DASH/HLS/MSS protocols for both VOD and live streaming. It features multi-threaded concurrent downloads, automatic best track selection, built-in ffmpeg merging, and supports batch downloads with customizable naming patterns.

metadata.name: wljs-notebook
metadata.description: Open-source notebook interface for Wolfram Engine

summary.zh: 开源Wolfram语言笔记本界面，基于免费Wolfram Engine运行，无需Mathematica订阅。支持数学排版输入、丰富媒体输出和实时交互可视化。融合Mathematica与Jupyter优点，采用Git友好的笔记本格式。跨平台支持（Windows/Linux/MacOS/浏览器），内置JavaScript沙箱，可导出独立可交互HTML。适合科学计算、数据可视化和数学教育。
summary.en: An open-source notebook interface for Wolfram Language running on the free Wolfram Engine without Mathematica subscription. Supports mathematical typesetting, rich media output, and real-time interactive visualizations. Combines Mathematica and Jupyter's strengths with a Git-friendly notebook format. Cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS/browser), JavaScript sandbox, exportable interactive HTML. Ideal for scientific computing and data visualization.

metadata.name: zx
metadata.description: A tool for writing better scripts

summary.zh: Google 出品的脚本编写工具，通过 $`` 模板字符串语法在 JavaScript/TypeScript 中直接执行 shell 命令，简化 Node.js 原生 API 的使用。提供跨平台兼容、自动参数转义和多运行时支持（Node.js/Bun/Deno），让脚本开发兼具 Bash 的便捷与 JS 的强大能力。
summary.en: A Google-developed scripting tool that enables executing shell commands directly in JavaScript/TypeScript via $`` template literals, simplifying the native Node.js API. Provides cross-platform compatibility, automatic argument escaping, and multi-runtime support (Node.js/Bun/Deno), combining Bash convenience with JavaScript power.

metadata.name: Pearcleaner
metadata.description: A free, source-available and fair-code licensed mac app cleaner

summary.zh: Pearcleaner 是一款开源 macOS 应用清理工具，支持应用卸载、孤立文件搜索、Homebrew 管理、架构剥离等十余种功能。采用 Swift 开发，提供拖放、CLI 和 Finder 扩展等交互方式，内置 Sentinel Monitor 实现自动后台清理，适合需要深度清理和维护 macOS 系统的用户。
summary.en: Pearcleaner is an open-source macOS app cleaner featuring uninstall, orphaned file search, Homebrew management, architecture stripping, and more. Built with Swift, it supports drag-and-drop, CLI, and Finder extension. Includes Sentinel Monitor for automatic background cleanup, ideal for users seeking deep system maintenance.

metadata.name: Debian-Hyprland
metadata.description: For automated installation of Hyprland on Debian 13 Trixie (Testing) and Debian SiD (Unstable)

summary.zh: Debian 系统自动化安装 Hyprland Wayland 合成器的脚本项目，支持 Debian 13 Trixie、Testing 及 SID 版本。提供一键安装脚本、自动依赖解决及 Hyprland-Dots 配置，适用于需要快速部署现代 Wayland 平铺式桌面环境的用户。项目将于 2026 年 3 月移交 LinuxBeginnings 社区维护。
summary.en: An automated installation script for Hyprland Wayland compositor on Debian systems, supporting Debian 13 Trixie, Testing, and SID branches. Features one-click installation, automatic dependency resolution, and pre-configured Hyprland-Dots. Ideal for users seeking a modern Wayland tiling desktop environment on Debian. The project will transition to LinuxBeginnings community maintenance in March 2026.

metadata.name: fcitx5-ios
metadata.description: Fcitx5 iOS edition, currently developer beta. 小企鹅输入法 iOS 开发者公测 https://t.me/fcitx5macos/16126

summary.zh: Fcitx5 输入法框架的 iOS 移植版本，支持 iOS 16.3+。作为开发者公测版，通过 SideStore 侧载安装，提供自定义键盘扩展。集成 libime、hallelujah、rime 等多种输入引擎，支持全访问权限配置与跨应用数据同步。内置 OOM 监控与内存限制处理机制。
summary.en: iOS port of Fcitx5 input method framework supporting iOS ≥ 16.3. Developer beta released via SideStore sideloading with custom keyboard extension. Integrates multiple input engines including libime, hallelujah, and Rime. Features full access configuration, cross-app data sync, and built-in OOM monitoring with memory limit handling.

metadata.name: bilibili-api
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩常用API调用。支持视频、番剧、用户、频道、音频等功能。原仓库地址：https://github.com/MoyuScript/bilibili-api

summary.zh: 哔哩哔哩API Python调用库，覆盖视频、直播、用户、番剧等400+接口。采用全异步架构，支持aiohttp/httpx/curl_cffi，提供代理绕过风控、AV/BV号互转、弹幕WebSocket连接等特色功能，适用于Bilibili数据采集与自动化交互场景。
summary.en: A comprehensive Python library for accessing Bilibili APIs with 400+ endpoints covering videos, livestreaming, users, and anime. Features full async architecture, anti-detection capabilities, BV/AV ID conversion, and WebSocket-based danmaku streaming. Ideal for data crawling and automated interactions with Bilibili platform.

summary.zh: iQbit是一款为qBitTorrent设计的iOS风格WebUI主题，采用现代化设计语言让陈旧的torrent客户端界面焕然一新。作为PWA应用支持原生推送通知和相机扫描等功能，移动端优先设计遵循Human Interface Guidelines，提供深浅主题切换，并可通过独立服务器模式与qBitTorrent通信。
summary.en: iQbit is an iOS-styled WebUI theme for qBitTorrent, bringing modern design to legacy torrent clients. As a PWA, it supports native push notifications and camera scanning, with mobile-first design following Human Interface Guidelines. It offers light/dark themes and can run standalone with proxy communication to qBitTorrent.

metadata.name: synctv
metadata.description: Synchronized viewing, theater, live streaming, video

summary.zh: SyncTV 是一款支持远程同步观影和直播的开源工具，用户无论身处何地都能与朋友家人同步观看视频、实时聊天、发送弹幕。核心功能包括播放进度同步、倍速控制、视频源解析（Alist/Bilibili/Emby）、直播代理及 WebRTC 语音通话。采用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 和 Helm 部署，适合远程社交观影场景。
summary.en: SyncTV is an open-source tool for remote synchronized viewing and live streaming, enabling users to watch videos together with friends and family anywhere. Key features include playback synchronization, speed control, multi-source parsing (Alist/Bilibili/Emby), live proxy, and WebRTC voice calls. Built with Go, it supports Docker and Helm deployment for seamless remote social viewing experiences.

metadata.name: Microsoft-Office-For-MacOS
metadata.description: Installer Microsoft Office For MacOS

summary.zh: 这是一个为 macOS 用户提供的 Microsoft Office 安装工具，支持 Office LTSC 2021/2024 版本。项目整合了 Volume License 序列化包，简化了企业用户在 macOS 上的 Office 部署流程，同时兼容 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 处理器，覆盖从 macOS 10.6 到 14 的广泛系统版本。
summary.en: This project provides a streamlined installation tool for Microsoft Office on macOS, supporting Office LTSC 2021/2024 versions. It integrates Volume License serialization packages to simplify enterprise deployment, with native support for both Apple Silicon and Intel processors across macOS 10.6 to 14.

metadata.name: Lorien
metadata.description: Infinite canvas drawing/whiteboarding app for Windows, Linux and macOS. Made with Godot.

summary.zh: Lorien 是一款基于 Godot 引擎的无限画布绘图/笔记应用，以矢量点集合存储笔触实现极小文件体积。提供自由画笔、橡皮擦、几何工具等多种绘图功能，支持无限撤销/重做、无限缩放、SVG 导出及绘图板压力感应。专为数字笔记本和头脑风暴设计，跨平台支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
summary.en: Lorien is an infinite canvas drawing and note-taking app built with Godot, storing brush strokes as vector point collections for extremely small file sizes. It features freehand brush, eraser, geometric tools, unlimited undo/redo, infinite zoom, and SVG export. Designed as a digital notebook and brainstorming tool, it supports pressure-sensitive drawing tablets and runs cross-platform on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

metadata.name: MahoShojo-Generator
metadata.description: 基于 AI 结构化生成的个性化魔法少女角色生成器。

summary.zh: 魔法少女生成器是一款基于 AI 结构化生成技术的 Web 互动游戏，集成角色生成、深度问卷、竞技场对战故事、连续战报会话、角色成长与排位系统等功能。支持多 AI 模型轮询、SillyTavern/万途生态互通、立绘生成及云端分享，采用 Next.js + Cloudflare Edge Runtime 部署。
summary.en: MahoShojo-Generator is an AI-powered web game featuring structured character generation, arena battle storytelling, growth systems, and ranked matchmaking. Supports multi-model AI routing, cross-platform card sharing with SillyTavern/Wantu ecosystems, AI image generation, and deploys via Next.js on Cloudflare Edge Runtime.

metadata.name: Adobe-Downloader
metadata.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer

summary.zh: macOS 平台专用的 Adobe 应用下载与安装工具，支持 Acrobat Pro 及 Creative Cloud 全套产品下载、多任务并行下载、自动安装与残留清理。采用 SMAppService Daemon 机制实现无密码提权，兼容浅色/深色模式，提供 Helper 游乐场实时监控权限状态。
summary.en: A macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications including Acrobat Pro and Creative Cloud suite. Features multi-task parallel downloads, automated installation, and comprehensive residual file cleanup. Utilizes SMAppService Daemon for privilege escalation without password prompts, supporting light/dark modes with a Helper playground for real-time permission monitoring.

metadata.name: mirotalksfu
metadata.description: 🏆 Self-hosted, open-source WebRTC video conferencing platform for real-time communication and collaboration. A modern alternative to Zoom, built on SFU architecture.

summary.zh: MiroTalk SFU 是一个基于 mediasoup SFU 架构的自托管开源视频会议平台，支持实时音视频通话、屏幕共享、聊天和直播等功能。作为 Zoom/Google Meet 的开源替代方案，用户可在自有服务器部署，完全掌控数据隐私与基础设施，支持 Docker 快速部署。
summary.en: MiroTalk SFU is a self-hosted, open-source video conferencing platform built on mediasoup SFU architecture for scalable real-time communication. It offers video/audio calls, screen sharing, chat, and streaming. As an open-source alternative to Zoom and Google Meet, users deploy it on their own servers for full data privacy and infrastructure control with Docker support.

metadata.name: neodb
metadata.description: 🧩 a self-hosted server tracking what you read/watch/listen/play, powering a global distributed community federating via ActivityPub and (a bit of) ATProto.

summary.zh: NeoDB 是开源自托管服务，帮助用户管理、分享和发现书籍、电影、音乐、播客、游戏等文化产品的收藏与评论。通过 ActivityPub 和 ATProto 接入 Fediverse，支持 Goodreads、IMDB、Douban 等多源数据导入，提供收藏追踪、评分评论、社交动态等完整功能。
summary.en: NeoDB is an open-source self-hosted platform for tracking books, movies, music, podcasts, games and performances. It federates via ActivityPub and ATProto, integrating with Fediverse for social networking. Supports importing from Goodreads, IMDB, Douban, Discogs, Steam and more, offering collection management, ratings, reviews and social feeds.

metadata.name: qbittorrent-nox-static
metadata.description: A bash script which builds a fully static qbittorrent-nox binary with current dependencies to use on any Linux OS

summary.zh: 一个 Bash 脚本项目，用于编译完全静态链接的 qBittorrent-nox 二进制文件。静态编译使其可在任何 Linux 发行版上直接运行，无需安装额外依赖库。支持 x86_64、ARM、PowerPC、MIPS、RISC-V、LoongArch 等 13 种 CPU 架构，同时提供 libtorrent v1.2 和 v2.0 两种版本。适合在无图形界面的服务器或 Docker 容器中部署 BT 下载服务。
summary.en: A Bash build script that compiles fully static qBittorrent-nox binaries, eliminating external library dependencies on any Linux OS. Supports 13 CPU architectures including x86_64, ARM variants, PowerPC, MIPS, RISC-V, and LoongArch64. Offers both libtorrent v1.2 and v2.0 builds, ideal for headless server deployments and Docker containers.

metadata.name: imessage-exporter
metadata.description: Export iMessage data + run iMessage Diagnostics

summary.zh: 一款基于 Rust 的开源工具，可跨平台导出 iMessage 消息数据（支持 txt/html 格式及多媒体附件），并提供数据库诊断功能。该库支持解析所有 iMessage 特性，包括群聊、语音消息、Tapbacks 等，适合数据备份、迁移及合规存档场景。
summary.en: A Rust-based open-source tool that exports iMessage data cross-platform (txt/html formats with multimedia attachments) and provides database diagnostics. Supports all iMessage features including group chats, audio messages, and tapbacks, ideal for backup, migration, and compliance archiving.

metadata.name: langshift.dev
metadata.description: 🌍 Programming language learning platform for developers. Master new languages through comparison learning. Interactive editor, performance monitoring, multi-language support.

summary.zh: LangShift.dev 是专为开发者设计的编程语言对比学习平台，通过已知语言快速理解新语言。支持 JavaScript 与 Python、Rust、Go、Kotlin、C++、C 等语言的语法映射和概念对比，内置交互式编辑器和 AI 辅助内容生成，提供完整的模块化学习路径，帮助开发者高效构建多语言开发能力。
summary.en: LangShift.dev is a developer-focused programming language learning platform using comparative learning methodology. It supports syntax mapping between JavaScript and Python, Rust, Go, Kotlin, C++, C through interactive editors and AI-generated content, providing comprehensive modular learning paths to help developers build multi-language capabilities efficiently.

metadata.name: copyparty
metadata.description: Portable file server with accelerated resumable uploads, dedup, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP, TFTP, zeroconf, media indexer, thumbnails++ all in one file

summary.zh: copyparty是一款轻量级便携式文件服务器，仅需Python环境即可运行。它支持HTTP/WebDAV/SFTP/FTP/TFTP/SMB等多协议，实现断点续传加速上传、去重、媒体缩略图生成。功能涵盖ZIP打包下载、RSS/OPDS订阅、自毁上传、账户权限管理等，单文件部署，跨平台运行，是高效文件分享的利器。
summary.en: copyparty transforms any device into a versatile file server with just Python. It supports HTTP/WebDAV/SFTP/FTP/TFTP/SMB protocols, featuring resumable uploads with acceleration and deduplication, media thumbnails, zip-DL, and RSS/OPDS feeds. Single-file deployment, cross-platform, with account permissions and media indexing.

metadata.name: r8125
metadata.description: 2.5G Ethernet LINUX driver r8125

summary.zh: Realtek RTL8125 2.5G千兆以太网控制器Linux驱动，采用DKMS机制实现内核升级后自动重新编译，确保驱动持久有效。提供Debian/Ubuntu和openSUSE发行版的便捷安装包，解决开源r8169驱动兼容性问题，适用于需要2.5Gbps高速网络连接的桌面和服务器场景。
summary.en: Linux driver for Realtek RTL8125 2.5GbE Ethernet controller using DKMS mechanism to automatically recompile after kernel upgrades. Provides easy-to-install packages for Debian/Ubuntu and openSUSE, resolving open-source r8169 driver compatibility issues for desktop and server environments requiring 2.5Gbps network connectivity.

metadata.name: dashy
metadata.description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!

summary.zh: Dashy是一个自托管的个人仪表盘，可将所有自托管服务集中到一个界面统一访问。支持实时状态监控、动态小部件、丰富主题和图标、自定义布局、多语言及云备份功能。采用YAML配置，支持Docker一键部署，适合homelab爱好者和需要统一管理自托管应用的用户。
summary.en: Dashy is a self-hostable personal dashboard that organizes self-hosted services in one interface. It features real-time status monitoring, dynamic widgets, customizable themes, multi-language support, and cloud backup. Configured via YAML and deployable with Docker, ideal for homelab enthusiasts managing multiple self-hosted applications.

metadata.name: Resume-Matcher
metadata.description: Improve your resumes with Resume Matcher. Get insights, keyword suggestions and tune your resumes to job descriptions.

summary.zh: AI驱动的简历优化工具，支持本地Ollama或API连接LLM。用户上传主简历并粘贴目标职位描述，系统自动生成关键词建议、内容优化和求职信，支持PDF/DOCX导入导出，帮助求职者针对性提升简历匹配度。
summary.en: AI-powered resume optimization tool supporting local Ollama or API-based LLM providers. Users upload a master resume and paste job descriptions to receive keyword suggestions, content improvements, and cover letters, enhancing job application match rates.

metadata.name: university-information
metadata.description: 收集全国各高校招生时不会写明，却会实实在在影响大学生活质量的要求与细节

summary.zh: 社区协作收集中国高校真实生活细节的项目，填补招生信息空白。系统整理宿舍条件、作息要求、校园设施等25类影响生活质量的关键指标，帮助高考学生全面了解目标院校的实际就读体验。配套网站提供便捷查询，资料以Markdown格式开放共享，采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0协议。
summary.en: A community-driven platform collecting authentic details about Chinese university life, filling gaps in official admissions information. Systematically organizes 25 categories of quality-of-life indicators including dormitory conditions, schedules, and campus facilities. Helps prospective students understand real campus experiences before applications. Paired with a searchable website, with open Markdown-format resources under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.

metadata.name: anylinuxfs
metadata.description: macOS: mount any linux-supported filesystem read/write using NFS and a microVM

summary.zh: macOS工具，通过轻量级虚拟机和NFS协议，在Apple Silicon Mac上挂载ext4、btrfs、XFS、NTFS等任意Linux文件系统，支持LUKS/BitLocker加密、LVM、RAID、ZFS等高级存储配置。无需内核扩展，安全可靠，提供完整读写能力。
summary.en: A macOS utility that mounts any Linux filesystem on Apple Silicon Macs using lightweight VMs and NFS. Supports ext4, btrfs, XFS, NTFS, exFAT with full read-write access. Handles encrypted drives (LUKS, BitLocker), LVM, RAID, ZFS. No kernel extensions needed.

metadata.name: UniBoard
metadata.description: 个人介绍，导航页、笔记、短链、文件分享、探针，私有化部署。Profile、Note、ShortURL、FileSharing、probeMonitor…… with self-host

summary.zh: UniBoard 是一款开源的个人主页导航工具箱，集成个人信息展示、外链导航、Markdown 云笔记、短链接管理、文件分享存储及探针监控等功能。基于 Vue + TS + PrimeVue + Tailwind CSS 构建，支持 Docker 私有化部署与全局暗色模式，适合个人搭建专属工具平台。
summary.en: UniBoard is an open-source personal hub toolbox featuring profile display, link navigation, Markdown cloud notes, short URL management, file sharing with storage, and probe monitoring. Built with Vue + TS + PrimeVue + Tailwind CSS, it supports Docker self-hosting and global dark mode, ideal for building personal utility platforms.

metadata.name: Mangane
metadata.description: Alternative frontend for Akkoma

summary.zh: Mangane 是一个专为去中心化社交网络（Fediverse）设计的替代前端界面，兼容 Pleroma、Akkoma 和 Mastodon API。作为浏览器端单页应用，它通过后端功能检测系统自动适配不同平台，追求易用性、可读性与自定义品牌能力。
summary.en: Mangane is an alternative frontend for decentralized social networks, compatible with Pleroma, Akkoma, and Mastodon. Built as a browser-based SPA, it automatically adapts to different backends through feature detection, emphasizing accessibility and custom branding.

metadata.name: cherry
metadata.description: Cherry is a self-hostable bookmark service

summary.zh: Cherry 是一个轻量级自托管书签服务，支持用户注册与权限管理。用户可本地部署实现数据自控，提供简洁的 Web 界面进行书签分类、收藏与管理，适合个人或小团队搭建私有书签管理系统。
summary.en: Cherry is a lightweight self-hostable bookmark service with user authentication and role-based access control. It enables individuals or teams to deploy their own bookmark management system, offering a clean web interface for organizing, categorizing, and quickly accessing saved links privately.

metadata.name: macos
metadata.description: MacOS inside a Docker container.

summary.zh: 在Docker容器中运行macOS的开源虚拟化方案，通过KVM硬件加速实现高性能。支持macOS 11-15多个版本，提供网页端访问（端口8006）和VNC远程连接。兼容Docker Compose、Kubernetes等多种部署方式，支持自定义磁盘容量、CPU和内存配置。适合开发测试和跨平台体验场景。
summary.en: An open-source solution running macOS within Docker containers using KVM hardware virtualization acceleration. Supports macOS versions 11-15 with a web-based viewer on port 8006 and VNC access. Deployable via Docker Compose, Kubernetes, or CLI with customizable disk size, CPU, and RAM settings. Ideal for development, testing, and cross-platform experiences.

metadata.name: diskonaut
metadata.description: Terminal disk space navigator 🔭

summary.zh: diskonaut 是一款 Rust 编写的终端磁盘空间导航工具，可实时扫描指定路径并以树状图可视化展示空间占用情况，支持在扫描过程中浏览目录结构。内置文件删除功能，可追踪本次会话释放的磁盘空间。跨平台支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows，提供多种安装方式。
summary.en: diskonaut is a Rust-based terminal disk space navigator that scans paths and indexes metadata to memory, enabling real-time exploration via treemap visualization. It supports deleting files/folders while tracking freed space during the session. Cross-platform support for Linux, macOS and Windows with multiple installation options.

metadata.name: blockminer
metadata.description: o

summary.zh: BlockMiner 是一款 Minecraft 客户端 Mod，通过红石火把或拉杆配合活塞的方案，实现破坏生存模式下不可破坏方块（如基岩）的功能。支持自定义白名单、距离计算模式调试、无头活塞模式等高级配置，提供丰富的命令系统用于精细控制。
summary.en: BlockMiner is a Minecraft client mod that enables breaking normally unbreakable blocks in survival mode (like bedrock) using redstone torches or levers with pistons. It features customizable whitelists, distance calculation mode adjustment, headless piston mode, and comprehensive command controls for fine-tuned operation.

metadata.description: 015 is a self-hosted temporary file sharing platform. Focused on providing one-time, temporary file and text upload, processing, and sharing services.

summary.zh: 015是一款自托管临时文件分享平台，采用Vue 3 + Nuxt 3 + Go全栈架构。核心功能包括大文件分片上传、前端哈希即时传输避免重复上传、图片压缩、分享链接管理（密码保护、下载限制、过期时间）、取件码分享及多语言支持。基于Redis+Asynq实现异步任务队列，适合个人或团队搭建私有文件分享服务。
summary.en: 015 is a self-hosted temporary file sharing platform built with Vue 3 + Nuxt 3 + Go. Key features include chunked large file uploads, instant transfer via frontend hash calculation to avoid duplicates, image compression, share link management with password protection and download limits, pickup code sharing, and multi-language support. Powered by Redis + Asynq for async task processing, ideal for private file sharing services.

metadata.name: docker_image_pusher
metadata.description: 使用Github Action将国外的Docker镜像转存到阿里云私有仓库，供国内服务器使用，免费易用

summary.zh: 利用GitHub Actions自动化将DockerHub、gcr.io等国外镜像仓库的镜像同步到阿里云容器镜像服务，支持最大40GB的大型镜像和多架构镜像，自动处理镜像重名问题，适合国内服务器快速拉取镜像。
summary.en: Automates syncing Docker images from foreign registries like DockerHub and gcr.io to Alibaba Cloud Container Registry using GitHub Actions. Supports large images up to 40GB and multi-architecture mirrors with automatic duplicate name handling for fast image pulling in China.

metadata.name: happy-llm
metadata.description: 📚 从零开始构建大模型

summary.zh: Datawhale推出的系统性LLM学习教程，从NLP基础逐步深入至大模型核心原理。涵盖Transformer架构、注意力机制、预训练语言模型等核心理论，并手把手实现LLaMA2模型，讲解预训练、SFT、LoRA/QLoRA微调全流程。配套RAG、Agent等前沿应用实战，完全免费开源。
summary.en: A systematic LLM learning tutorial by Datawhale, progressing from NLP fundamentals to core LLM principles. Covers Transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and pretraining models, with hands-on LLaMA2 implementation, full training pipelines including pretraining, SFT, and LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, plus RAG and Agent applications.

metadata.name: DockerHub
metadata.description: 2026年5月更新，目前国内可用Docker镜像源汇总，DockerHub国内镜像加速列表，🚀DockerHub镜像加速器

summary.zh: 整理2026年5月国内可用的Docker Hub镜像加速器列表，收录毫秒镜像、Docker Proxy、DaoCloud、阿里云、腾讯云等10余个可用源，并标注已失效的镜像站。帮助开发者解决Docker镜像拉取速度慢或无法访问的问题，提供即时的镜像源可用性参考。
summary.en: A curated list of working Docker Hub mirror accelerators in China as of May 2026, featuring 10+ available sources including 1ms.run, DockerProxy, DaoCloud, Aliyun, and Tencent Cloud. Also documents deprecated mirrors to help developers resolve slow or inaccessible Docker image pulls in China.

metadata.name: Graphite
metadata.description: Community-built comprehensive 2D content creation appplication for graphic design, digital art, and interactive real-time motion graphics powered by a node-based procedural graphics engine

summary.zh: Graphite是一款免费开源的2D内容创作工具，融合矢量与栅格图形处理能力。其核心是基于节点的程序化图形引擎，支持完全非破坏性编辑工作流程。结合图层合成与节点生成设计，可用于图形设计、数字绘画、实时运动图形和VFX合成等场景。
summary.en: Graphite is a free, open-source 2D content creation tool that integrates vector and raster graphics processing. Its core is a node-based procedural graphics engine enabling fully nondestructive editing workflows. Combining layer compositing with node-based generative design, it supports graphic design, digital painting, real-time motion graphics, and VFX compositing.

metadata.name: VueTorrent
metadata.description: The sleekest looking WEBUI for qBittorrent made with Vuejs!

summary.zh: VueTorrent 是一个为 qBittorrent 打造的现代化 WebUI 界面，基于 Vue.js 3 和 Vuetify 3 构建。它提供美观的界面设计，支持桌面和移动端响应式布局，具备亮/暗色模式切换、键盘快捷键（包括 Mac keymap）、种子文件管理、选择性下载和内置种子搜索等丰富功能，是 qBittorrent 用户提升下载体验的优质选择。
summary.en: VueTorrent is a modern, visually stunning WebUI for qBittorrent, built with Vue.js 3 and Vuetify 3. It features responsive design for both desktop and mobile, light/dark mode support, comprehensive keyboard shortcuts including Mac keymap, torrent management with selective downloading, and integrated torrent search functionality.

metadata.name: danted
metadata.description: Fast script for installing & configing Danted--Socks5 Proxy Server.

summary.zh: 这是一个用于快速部署 Dante SOCKS5 代理服务器的自动化脚本，支持从源码自动编译安装和 Docker 部署。脚本可自动识别系统环境，支持多IP同源轮换、PAM认证、系统用户认证及IP白名单等多种认证方式，并提供完善的用户管理和服务控制功能。
summary.en: An automated installation and management script for deploying Dante SOCKS5 proxy server, featuring automatic system detection and source code compilation. The solution offers Docker deployment support, multi-IP rotation capabilities, and flexible authentication methods including PAM, system users, and IP whitelisting. Complete user management and service control tools are included.

metadata.name: Docker-qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition
metadata.description: Docker-qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition

summary.zh: 专为群晖、威联通等NAS设备优化的qBittorrent增强版Docker镜像，支持x86-64、arm64、armhf全平台架构。采用usermapping技术以用户自身权限运行容器，内置400+条tracker并自动同步更新。核心亮点是屏蔽迅雷等吸血客户端，优化下载连接数，配合预置的优化配置文件和中文界面，显著降低部署复杂度。
summary.en: A Docker image of qBittorrent Enhanced Edition optimized for NAS devices like Synology and QNAP, supporting x86-64, arm64, and armhf architectures. It uses usermapping to run with the user's own permissions, includes 400+ pre-configured trackers with automatic updates. Key feature: blocks leech clients to optimize download speed, with pre-tuned config files and Chinese UI for easy deployment.

metadata.name: neko
metadata.description: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.

summary.zh: Neko 是一个自托管的虚拟浏览器，运行在 Docker 容器中，通过 WebRTC 技术将桌面环境实时流传输到浏览器。它支持多人同时访问，可用于安全私密浏览、远程办公、观看派对和交互式演示等场景。作为 Rabb.it 的开源替代方案，Neko 提供了一个隔离的虚拟浏览环境，让用户在任何设备上都能获得完整的浏览器体验。
summary.en: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running in Docker containers, using WebRTC to stream a desktop environment directly to browsers. It supports multiple simultaneous users for secure private browsing, remote work, watch parties, and interactive presentations. As an open-source alternative to Rabb.it, Neko provides an isolated virtual browsing environment accessible from any device.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS Fusion Monster Server Test GO Version Aiming to be the most comprehensive server testing project, implemented in Go with zero environment dependencies.      VPS融合怪服务器测评项目 GO版本 尽量成为最全能的服务器测评项目，使用 Go 实现，无需任何环境依赖。

summary.zh: VPS融合怪服务器测评工具的 Go 语言实现版，主打零环境依赖。支持系统信息、CPU、内存、磁盘、流媒体解锁、IP质量、邮箱端口、三网回程等全方位测试。项目自研多个测试模块（basics、cputest、disktest、UnlockTests等），覆盖 amd64/arm64/mips 等多架构，兼容 Linux/Windows/MacOS/Android 等系统，是 VPS 商家筛选与性能评估的实用工具。
summary.en: A comprehensive Go-based VPS server testing tool with zero environment dependencies. It performs full-spectrum evaluations including system info, CPU, memory, disk, streaming platform unlock, IP quality, email port, and network routing tests. With self-developed modules (basics, cputest, disktest, UnlockTests) and multi-architecture support (amd64/arm64/mips), it runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, and Android—ideal for VPS benchmarking and vendor screening.

metadata.name: knowledge-grab
metadata.description: knowledge-grab 是一个基于 Tauri 和 Vue 3 构建的桌面应用程序，方便用户从 国家中小学智慧教育平台 (basic.smartedu.cn) 下载各类教育资源。

summary.zh: 一个基于 Tauri 和 Vue 3 构建的跨平台桌面应用，用于从国家中小学智慧教育平台批量下载教育资源。支持按分类浏览、批量下载教材和课程资源，帮助用户高效获取学习资料。
summary.en: A cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri and Vue 3 that enables batch downloading of educational resources from China's National Smart Education Platform. It supports categorized browsing and bulk download of teaching materials and courses.

metadata.name: RSS-to-Telegram-Bot
metadata.description: A Telegram RSS bot that cares about your reading experience (calling for new maintainers: https://github.com/Rongronggg9/RSS-to-Telegram-Bot/issues/747)

summary.zh: RSS-to-Telegram-Bot 是一款专注于阅读体验的 Telegram RSS 机器人，支持多用户、多语言环境。它能保留 RSS 文章的富文本格式和媒体内容（图片、视频、音频），自动处理长消息分割、表情符号转换，并支持 Telegraph 发布、代理设置和 OPML 导入导出。
summary.en: RSS-to-Telegram-Bot is a Telegram RSS bot focused on reading experience, supporting multi-user and i18n. It preserves rich-text format and media content from RSS feeds, handles long message splitting, emoji conversion, and offers features like Telegraph posting, proxy settings, and OPML import/export.

metadata.name: zerotier-moon
metadata.description: 🐳 A docker image to create ZeroTier moon in one step.

summary.zh: ZeroTier Moon 私有根服务器 Docker 镜像，通过 Docker 一键部署自建 ZeroTier 网络根节点。该镜像支持自动检测公网 IPv4/IPv6 地址，简化了 ZeroTier 网络的自建优化过程，可显著提升异地组网连接的稳定性和速度。
summary.en: A Docker image for deploying ZeroTier Moon private root server in one step. It automates the creation of self-hosted ZeroTier network root nodes with public IP detection, improving network stability and connection speed for distributed team collaboration.

metadata.name: zfile
metadata.description: 在线云盘、网盘、OneDrive、云存储、私有云、对象存储、h5ai、上传、下载

summary.zh: ZFile 是一款面向个人和小团队的开源私有云盘程序，支持统一管理 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive、本地存储、FTP 等多种存储源。具备文件在线预览（图片、音视频、Office、3D文件）、直链生成、多用户权限控制等功能，采用响应式设计适配多种设备，提供 Docker 便捷部署。
summary.en: ZFile is an open-source private cloud drive for individuals and small teams, unifying S3, OneDrive, Google Drive, local storage, FTP and more. Features include online preview of images, videos, Office docs, 3D files, direct link generation, multi-user access control, responsive design, and Docker deployment support.

metadata.name: gemini-poise
metadata.description: 一个用于代理和管理 Gemini API 请求的全栈应用，支持 API Key 轮换和请求转发。

summary.zh: Gemini Poise 是一个全栈 API 代理管理工具，为 AI 应用开发者提供 Gemini API Key 轮换、请求转发、限流控制和用户认证等一站式解决方案。集成 FastAPI + React 技术栈，支持令牌桶算法限流和自动故障转移，可显著提升 API 可用性和系统稳定性。
summary.en: Gemini Poise is a full-stack API proxy and management tool providing AI developers with comprehensive solutions for Gemini API key rotation, request forwarding, rate limiting, and user authentication. Built with FastAPI and React, it implements token bucket algorithm for advanced rate control and automatic fallback to enhance API availability and system stability.

metadata.name: tg-disk
metadata.description: tgNetDisc重构升级版，基于Telegram的♾️️无限容量网盘/图床，不限制文件格式，不限制文件大小（大文件会分块上传），不限制文件内容😏，占用很少的内存和磁盘空间📁，轻巧方便。 文件都存储在Telegram☁️端，拥有良好的安全性🔒和持久性。文件上传成功会生成HTML、Markdown、BBCode三种形式的外链🔗，可以用来当做图床、文件下载url。

summary.zh: 基于 Telegram Bot API 构建的无限容量网盘与图床服务，支持任意格式、任意大小文件（分块上传），可执行文件仅 6MB，Docker 镜像不足 20MB，轻量高效。文件存储于 Telegram 云端，具备高安全性与持久性。上传后自动生成 HTML、Markdown、BBCode 三种外链格式，支持多线程下载加速，配套 Web 界面与 API 接口，适用于个人文件存储与公开分享场景。
summary.en: An infinite-capacity cloud disk and image hosting service powered by Telegram Bot API, supporting unlimited file formats and sizes via chunked upload. The executable is under 6MB with a Docker image under 20MB, making it lightweight and efficient. Files are stored on Telegram's cloud with high security and durability. Uploaded files generate HTML, Markdown, and BBCode links automatically, with multi-threaded download acceleration, web UI, and API support for personal storage and public sharing.

metadata.name: angie
metadata.description: Angie - drop-in replacement for nginx

summary.zh: Angie 是从 nginx 分叉的高性能 Web 服务器，作为直接替代品兼容现有配置。由原 nginx 团队开发，在 nginx 1.29 基础上新增 HTTP/3 原生支持、自动 HTTPS (ACME)、简化的 location 配置及 RESTful API 监控等特性，适合需要现代协议支持和便捷运维的场景。
summary.en: Angie is a high-performance web server forked from nginx, designed as a drop-in replacement with full configuration compatibility. Developed by former nginx team members, it builds upon nginx 1.29, introducing native HTTP/3 support, automatic HTTPS via ACME, streamlined location configurations, and comprehensive RESTful API monitoring capabilities.

metadata.name: copicseal
metadata.description: Copicseal is an EXIF-based photo watermarking tool for adding camera settings like shutter speed and ISO. Copicseal（可图匠）是一款基于 EXIF 的图片边框水印工具。

summary.zh: Copicseal（可图匠）是一款基于 EXIF 数据的图片边框水印工具，自动读取照片的快门速度、ISO、焦距等拍摄参数，生成专业级边框水印。支持自定义水印样式、位置、大小与透明度，提供实时预览和批量处理功能，跨平台支持 Windows 与 macOS，单文件安装零依赖，适合摄影师和内容创作者快速为照片添加参数水印。
summary.en: Copicseal is an EXIF-based photo watermarking tool that automatically extracts camera settings like shutter speed, ISO, and focal length to create professional border watermarks. It supports customizable watermark styles, positions, sizes, and transparency with real-time preview and batch processing. Cross-platform compatible (Windows/macOS) with single-file installation and zero dependencies, ideal for photographers and content creators.

metadata.name: telegraph
metadata.description: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 和 Pages 的图床/视频床/文件床，轻松实现无服务器部署！

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 和 Telegram Bot API 的无服务器图床/文件床服务，支持图片、视频、文档等多格式上传。采用 D1 数据库存储文件映射，提供图片压缩、哈希去重、管理后台和访客验证等功能，通过 Cloudflare Cache API 优化访问速度，支持响应式布局与移动端。
summary.en: A serverless image/file hosting service built on Cloudflare Worker and Telegram Bot API. Supports multi-format uploads including images, videos, and documents. Features D1 database for file mapping, image compression, hash-based deduplication, admin panel, and Cloudflare Cache API for optimized performance with responsive design.

metadata.name: reinstall
metadata.description: 一键DD/重装脚本 (One-click reinstall OS on VPS)

summary.zh: 一键 VPS 系统重装脚本，支持 Linux 19种发行版和 Windows 官方原版 ISO 重装。可实现任意方向系统互装（Linux↔Linux、Linux↔Windows），自动配置网络（支持静态/动态IP、纯IPv6），适配低内存环境，使用分区表ID精准识别硬盘，兼容 BIOS/EFI 引导和 ARM 架构。
summary.en: One-click VPS OS reinstall script supporting 19 Linux distros and official Windows ISO. Enables cross-direction reinstallation (Linux↔Windows↔Linux), auto network config (static/dynamic IP, IPv6), low-memory optimization, GPT/MBR disk detection, and BIOS/EFI/ARM compatibility.

metadata.name: Construct
metadata.description: A Minecraft Bedrock addon to ease the survival building process.

summary.zh: Construct是一款Minecraft基岩版生存建筑辅助模组，帮助玩家将创造模式建筑便捷转移到生存模式。核心功能包括智能方块放置、材料自动从箱子获取、分层建筑、结构管理和跨世界导入。玩家通过Construct菜单管理结构实例，支持结构块和命令保存建筑，大幅简化生存模式建筑流程。
summary.en: Construct is a Minecraft Bedrock addon that streamlines survival building by transferring creative builds to survival mode. It features intelligent block placement, automatic material gathering from chests, layered building, and comprehensive structure management. Players can manage structure instances through an intuitive menu, import structures across worlds, and save buildings using structure blocks or commands.

metadata.name: komari
metadata.description: A simple server monitor tool.

summary.zh: Komari 是一款轻量级、自托管的服务器监控工具，通过 Web 界面实时展示服务器性能状态，采用轻量级 Agent 数据采集，支持 Docker、一键脚本、二进制等多途径部署，数据隐私完全自主可控，适合中小型服务器环境。
summary.en: Komari is a lightweight, self-hosted server monitoring tool that provides real-time server performance monitoring through a web interface with a lightweight agent. It supports multiple deployment methods including Docker, one-click scripts, and binary files, offering complete data privacy control.

metadata.name: stb
metadata.description: Stb图床 - 现代化图片托管解决方案

summary.zh: Stb图床是一个现代化图片托管解决方案，支持阿里云OSS、腾讯云COS、七牛云、S3等十余种云存储后端。提供图片压缩、水印、缩略图、格式转换等处理功能，具备用户管理、相册管理、图片广场等社交特性，支持API接口和第三方登录，适用于个人或团队搭建私有图床。
summary.en: Stb is a modern image hosting solution supporting multiple cloud storage backends including Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, Qiniu, S3, and more. It offers image processing features like compression, watermarks, thumbnails, and format conversion, with social features such as user management, albums, and image gallery. Supports API and third-party login, ideal for building private image hosting services.

metadata.name: EasyTier
metadata.description: A simple, decentralized mesh VPN with WireGuard support.

summary.zh: 基于 Rust 和 Tokio 构建的去中心化 mesh VPN 解决方案，支持 WireGuard 加密协议。具备高效 NAT 穿透、智能路由和零拷贝高性能传输能力，支持 Win/MacOS/Linux/Android 等多平台。提供 Web 管理界面和命令行工具，适用于跨地域安全互联、子网共享等场景。
summary.en: A decentralized mesh VPN solution built with Rust and Tokio, featuring WireGuard encryption, efficient NAT traversal, and zero-copy high-performance transmission. Supports Win/MacOS/Linux/Android across X86/ARM/MIPS architectures. Offers Web management and CLI tools, ideal for secure cross-regional networking and subnet sharing.

metadata.name: airi
metadata.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.

summary.zh: AIRI是一个自托管的AI虚拟角色项目，旨在复现Neuro-sama式的AI伴侣。支持实时语音对话、游戏互动（Minecraft、Factorio）等功能，可跨平台部署于Web、macOS和Windows系统，提供高度可定制的AI人格与交互体验。
summary.en: AIRI is a self-hosted AI virtual companion project inspired by Neuro-sama, featuring real-time voice interaction and gaming capabilities with Minecraft and Factorio. Supports Web, macOS, and Windows platforms with customizable AI personalities and interactive behaviors.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList是AList的社区驱动分叉项目，旨在应对开源信任危机，维护开放生态。支持阿里云盘、OneDrive、Google Drive、S3等20+种存储后端的统一文件管理与访问。采用Go语言开发，遵循AGPL-3.0开源协议，提供Web界面和API，适合搭建私有网盘或统一文件访问平台。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-driven fork of AList defending open source against trust-based attacks. It provides unified file management across 20+ storage backends including Aliyun Drive, OneDrive, Google Drive, and S3. Built with Go under AGPL-3.0 license, it offers Web UI and API for building private cloud storage or unified file access platforms.

metadata.name: fusion-pixel-font
metadata.description: 开源的泛中日韩像素字体，黑体风格

summary.zh: 缝合像素字体是一款开源的泛中日韩像素黑体字体，通过合并多个开源像素字体构建。支持8/10/12像素尺寸，提供等宽和比例两种模式，涵盖拉丁语、简繁体中文、日语和朝鲜语字形。采用SIL开放字体许可证，可免费用于个人和商业项目。
summary.en: Fusion Pixel Font is an open-source Pan-CJK bitmap sans-serif typeface, created by merging multiple pixel fonts. It supports 8/10/12px sizes in both monospaced and proportional modes, covering Latin, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Licensed under SIL OFL-1.1 for free use.

metadata.name: XMusicDownloader
metadata.description: 一款 支持从百度、网易、qq、酷狗、咪咕等音乐网站搜索并下载歌曲的程序，支持下载无损音乐

summary.zh: XMusicDownloader是一款C#开发的音乐下载工具，支持百度、网易、QQ、酷狗、咪咕等平台聚合搜索与批量下载。可一键下载歌单、专辑、歌手歌曲，支持flac无损、320kbps、128kbps多种音质。采用Provider可扩展架构，方便集成更多音乐源。
summary.en: XMusicDownloader is a C# music downloader supporting multiple platforms including Baidu, NetEase, QQ, Kugou, and Migu. It enables batch downloading of playlists, albums, and artist songs with support for lossless FLAC, 320kbps, and 128kbps formats. Its extensible Provider architecture allows seamless integration of additional music sources.

metadata.name: Sakurairo
metadata.description: A WordPress theme that is built with AI-assisted reading features, colorful, user-friendly, well-rounded, and rich in functionalities. Support Chinese, English, Japanese, Français (soutien de base) languages. Based on Theme Sakura.  一款具有 AI 辅助阅读功能的 WordPress 主题，多彩、友好、功能全面、体验完善。 支持中、英、日、法（基础适配）多语言。基于 Sakura 主题。

summary.zh: Sakurairo 是一款基于 Sakura 主题重构开发的 WordPress 主题，集成 AI 辅助阅读功能，提供多彩、友好的界面设计。支持中、英、日、法四种语言，适合个人博客和内容创作平台。采用 GPL V2.0 开源协议，基于 Codestar Framework 构建设置面板，具备无缝更新机制和活跃的社区支持。
summary.en: Sakurairo is a feature-rich WordPress theme rebuilt from Theme Sakura, featuring AI-assisted reading capabilities and a colorful, user-friendly interface. Supports Chinese, English, Japanese, and French languages, ideal for personal blogs and content platforms. Licensed under GPL V2.0 with Codestar Framework settings panel, seamless update mechanisms, and active community support.

metadata.name: Foxel
metadata.description: A highly extensible private cloud storage solution for individuals and teams, featuring AI-powered semantic search.

summary.zh: Foxel 是一款高度可扩展的私有云存储解决方案，支持统一管理 Local、S3、WebDAV、Google Drive 等多种存储后端。内置 AI 语义搜索功能，基于 Milvus/Qdrant 向量数据库实现自然语言内容检索。提供完整的 RBAC 权限体系、插件架构、AI Agent 自动化及 S3/WebDAV 协议映射，适用于团队协作与个人数据管理。
summary.en: Foxel is a highly extensible private cloud storage solution supporting multiple backends including Local, S3, WebDAV, and cloud drives. Features AI-powered semantic search via Milvus/Qdrant vector databases, RBAC permission system, plugin architecture, AI Agent automation, and S3/WebDAV protocol mappings for seamless team collaboration and personal data management.

metadata.name: duf
metadata.description: Disk Usage/Free Utility - a better 'df' alternative

summary.zh: duf 是一款跨平台磁盘使用查看工具，可作为 df 命令的现代化替代品。支持 Linux、BSD、macOS、Windows 等多系统，提供用户友好的彩色输出，自动适配终端主题与宽度。可按需排序、过滤和分组设备，支持 JSON 格式输出，方便集成到自动化脚本中。
summary.en: duf is a cross-platform disk usage analyzer serving as a modern alternative to df. It supports Linux, BSD, macOS, and Windows with user-friendly colored output that adapts to terminal themes. Features include sorting, filtering, grouping devices, and JSON output for scripting integration.

metadata.name: bird-lg-go
metadata.description: BIRD looking glass in Go, for better maintainability, easier deployment & smaller memory footprint

summary.zh: BIRD 路由协议的 Looking Glass 工具 Go 语言实现，用于查询 BGP 路由状态、AS 路径、traceroute 和 whois 信息。支持 peering 状态展示和 AS 路径可视化。采用 Go 语言实现以降低内存占用，支持 Docker 快速部署，前后端可独立或协同运行。
summary.en: A Go-based Looking Glass implementation for the BIRD internet routing daemon, enabling BGP route queries, AS path visualization, whois lookups, and traceroute. Offers reduced memory footprint and flexible deployment via Docker, supporting both frontend and proxy components with multi-format configuration support.

metadata.name: CloudFlare-ImgBed
metadata.description: A serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. Supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities.

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare 构建的开源无服务器文件托管解决方案，支持图片托管、安全存储与个人云盘功能。兼容 Docker、Workers 多端部署，集成 Cloudflare R2、S3、Telegram、Discord、WebDAV 等多存储渠道，提供 RESTful API 与 WebDAV 协议支持，实现跨平台文件管理。
summary.en: An open-source serverless file hosting solution built on Cloudflare, featuring image hosting, secure storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities. Supports multi-end deployment via Docker and Workers, integrating Cloudflare R2, S3, Telegram, Discord, and WebDAV storage channels with RESTful APIs and WebDAV protocol for cross-platform file management.

metadata.name: imgpush
metadata.description: Minimalist Self-hosted Image Service for user submitted images in your app

summary.zh: 极简自托管图片上传服务，提供单一 API 端点接收用户图片。支持自动格式转换、按需缩放、内置限流和跨域白名单，可选 S3 兼容存储后端。通过 Docker 一键部署，支持 Kubernetes 编排，适合应用内轻量级图片托管需求。
summary.en: A minimalist self-hosted image upload service with a single API endpoint for receiving user images. Supports automatic format conversion, on-demand resizing, built-in rate limiting, and CORS whitelisting. Docker-ready with optional S3-compatible storage backends. Ideal for lightweight image hosting within applications.

metadata.name: CF-ImgBed
metadata.description: A simple ImgBed can deploy on cloudflare platform.

summary.zh: 基于 Astro 和 Cloudflare 构建的现代化图床应用，部署于边缘网络。使用 R2 存储图片、KV 存储元数据，支持拖拽/批量上传、上传前编辑、多格式链接复制。提供后台管理界面，含仪表盘、图片管理、API Key 管理及防盗链设置，适合个人图床和开发者集成使用。
summary.en: A modern image hosting application built with Astro on Cloudflare's edge network. Uses R2 for image storage and KV for metadata, supporting drag-and-drop uploads, batch operations, and pre-upload editing. Features an admin dashboard with image management, API key authentication, and anti-hotlinking protection. Ideal for personal use and developer integration.

metadata.name: Picsur
metadata.description: An easy to use, selfhostable image sharing service like Imgur with built in converting

summary.zh: Picsur 是一款轻量级自托管图床服务，可作为 Imgur 的开源替代方案。支持 QOI、JPG、PNG、WEBP、GIF 等多种图片格式，具备图片转换、编辑（缩放、旋转、翻转、灰度等）功能。内置用户权限管理、Exif 信息剥离、CORS 限制和 ShareX 端点，提供 ARM64/AMD64 Docker 镜像便于部署。
summary.en: Picsur is a lightweight, self-hostable image sharing service serving as an open-source Imgur alternative. It supports multiple formats including QOI, JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, and offers built-in image conversion and editing (resize, rotate, flip, greyscale). Features include user role management, EXIF stripping, CORS restrictions, and ShareX endpoint with ARM64/AMD64 Docker images for easy deployment.

metadata.name: PixPro
metadata.description: PixPro 一款个人需求的高效图床，集成了强大的图片压缩功能与优雅的前台。后台管理瀑布流展示和AJAX刷新，能有效降低存储与带宽成本。

summary.zh: PixPro是一款基于PHP的高效图床系统，支持本地存储、阿里云OSS、S3、又拍云等多种存储后端。集成强大的图片压缩功能，可输出WebP/AVIF等现代格式。前台支持拖拽、粘贴、链接等多种上传方式，后台采用瀑布流展示和AJAX刷新提升体验。使用SQLite轻量数据库，支持Docker一键部署，可与Typora/Twikoo完美集成。
summary.en: PixPro is an efficient PHP-based image hosting platform supporting multiple storage backends including local storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS, S3, and UPaiyun. It features powerful image compression with WebP/AVIF output, multiple upload methods (drag-drop, paste, URL), waterfall admin layout with AJAX refresh, SQLite lightweight database, Docker support, and seamless integration with Typora and Twikoo.

metadata.name: FakeHTTP
metadata.description: Obfuscate all your TCP connections into HTTP protocol.

summary.zh: 基于 Linux Netfilter Queue 实现的流量伪装工具，可将任意 TCP 连接混淆为 HTTP 协议流量。支持 IPv4/IPv6 双栈，提供灵活的命令行配置选项，适用于隐私保护、流量混淆或网络穿透等场景。
summary.en: A Linux-based traffic obfuscation tool that transforms TCP connections into HTTP protocol using Netfilter Queue. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6 with flexible CLI options, suitable for privacy protection and network traffic manipulation scenarios.

metadata.name: dream-han-cjk
metadata.description: Open-source pan-CJK font families with enormous range of weights, the CJK sans and serif you have dreamed of.

summary.zh: 梦源字体系列是基于 Adobe 思源黑体/宋体可变字体，通过插值算法将中间字重实例化为 27 种传统单字重字体的开源泛CJK字体项目。采用二次多项式插值（黑体）和线性插值（宋体）算法，绕过 avar 表干扰，提供更细腻的字重选择，同时修复了思源系列行高过大的问题。
summary.en: Dream Han CJK is an open-source pan-CJK font family derived from Adobe Source Han Sans/Serif variable fonts.
