It interpolates intermediate weights into 27 traditional static fonts using quadratic (sans) and linear (serif) interpolation algorithms, bypassing the avar table interference. Offers finer weight granularity and fixes the excessive line height issue.

metadata.name: music-dl
metadata.description: search and download music 从网易云音乐、QQ音乐、酷狗音乐、百度音乐、虾米音乐、咪咕音乐等搜索和下载歌曲

summary.zh: 基于Python3的命令行音乐搜索下载工具，聚合网易云、QQ音乐、酷狗、百度、虾米等多个音乐源，支持无损音乐和多线程搜索，具备去重排序、歌词封面下载、代理支持、过滤筛选及播放控制等功能。
summary.en: A Python3 CLI tool that aggregates multiple music sources including Netease, QQ Music, Kugou, Baidu, and Xiami for searching and downloading music. Supports lossless audio, multi-threaded search, deduplication, lyrics/cover download, proxy, filtering, and playback control.

metadata.name: landscape
metadata.description: The goal is to make it easier to configure your favorite Linux distribution as a router. Built with Rust and eBPF.

summary.zh: Landscape是基于Rust和eBPF技术构建的Linux路由器平台，实现零侵入式流量引导与精细化策略控制。支持基于SIP-CIDR、MAC的源匹配和DIP、域名、Geo规则的 destination匹配，提供每流DNS配置缓存、NAT4级别严格控制及Docker容器流量重定向。单目录部署，跨发行版运行，适合家庭及企业网络场景。
summary.en: Landscape is an eBPF-powered Linux router platform built with Rust, enabling zero-overhead traffic steering and granular policy control. It supports source matching via SIP-CIDR/MAC and destination matching using DIP, domains, and Geo rules. Features include per-flow DNS caching, strict NAT4 control, and Docker traffic redirection. Single-directory deployment runs across multiple Linux distributions.

metadata.name: custom-install
metadata.description: Installs a title directly to an SD card for the Nintendo 3DS

summary.zh: Nintendo 3DS 自制软件工具，可将 CIA 格式游戏/应用直接安装到 SD 卡。支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，提供 GUI 和命令行双界面。需配合从 3DS 提取的 boot9.bin、movable.sed 等密钥文件使用，兼容 SeedDB 导入以支持 2015 年后使用 seeds 的游戏。
summary.en: A Nintendo 3DS homebrew tool that installs CIA format titles directly to an SD card. Supports Windows/macOS/Linux with both GUI and CLI interfaces. Requires boot9.bin and movable.sed keys extracted from a 3DS system, with optional SeedDB support for newer titles released after 2015.

metadata.name: zellij
metadata.description: A terminal workspace with batteries included

summary.zh: Zellij 是一个用 Rust 编写的现代终端工作空间/多路复用器，定位为 tmux 和 screen 的替代品。它遵循"不牺牲简洁性换取强大功能"的理念，提供多面板布局、浮动/堆叠窗格、深度定制、布局自动化、多人协作和 WebAssembly 插件系统。内置 Web 客户端可实现无终端访问。
summary.en: Zellij is a modern Rust-based terminal workspace and multiplexer designed as a tmux/screen alternative. Following the philosophy of no sacrifice of simplicity for power, it offers multi-pane layouts, floating/stacked windows, deep customizability, layout automation, multiplayer collaboration, and a WebAssembly plugin system with a built-in web client.

metadata.name: lrc-maker
metadata.description: 歌词滚动姬｜可能是你所能见到的最好用的歌词制作工具

summary.zh: LRC Maker（歌词滚动姬）是一款在线歌词制作工具，支持拖拽导入音频文件，通过空格键快速插入时间戳，方向键控制播放进度。跨平台兼容现代浏览器，可部署至任意CDN或静态服务器，适合音乐爱好者和歌词制作者高效制作LRC格式歌词文件。
summary.en: LRC Maker is a web-based lyric editing tool for creating scrolling LRC files with time tags. Users can drag and drop audio files, use spacebar to insert timestamps, and control playback with arrow keys. Cross-platform compatible with modern browsers, deployable to any CDN or static server. Ideal for music enthusiasts and lyric creators to efficiently produce LRC format files.

metadata.name: fscan
metadata.description: 一款内网综合扫描工具，方便一键自动化、全方位漏扫扫描。(An intranet comprehensive scanning tool, enabling one-click automated, all-round vulnerability scanning)

summary.zh: Fscan是一款Go语言开发的一站式内网综合扫描工具，集成主机发现、端口扫描、服务识别、弱口令爆破、漏洞检测与利用等核心功能。支持28种服务爆破、133个常用端口、3139条指纹库，内置MS17-010/SMBGhost等高危漏洞POC。通过插件化架构、滑动窗口调度和正则预编译等优化，实现高效并发扫描，适用于内网渗透测试与安全评估。
summary.en: Fscan is a comprehensive intranet scanning tool written in Go, featuring host discovery, port scanning, service identification, credential brute-forcing, and vulnerability exploitation. It supports 28 service types, 133 common ports, and 3139 fingerprints with built-in critical vulnerability POCs like MS17-010 and SMBGhost. Built with a plugin architecture and performance optimizations including sliding window scheduling and precompiled regex, enabling efficient concurrent scanning for penetration testing and security assessment.

metadata.name: ztncui
metadata.description: ZeroTier network controller UI

summary.zh: ztncui是一个基于Node.js和Express构建的ZeroTier网络控制器Web管理界面，提供网络配置、成员管理、访问控制等核心功能。支持Docker部署和RPM/DEB包安装，可通过PM2实现生产环境自动化运维。
summary.en: ztncui is a web-based user interface for managing a standalone ZeroTier network controller. Built with Node.js and Express, it provides graphical management for network configuration, member management, and access control. Supports Docker deployment and package-based installation, with production-ready automation via PM2.

metadata.name: gopeed
metadata.description: A fast, modern download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet, and ed2k. Cross-platform, built with Golang and Flutter.

summary.zh: Gopeed（Go Speed）是一款由Golang和Flutter构建的高速下载器，支持HTTP、BitTorrent、Magnet、ed2k等多协议，覆盖Windows、MacOS、Linux全平台。除基础下载功能外，支持通过REST API和扩展插件系统进行高度定制化，满足从普通用户到开发者的多样化需求。
summary.en: Gopeed (Go Speed) is a high-speed download manager built with Golang and Flutter, supporting HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet, and ed2k protocols across Windows, MacOS, and Linux. Beyond core downloading, it offers deep customization via REST APIs and extension plugins for both end users and developers.

metadata.name: iperf3-static
metadata.description: Static builds of iperf3 binaries for Windows, Linux and MacOSX to do network testing on remote servers.

summary.zh: 提供 iperf3 网络性能测试工具的跨平台静态编译二进制文件，支持 Linux、Windows、MacOSX 及多种 CPU 架构。构建流程完全透明，从源码到发布全程可追溯，集成 Virustotal 安全扫描与 Zizmor 工作流审计，确保二进制文件安全可信。支持 Docker 镜像部署，适用于服务器网络带宽与延迟测试。
summary.en: Provides cross-platform static iperf3 binaries for network performance testing on Linux, Windows, and macOS with multi-architecture support. Features transparent build provenance, Virustotal scanning, and Zizmor workflow auditing for security. Available as standalone binaries or Docker images for bandwidth and latency testing on remote servers.

metadata.name: nature
metadata.description: The Nature Programming Language

summary.zh: Nature 是一门通用系统编程语言及其编译器，采用纯 C 实现高性能运行时与编译后端，无需 LLVM 依赖即可直接生成目标平台机器码并支持交叉编译。其内置协程、channel、select 等并发原语，实现每秒百万级协程切换；采用短 STW GC 与 tcmalloc 风格分配器保障内存高效管理；支持强类型系统、泛型、标签联合等高级类型特性，配套 npkg 包管理与 LSP 编辑器支持。
summary.en: Nature is a general-purpose system programming language with a self-developed compiler written in pure C, compiling directly to native machine code without LLVM dependency and supporting cross-compilation. It features built-in concurrency primitives (go/channel/select), millions of coroutine switches per second, short-STW GC, tcmalloc-style allocator, strong type system with generics and tagged unions, plus centralized package management and LSP support.

metadata.name: cilikube
metadata.description: cilikube is a k8s admin mutli cluster manage platform, ideal for learning Vue.js, Go, and Kubernetes

summary.zh: CiliKube是一个企业级开源Kubernetes多集群管理平台，采用Vue3+TypeScript前端和Go+Gin后端构建。平台提供直观的界面进行全面的Kubernetes资源管理，具备模块化可扩展架构。既适合企业级集群运维管理，也适合开发者学习Vue3/Go开发和Kubernetes云原生技术。
summary.en: CiliKube is an enterprise-grade open-source Kubernetes multi-cluster management platform built with Vue3/TypeScript frontend and Go/Gin backend. It provides an intuitive interface for comprehensive Kubernetes resource management with extensible modular architecture. Ideal for enterprise cluster operations and developers learning Vue3/Go development and cloud-native technologies.

metadata.name: sharkey-stelpolva
metadata.description: 🌎 Sharkey is an open source, decentralized social media platform that's free forever! 🚀

summary.zh: Sharkey Stelpolva 是一个基于 ActivityPub 协议的开源去中心化社交平台分支，专注于用户体验增强与中文本地化优化。集成 pgroonga 全文搜索、帖子时光机、私密化、软折叠等实用功能，支持 Docker 部署，与上游 Sharkey 完全兼容，适合自建社交网络实例。
summary.en: Sharkey Stelpolva is an open-source decentralized social platform fork based on ActivityPub protocol, focusing on enhanced user experience and Chinese localization. Features pgroonga full-text search, post timeline archive, privacy controls, soft mute, and Docker support. Fully compatible with upstream Sharkey, ideal for self-hosted social network instances.

metadata.name: BongoCat
metadata.description: 🐱 跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！

summary.zh: 基于 Tauri 框架开发的跨平台桌面宠物应用，模拟弹吉他的 Bongocat 卡通形象。用户敲击键盘或点击鼠标时，桌宠会做出相应的趣味动画反应，为枯燥的桌面操作增添互动乐趣。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 三大主流系统。
summary.en: A cross-platform desktop companion built with Tauri, featuring a cute Bongocat character that plays guitar. The mascot animates in response to keyboard and mouse input, adding playful interactivity to your desktop. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux with a lightweight footprint.

metadata.name: Netease_url
metadata.description: 网易云无损解析

summary.zh: 一款功能强大的网易云音乐解析工具，支持歌曲搜索、单曲/歌单/专辑解析及多音质下载（最高支持Hi-Res和超清母带）。提供Web界面和RESTful API两种使用方式，支持批量处理和Docker部署。工具需配合黑胶会员账号Cookie使用，可解析网易云音乐平台的高质量音频资源。
summary.en: A powerful NetEase Cloud Music resolution tool supporting song search, individual/album/playlist parsing and multi-quality downloads (up to Hi-Res and Super Master Quality). Features Web UI and RESTful API with batch processing and Docker deployment support. Requires a premium account cookie for high-quality audio access.

metadata.name: ente
metadata.description: 💚 End-to-end encrypted cloud for everything.

summary.zh: Ente 是一个开源端到端加密云平台，提供照片管理（Ente Photos）、双因素认证器（Ente Auth）和文件保险箱（Ente Locker）三款应用。支持 iOS/Android/Web/Linux/macOS/Windows 全平台，采用零知识加密架构，数据仅用户可访问，已通过 Cure53 等三家安全公司外部审计。支持自托管部署。
summary.en: Ente is an open-source end-to-end encrypted cloud platform featuring Ente Photos (Google Photos alternative), Ente Auth (2FA authenticator), and Ente Locker (secure documents). Cross-platform apps with zero-knowledge encryption, externally audited by Cure53 and others. Self-hosting supported.

metadata.name: WeClone
metadata.description: 🚀 One-stop solution for creating your AI twin from chat history 💡 Fine-tune LLMs with your chat logs to capture your unique style, then bind to a chatbot to bring your digital self to life.

summary.zh: WeClone 是一站式AI数字克隆解决方案，通过聊天记录微调LLM，捕捉个人独特的语言风格。支持Telegram、Discord、Slack等多平台部署，本地化处理保障隐私安全。提供从数据导出、预处理、模型训练到部署的完整端到端流程，让用户轻松拥有自己的AI数字分身。
summary.en: WeClone offers an all-in-one solution for creating AI digital avatars from chat history by fine-tuning LLMs to capture unique communication styles. It supports multi-platform deployment including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, with local processing for privacy protection. The end-to-end pipeline covers data export, preprocessing, model training, and deployment.

metadata.name: ChinaTextbook
metadata.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。

summary.zh: 中国K12及大学教材开源仓库，收录小学、初中、高中各年级数学等科目PDF教材。旨在打破教育资源垄断，促进教育公平，帮助海外华人子女学习国内教材，推动义务教育普及与教育资源均衡。
summary.en: An open-source repository of Chinese K-12 and university textbooks in PDF format, covering primary through high school mathematics and other subjects. Aims to break educational resource monopolies, promote equity, and help overseas Chinese students access domestic curriculum.

metadata.name: visualization-collection
metadata.description: 🌈 一个专注于前端视觉效果的集合应用，包含CSS动效、Canvas动画、Three.js3D、人工智能应用等上百个案例（持续更新）

summary.zh: 这是一个专注于前端视觉效果的综合性集合应用，收录上百个CSS动效、Canvas动画、Three.js 3D图形及AI人工智能应用案例。涵盖视觉设计、交互设计、量子纠缠等高级效果，支持在线体验和本地启动，为前端开发者提供丰富的学习参考和灵感来源，持续更新中。
summary.en: A comprehensive frontend visual effects collection featuring 100+ CSS animations, Canvas animations, Three.js 3D graphics, and AI application cases. Covering visual design, interactive design, and quantum entanglement effects, it provides rich learning resources for frontend developers with online experience and local startup support.

metadata.name: Wallos
metadata.description: Wallos: Open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Visualize your recurring expenses, manage your budget, and save money.

summary.zh: Wallos是一款开源自托管的个人订阅追踪工具，帮助用户可视化周期性支出、管理预算。支持多币种及汇率转换（Fixer API）、订阅Logo自动搜索、统计图表、多种通知渠道（邮件/Discord/Telegram等）。内置OIDC/OAuth认证和AI智能推荐（ChatGPT/Gemini/Ollama），保障数据隐私的同时提供智能化体验。
summary.en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable subscription tracker for managing recurring expenses. It features multi-currency support with exchange rate integration, logo search, statistics, and notifications via email, Discord, Telegram, and more. Supports OIDC/OAuth authentication and AI recommendations through ChatGPT, Gemini, or local Ollama. Deploy via Docker or bare metal with PHP 8.3.

summary.zh: 一款用 Rust 编写的 macOS 磁盘清理工具，自动扫描并删除系统中的缓存、日志、临时文件等无用数据，帮助用户释放存储空间。命令行交互，操作轻量高效，适合需要优化 Mac 磁盘占用的用户。
summary.en: A Rust-powered macOS disk cleanup utility that automatically scans and removes cached files, logs, and temporary data to free up storage space. Lightweight command-line tool designed for users seeking efficient disk space management on Mac.

summary.zh: XcodeLLMEligible 是一个 macOS 系统工具，通过覆盖 eligibilityd 进程实现 Xcode LLM、Apple Intelligence 和 iPhone Mirroring 在不受官方支持的 Mac 上的永久使用。支持 macOS 15.0-15.3.1，提供两种方案：util tool 需一次性禁用 SIP，override file 方案无需 SIP 禁用。该项目仅供学习研究，使用者需自行承担风险。
summary.en: XcodeLLMEligible is a macOS utility that enables Xcode LLM, Apple Intelligence, and iPhone Mirroring on unsupported Macs by overriding the eligibilityd process. Supports macOS 15.0-15.3.1 with two methods: util tool (one-time SIP disable) and override file (no SIP disable required). For educational and research purposes only.

metadata.name: yt-dlp-web-ui
metadata.description: A terrible web ui and RPC server for yt-dlp. Designed to be self-hosted.

summary.zh: 基于 yt-dlp 的 Web 界面与 RPC 服务器，支持自托管部署。提供可视化的视频/音频下载管理功能，可通过 RPC 接口实现程序化控制，适合搭建个人媒体下载中心或私有下载服务。
summary.en: A web UI and RPC server for yt-dlp, designed for self-hosted deployment. Offers visual video/audio download management with RPC API support, ideal for building personal media download centers or private download services.

metadata.name: enableAppleAI
metadata.description: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, for version between  MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26.5 beta3

summary.zh: 一款在 macOS 15.4+ 至 26.5 beta3 上为中国大陆销售 Mac 设备强制开启 Apple Intelligence 的自动化脚本。通过修改 eligibilityd 系统缓存文件绕过地区限制，支持两种方法（lldb 注入或直接修改 plist），破解完成后可重新启用 SIP。
summary.en: An automation script enabling Apple Intelligence on China-sold Macs running macOS 15.4+ to 26.5 beta3. It bypasses regional restrictions by modifying eligibilityd system cache files, offering two methods (lldb injection or direct plist modification), with SIP re-enableable after setup.

metadata.name: dpanel
metadata.description: 轻量化 docker 可视化管理面板。lightweight  panel for docker

summary.zh: DPanel 是一款轻量化 Docker/Podman 可视化管理面板，支持容器、镜像、网络等资源的图形化管理。它集成域名反向代理与 SSL 证书自动申请功能，提供标准版和精简版两种部署模式，支持一键 Docker 部署和脚本快速安装，适用于个人开发者及小型团队的容器运维场景。
summary.en: DPanel is a lightweight visual management panel for Docker and Podman containers. It provides intuitive GUI for managing containers, images, networks and volumes with built-in reverse proxy and automated SSL certificate issuance. Offering both standard and lite editions, it supports one-click Docker deployment and quick setup scripts for individual developers and small teams.

metadata.name: ttyd
metadata.description: Share your terminal over the web

summary.zh: ttyd 是一个通过网络分享终端的命令行工具，基于 libuv 和 WebGL2 构建高性能 Web 终端。支持 SSL 加密、基础认证、ZMODEM 文件传输和 Sixel 图片输出，可运行任意命令并提供完整的跨平台支持（macOS、Linux、BSD、Windows、OpenWrt），适用于远程终端访问、技术演示和嵌入式设备管理。
summary.en: ttyd is a command-line tool for sharing terminal over the web, built on libuv and WebGL2 for high performance. It supports SSL encryption, basic authentication, ZMODEM file transfer, and Sixel image output. Cross-platform support includes macOS, Linux, BSD, Windows, and OpenWrt, making it ideal for remote terminal access, technical demonstrations, and embedded device management.

metadata.name: homer
metadata.description: A very simple static homepage for your server.

summary.zh: Homer是一个极简的静态服务器导航首页，通过YAML配置文件管理服务链接。提供模糊搜索、智能卡片、PWA安装、主题自定义等实用功能，支持Docker一键部署。适合Homelab、NAS及自托管服务场景，快速搭建个人服务统一入口。
summary.en: Homer is a dead-simple static homepage for servers, configured via YAML files. It offers fuzzy search, smart cards, PWA installation, and theme customization with Docker support. Ideal for Homelab, NAS, and self-hosted service dashboards to centralize access.

metadata.name: uptime-kuma
metadata.description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool

summary.zh: Uptime Kuma 是一款开源自托管监控工具，支持 HTTP/TCP/Ping/DNS 等多种协议监测，20秒间隔检测服务可用性。集成90+通知渠道，支持多语言和状态页面展示，提供美观的响应式界面和2FA安全认证，可通过 Docker 快速部署，适用于网站和服务的运维监控场景。
summary.en: Uptime Kuma is an open-source self-hosted monitoring tool supporting HTTP/TCP/Ping/DNS protocols with 20-second check intervals. It offers 90+ notification integrations, multi-language support, customizable status pages, and 2FA authentication. Deployable via Docker or Node.js, ideal for monitoring website and service uptime.

metadata.name: docker-flare
metadata.description: Flare ✨ Lightweight, high performance and fast self-hosted navigation pages, resource utilization rate is <1% CPU, MEM <30 M, Docker Image < 10M

summary.zh: Flare 是一款轻量级高性能的个人导航页面工具，采用 Go 语言开发，Docker 部署简单。资源占用极低（CPU<1%，内存<30M，镜像<10M），支持 x86/ARM 全平台。无数据库依赖，数据完全透明，支持在线编辑和 Material Design Icons 6k+ 图标，适用于 HomeLab 和私有部署场景。
summary.en: Flare is a lightweight, high-performance self-hosted navigation page tool built with Go and containerized via Docker. It boasts extremely low resource consumption (CPU<1%, MEM<30M, Image<10M) and supports both x86 and ARM platforms. With no database dependency and transparent data storage, it offers online editing capabilities and includes 6k+ Material Design Icons for a polished interface.

metadata.name: sun-panel
metadata.description: A server, NAS navigation panel, Homepage, browser homepage. | 一个服务器、NAS导航面板、Homepage、浏览器首页。

summary.zh: Sun-Panel是一款服务器/NAS导航面板，可作为浏览器首页使用。提供可视化配置、Iconify图标库集成、内网外网模式切换、多账号隔离等功能，支持Docker一键部署和ARM系统兼容。界面简洁美观，支持自定义JS/CSS，无外部数据库依赖，开源版本目前为v1.3.0。
summary.en: Sun-Panel is a server/NAS navigation dashboard that serves as a browser homepage. Features visual configuration, Iconify icon library integration, one-click intranet/extranet switching, multi-account isolation, and Docker deployment with ARM compatibility. Clean interface with custom JS/CSS support, no external database required. Open-source version currently at v1.3.0.

metadata.name: Personal-page
metadata.description: 🍊个人简介页面模板，女生自用99新（划掉），带二维码、打赏页、收款页。个人简介、个人介绍网页.

summary.zh: 个人简介页面模板，支持个人介绍、收款码和打赏功能。采用纯静态架构，CDN友好，可一键部署至GitHub Pages或OSS。页面包含流畅动画和摇晃交互彩蛋，适合博主、创作者快速搭建个性化主页。提供详细Wiki文档，改动简单。
summary.en: A personal introduction page template featuring profile, payment QR codes, and donation pages. Built with pure static architecture, CDN-friendly and deployable on GitHub Pages or OSS. Includes smooth animations and shake-to-pour easter egg. Perfect for bloggers and creators to build personalized homepages quickly.

metadata.name: mastomods
metadata.description: CSS tweaks and custom themes for Mastodon.

summary.zh: MastoMods是专为Mastodon去中心化社交平台设计的CSS主题与样式修改工具集。提供模块化的SCSS/CSS代码，支持管理员一键部署自定义主题（如linernotes_dark、MFC等），也可供用户通过浏览器扩展导入使用。高度可定制化，让去中心化社交平台拥有独特的视觉风格。
summary.en: MastoMods is a CSS theme and styling toolkit for Mastodon, a decentralized microblogging platform. It provides modular SCSS/CSS code allowing admins to deploy custom themes (e.g., linernotes_dark, MFC) or users to import via browser extensions. Highly customizable, enabling unique visual styles for decentralized social networks.

metadata.name: mastodon
metadata.description: Chuckya, a glitch-soc fork used on wetdry.world

summary.zh: Chuckya 是 Mastodon Glitch Edition 的一个软分支，专注于引入更多实验性功能以提升用户体验。核心特性包括：表情符号反应、气泡时间线、GIF 选择器、Mastodon Modern 主题、可配置媒体附件限制，以及增强的管理员审核工具。支持轮询与媒体附件组合、单选项投票等灵活功能。作为湿干世界的定制版本，可作为 Mastodon 的即插即用替代方案部署。
summary.en: Chuckya is a soft fork of Mastodon Glitch Edition introducing experimental features for enhanced user experience. Key additions include emoji reactions, bubble timeline, GIF picker, Mastodon Modern theme, configurable media limits, and advanced moderation tools. Supports polls with media attachments and single-option polls. Designed for wetdry.world but deployable as a drop-in, backwards-compatible Mastodon replacement.

metadata.name: home
metadata.description: 个人主页，我的个人主页，个人主页源码，主页模板，homepage

summary.zh: 基于 Vue.js 构建的个人主页项目，集成载入动画、实时天气、音乐播放器、Hitokoto 一言、时光进度条等功能，支持响应式布局适配多端设备。可通过 Docker、Vercel 或 GitHub Actions 实现快速部署，配置高德天气 API 与 MetingJS 音乐播放器实现个性化展示。
summary.en: A Vue.js-based personal homepage featuring loading animations, real-time weather, music player, Hitokoto quotes, and progress bar. Supports responsive design across devices with flexible deployment options including Docker, Vercel, and GitHub Actions. Integrates AMap weather API and MetingJS for customized experience.

metadata.name: mastodon-bird-ui
metadata.description: 🐘🐦 Mastodon web UI, but strongly inspired by Twitter (when it was still good!)

summary.zh: 这是一个为 Mastodon 去中心化社交网络设计的 CSS 主题项目，将默认界面改造成类似 Twitter 经典外观。提供暗色/亮色模式、PWA 支持和可访问性版本，实例管理员可将其作为可选站点主题集成到 Mastodon 设置中，适合希望保留熟悉界面体验的用户迁移到去中心化平台。
summary.en: A CSS theming project that transforms Mastodon's default interface to resemble Twitter's classic design. Features dark/light mode, PWA support, and an accessibility version. Instance admins can integrate it as an optional site theme, ideal for users seeking a familiar experience while transitioning to the decentralized social network.

metadata.name: flyde
metadata.description: Open-source Visual programming for backend logic that integrates with existing codebases. Flyde bridges the gap between technical and non-technical team members. Product managers, designers, and backend developers can collaborate on the same visual flows.

summary.zh: Flyde 是一款开源可视化编程工具，专注于后端逻辑和 AI 工作流开发。它以 VS Code 扩展形式运行，无缝集成到 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码库中，支持 AI 代理、提示链和代理工作流的视觉化构建。弥合技术人员与非技术人员的协作鸿沟，让产品经理、设计师和开发者能在同一可视化流程中协作。
summary.en: Flyde is an open-source visual programming tool for backend logic and AI workflow development. Running as a VS Code extension, it integrates seamlessly into TypeScript/JavaScript codebases, enabling visual building of AI agents, prompt chains, and agentic workflows. Bridges the collaboration gap between technical and non-technical team members for unified workflow development.

metadata.name: AFFiNE
metadata.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

summary.zh: AFFiNE 是一款开源本地优先的新一代知识库工具，将文档编辑、白板画布与多视图数据库深度融合，同时支持规划、创作与整理功能。作为 Notion 和 Miro 的开源替代方案，它注重隐私保护，支持端到端加密、自托管部署及跨平台多人实时协作，并内置 AI 辅助写作和思维导图生成能力。
summary.en: AFFiNE is an open-source, local-first knowledge base that seamlessly merges docs, whiteboard canvas, and multi-view databases. Positioned as an open alternative to Notion & Miro, it emphasizes privacy with end-to-end encryption, supports self-hosting and cross-platform collaboration, and integrates AI-powered writing assistance and mind map generation for enhanced productivity.

metadata.name: wemeet-wayland-screenshare
metadata.description: 实现Linux Wayland下腾讯会议屏幕共享（非虚拟相机）. Hook library that enables screenshare with Tencent Wemeet on Linux Wayland, without the need of using virtual cameras.

summary.zh: 通过Hook X11共享内存API实现Wayland环境下腾讯会议屏幕共享的开源方案。核心原理是劫持XShmAttach/XShmGetImage/XShmDetach函数，结合PipeWire和xdg-desktop-portal捕获屏幕内容并注入给wemeet，无需虚拟相机。已支持KDE/GNOME/Hyprland/wlroots等主流Wayland桌面环境。
summary.en: An open-source solution enabling Tencent Wemeet screensharing on Linux Wayland by hooking X11 shared memory APIs. It intercepts XShmAttach/XShmGetImage/XShmDetach and uses PipeWire/xdg-desktop-portal to capture and inject screen content without virtual cameras. Supports KDE, GNOME, Hyprland, and wlroots-based WMs.

metadata.name: hexo-generator-sitemap
metadata.description: Sitemap generator for Hexo.

summary.zh: Hexo 静态博客的站点地图生成插件，自动生成 sitemap.xml 和 sitemap.txt 两种格式，支持自定义模板、标签分类索引、rel-sitemap 头部关联，并可通过 front matter 灵活排除特定页面，有效提升网站 SEO 效果。
summary.en: A sitemap generator plugin for Hexo static blog framework that automatically produces sitemap.xml and sitemap.txt files, supporting custom templates, tag/category indexing, and rel-sitemap header integration with page-level exclusion via front matter to enhance SEO performance.

metadata.name: godns
metadata.description: A dynamic DNS client tool that supports AliDNS, Cloudflare, Google Domains, DNSPod, HE.net & DuckDNS & DreamHost, etc, written in Go.

summary.zh: Go语言编写的动态DNS客户端，支持Cloudflare、DNSPod、AliDNS等15+家DNS服务商，可同时管理IPv4/IPv6记录。提供Docker部署和内置Web管理面板，适合自建DDNS服务，实现动态公网IP与域名的自动同步映射。
summary.en: A dynamic DNS client written in Go, supporting 15+ providers like Cloudflare, DNSPod, and AliDNS. It manages both IPv4 and IPv6 records with a built-in web panel. Ideal for self-hosting DDNS to automatically sync dynamic IPs with domain names.

metadata.name: tinyauth
metadata.description: The tiniest authentication and authorization server you have ever seen.

summary.zh: Tinyauth 是一个极致轻量的认证与授权服务器，支持 OAuth、LDAP 和细粒度访问控制。可作为中间件集成到 Traefik、Nginx、Caddy 等主流代理中实现零侵入式认证，也支持独立部署运行。提供 Docker 一键部署和多语言本地化支持，专为自托管环境和家庭实验室设计，是搭建轻量级身份认证服务的理想选择。
summary.en: Tinyauth is the tiniest authentication and authorization server, supporting OAuth, LDAP, and fine-grained access controls. It seamlessly integrates as middleware with Traefik, Nginx, and Caddy proxies or runs standalone. With Docker deployment and multi-language localization, it's designed for self-hosted environments and homelabs seeking lightweight authentication solutions.

metadata.name: GPT-SoVITS
metadata.description: 1 min voice data can also be used to train a good TTS model! (few shot voice cloning)

summary.zh: GPT-SoVITS是一款强大的少样本语音克隆与文本转语音工具，仅需1分钟音频即可训练高质量TTS模型。支持零样本TTS（5秒样本即时转换）和跨语言推理，涵盖中英日韩粤语。集成WebUI工具包括人声伴奏分离、自动标注等功能，RTF推理速度达0.028（RTX 4060Ti），提供Colab和Docker部署方案。
summary.en: GPT-SoVITS is a powerful few-shot voice cloning and TTS tool that achieves high-quality voice synthesis with just 1 minute of training data. Features zero-shot TTS (5-second sample), cross-lingual inference across Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and Cantonese. Includes WebUI with voice separation, auto-labeling tools, achieving RTF 0.028 on RTX 4060Ti with support for Colab and Docker deployment.

metadata.name: vaultwarden
metadata.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs

summary.zh: Vaultwarden 是用 Rust 编写的非官方 Bitwarden 兼容服务器，原名 bitwarden_rs。完全兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端，支持密码管理、加密存储等核心功能。相比官方服务资源占用更低，非常适合个人或小型组织自托管部署密码管理服务。
summary.en: Vaultwarden is an unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs. It provides a lightweight alternative to the official Bitwarden server with full client compatibility. Perfect for self-hosted password management with significantly lower resource usage, supporting all official Bitwarden client applications.

metadata.name: HowToCook
metadata.description: 程序员在家做饭方法指南。Programmer's guide about how to cook at home (Simplified Chinese only).

summary.zh: 程序员发起的开源烹饪指南项目，用精准的形式化语言重写传统菜谱，解决描述模糊、材料缺失等痛点。涵盖素菜、肉菜、主食等分类及厨房技巧，支持 Web 可视化浏览和 Docker 本地部署，社区驱动持续更新。
summary.en: An open-source cooking guide created by programmers, using precise, formal language to rewrite traditional recipes. Solves pain points like ambiguous descriptions and missing ingredients. Covers vegetable dishes, meat dishes, staples, and kitchen tips, with web visualization and Docker deployment. Community-driven with continuous updates.

metadata.name: proxy-script-template
metadata.description: A template to assist you in writing proxy tool scripts

summary.zh: 一个帮助开发者快速编写Proxy Tool脚本的模板项目。通过提供通用的Client类，兼容Quantumult X、Surge等不同代理客户端的API差异，减少脚本开发中的重复工作。内置URL解析、JSON持久化存储、定时器、protobuf解码等工具，支持esbuild打包，适用于网络代理自动化脚本开发。
summary.en: A template for rapid Proxy Tool script development with a universal Client class that abstracts API differences across clients like Quantumult X and Surge. Includes built-in utilities for URL parsing, JSON storage, timers, and protobuf decoding. Uses esbuild for bundling and targets Node.js-based script development.

metadata.name: NapCatQQ
metadata.description: Modern protocol-side framework based on NTQQ

summary.zh: NapCatQQ 是基于 NTQQ 的现代化 QQ 机器人协议框架，提供完整的 Bot API 接口，支持消息收发、群组管理等核心功能。采用字符串类型处理 ID，支持 Stream API，可 Docker 部署，适合低内存环境持续运行。
summary.en: NapCatQQ is a modern QQ bot protocol framework based on NTQQ, providing complete Bot API interfaces for message handling and group management. Uses string-based ID handling, supports Stream API, Docker deployment, and runs efficiently in low-memory environments.

metadata.name: snacks.nvim
metadata.description: 🍿 A collection of QoL plugins for Neovim

summary.zh: snacks.nvim 是 Neovim 的 QoL 插件集合，提供 30+ 独立模块，涵盖文件管理、Git 集成、UI 增强、调试工具等场景。核心亮点包括：文件浏览器、图片预览、LazyGit 集成、平滑滚动、状态栏美化等开箱即用功能，由知名 Neovim 开发者 folke 打造，高度模块化设计。
summary.en: snacks.nvim is a collection of 30+ QoL plugins for Neovim, featuring file explorer, image viewer, Git integration, dashboard, smooth scrolling, and more. Built by folke with a highly modular design, it provides out-of-the-box enhancements for productivity, debugging, and UI customization.

metadata.name: neo-tree.nvim
metadata.description: Neovim plugin to manage the file system and other tree like structures.

summary.zh: Neo-tree是Neovim的树形文件管理器插件，支持侧边栏、浮动窗口、netrw风格等多种布局展示。具备自动刷新、跟随当前文件、gitignore过滤、LSP文件操作集成等特性，注重用户体验细节，确保窗口行为流畅稳定，可替代netrw成为主要文件浏览器。
summary.en: Neo-tree is a Neovim plugin for browsing file systems and tree structures in various styles including sidebars, floating windows, and netrw-style splits. It features auto-refresh, file following, gitignore filtering, and LSP integration. Focused on smooth UX with glitch-free window behavior, serving as a modern netrw replacement.

metadata.name: yazi
metadata.description: 💥 Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.

summary.zh: Yazi 是一款用 Rust 编写的极速终端文件管理器，基于异步 I/O 架构。它提供全异步任务调度、内置多终端图片预览、代码高亮、Lua 插件系统、虚拟文件系统及包管理器。支持多标签页、批量操作、Vim 风格交互，与 ripgrep、fd、fzf、zoxide 等工具深度集成。
summary.en: Yazi is a blazing-fast terminal file manager written in Rust, leveraging async I/O architecture. It offers full async task scheduling, multi-terminal image preview, code highlighting, Lua plugin system, virtual filesystem, and package manager. Supports multi-tab, bulk operations, Vim-style interaction, with deep integration of ripgrep, fd, fzf, and zoxide.

metadata.name: Bili23-Downloader
metadata.description: Bili23-Downloader 是一款跨平台的 B 站视频下载工具，兼容 Windows（含 Win7）、Linux 和 macOS。它拥有现代化 UI，支持音视频流分离下载、多线程加速、弹幕与字幕获取、封面提取、元数据刮削等丰富功能，并可自定义文件命名与分类，满足多样化需求。

summary.zh: Bili23-Downloader 是一款基于 PySide6 的跨平台 B 站视频下载工具，采用 Fluent Design 现代 UI，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS。核心功能包括多线程加速下载、音视频流分离、弹幕字幕多格式获取、封面嵌入、NFO 元数据刮削（兼容 Kodi/Jellyfin/Emby），以及高度自定义的文件命名与分类规则。完全开源免费，基于 GPL-3.0 协议。
summary.en: Bili23-Downloader is a cross-platform Bilibili video downloader built with PySide6, featuring a modern Fluent Design UI. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS with multi-threaded acceleration, audio/video stream separation, danmaku/subtitle extraction in multiple formats, thumbnail embedding, and NFO metadata scraping compatible with Kodi/Jellyfin/Emby. Fully open-source under GPL-3.0 license.

metadata.name: yazi.nvim
metadata.description: A Neovim Plugin for the yazi terminal file manager

summary.zh: 一款将极速终端文件管理器 yazi 集成到 Neovim 的插件。在浮动窗口中打开 yazi，悬停文件自动高亮同步，支持多种打开方式（缓冲区、垂直/水平分割、新标签、quickfix）。深度集成 telescope、fzf-lua、snacks.picker 等主流插件，实现目录搜索替换、缓冲区智能同步。替代 netrw 作为目录浏览器，支持自定义键绑定和 yazi 插件管理。
summary.en: A Neovim plugin integrating the blazing fast terminal file manager yazi. Opens yazi in a floating window with hover-highlight sync across splits. Offers multiple file opening methods including buffers, splits, tabs, and quickfix. Deeply integrates with telescope, fzf-lua, snacks.picker for directory search and refactoring. Syncs renamed/deleted files with buffers and LSP servers, optionally replacing netrw as the directory explorer.

metadata.name: indent-blankline.nvim
metadata.description: Indent guides  for Neovim

summary.zh: 一款Neovim缩进引导线插件，利用虚拟文本特性渲染可视化缩进标识，不依赖conceal机制。支持treesitter作用域高亮、彩虹多色缩进、背景色填充等高级功能，可深度定制样式，与主流主题无缝兼容，显著提升代码层级结构的可读性和编辑体验。
summary.en: A Neovim plugin providing visual indent guides using virtual text instead of conceal. Features include treesitter-based scope highlighting, rainbow multi-color indentation, background color fills, and extensive customization options. Seamlessly integrates with themes and significantly improves code readability by clearly visualizing indentation hierarchy.

metadata.name: mini.nvim
metadata.description: Library of 40+ independent Lua modules improving Neovim experience with minimal effort

summary.zh: mini.nvim 是面向 Neovim 0.10+ 的 Lua 模块库，收录 40+ 独立功能模块（如补全、导航、文本编辑增强等）。每个模块可独立使用，共享统一配置接口和设计理念，零启动开销。是 Neovim 编辑器增强的"瑞士军刀"式解决方案。
summary.en: mini.nvim is a library of 40+ independent Lua modules enhancing Neovim 0.10+ experience with minimal effort. Each module addresses common editing tasks—completion, navigation, text editing, and more—while sharing consistent configuration approaches. Modules work standalone without overhead, making it a versatile "Swiss Army knife" for Neovim customization.

metadata.name: bsky-pds
metadata.description: Bluesky PDS running in Docker externally accessed by a Cloudflare tunnel

summary.zh: 该项目提供在 Docker 容器中自托管 Bluesky PDS（个人数据服务器）的完整方案。通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 实现安全的外部访问，支持本地存储和 S3 兼容对象存储。适合有一定技术基础的用户搭建去中心化社交网络节点。
summary.en: This project provides a complete solution for self-hosting a Bluesky Personal Data Server (PDS) in Docker containers. It leverages Cloudflare Tunnel for secure external access and supports both local and S3-compatible blob storage. Ideal for tech-savvy users deploying decentralized social network nodes.

metadata.name: wofi-themes
metadata.description: Style of wofi. Theme of wofi. Customize of wofi.

summary.zh: 为 Wayland 桌面环境下 wofi 启动器设计的 CSS 主题集合。提供 cyan、彩虹、亚克力等多款视觉效果，以及蛇年等中国风特别主题。支持直接替换 style.css 或通过命令行指定样式文件，快速自定义启动器外观，适合 Linux 桌面个性化配置。
summary.en: A CSS theme collection for wofi, a Wayland application launcher. Features multiple visual styles including cyan, rainbow, acrylic effects, plus special Chinese New Year themes. Supports both copying CSS files to config directory or using command-line styling options for quick launcher customization.

metadata.name: nerd-fonts-installer
metadata.description: Nerd Fonts Installer is a bash script that allows users to easily install any nerd font in a Debian-based distribution by following a few simple steps.

summary.zh: Nerd Fonts Installer 是一款跨平台字体安装脚本，支持 Linux/macOS（ Bash）和 Windows（PowerShell）。提供交互式菜单，可快速安装 51+ 款 Nerd Fonts 图标字体，支持 .ttf/.otf 格式，自动下载最新版本并完成系统注册与字体缓存刷新。
summary.en: Nerd Fonts Installer provides cross-platform scripts to easily install 51+ Nerd Fonts from command line. It includes a Bash script for Linux/macOS and a PowerShell script for Windows, featuring interactive menus, colored output, automatic font extraction, and system registration.

metadata.name: kickstart.nvim
metadata.description: A launch point for your personal nvim configuration

summary.zh: kickstart.nvim 是 Neovim 的轻量级配置起点，采用单文件架构并提供完整文档。它不是发行版，而是帮助用户理解 Neovim 配置原理的起点模板。需要 ripgrep、fd-find、tree-sitter 等外部依赖，支持 Linux/Mac/Windows 多平台，安装简便。
summary.en: kickstart.nvim is a lightweight configuration starting point for Neovim, featuring a single-file architecture with comprehensive documentation. It's not a distribution but a template to help users understand Neovim configuration principles. Requires external dependencies like ripgrep, fd-find, and tree-sitter, supporting Linux/Mac/Windows with straightforward installation.

metadata.name: newsnow
metadata.description: Elegant reading of real-time and hottest news

summary.zh: NewsNow 是一个优雅的新闻聚合阅读平台，实时抓取并展示热点新闻内容。核心特性包括：简洁优雅的UI设计优化阅读体验、GitHub OAuth登录实现数据同步、30分钟智能缓存机制、自适应爬取间隔防止IP封禁，以及MCP服务器支持实现AI集成。支持Cloudflare D1等数据库，可Docker部署或部署到Vercel/Cloudflare Pages。
summary.en: NewsNow is an elegant news aggregation platform that fetches and displays real-time trending news. Key features include: clean UI for optimal reading, GitHub OAuth login with data sync, 30-minute smart caching, adaptive scraping intervals to prevent IP bans, and MCP server support for AI integration. Supports Cloudflare D1 and other databases, deployable via Docker, Vercel, or Cloudflare Pages.

metadata.name: Lagrange.Core
metadata.description: An Implementation of NTQQ Protocol, with Pure C#, Derived from Konata.Core

summary.zh: Lagrange.Core是纯C#实现的NTQQ协议库，派生自Konata.Core，支持.NET 6/7。项目完整实现了QQ通信协议的核心功能，包括账号登录、消息收发、群聊私聊等，为开发者提供构建QQ机器人的底层基础设施，同时兼容OneBot标准。
summary.en: Lagrange.Core is a pure C# implementation of the NTQQ protocol, derived from Konata.Core with .NET 6/7 support. It fully implements core QQ communication functions including login, messaging, group/private chat, providing developers with infrastructure for building QQ bots while maintaining OneBot standard compatibility.

metadata.name: rime-ice
metadata.description: Rime 配置：雾凇拼音 | 长期维护的简体词库

summary.zh: 雾凇拼音是一份开箱即用的简体中文 Rime 输入法配置，支持全拼和双拼多种方案。它拥有长期维护的百万级精校词库、丰富的扩展功能（Emoji、模糊音、自动纠错、繁简转换等），并提供详细的配置注释。跨平台适配多款前端，隐私友好离线可用，是追求稳定、高效中文输入体验的理想选择。
summary.en: A production-ready Rime input method configuration for Simplified Chinese, featuring full pinyin and double pinyin schemes. It offers a long-term maintained million-level curated dictionary, rich features like fuzzy pinyin, emoji, and simplified-traditional conversion. Cross-platform with detailed comments for customization, prioritizing privacy and offline reliability.

metadata.name: mw2fcitx
metadata.description: Fcitx 5 pinyin dictionary generator for MediaWiki instances. (Releases for dict of zh.moegirl.org.cn / Check release list for latest releases)

summary.zh: 将MediaWiki百科词条转换为fcitx5/RIME输入法拼音词典的工具，支持从MediaWiki API或本地文件获取词条，通过pypinyin实现拼音转换，支持OpenCC繁简转换，可生成萌娘百科等中文百科网站的输入法词库。
summary.en: A tool converting MediaWiki wiki entries into fcitx5/RIME pinyin input method dictionaries, supporting fetching from MediaWiki API or local files, using pypinyin for conversion, with OpenCC for traditional/simplified Chinese text conversion, primarily used for Moegirlpedia and similar Chinese encyclopedias.

metadata.name: LxgwWenKai
metadata.description: An unprofessional open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One. 一款非专业的开源中文字体，基于 FONTWORKS 出品字体 Klee One 衍生。

summary.zh: 霞鹜文楷是一款基于日本 Fontworks Klee One 衍生的开源中文字体，采用 OFL 1.1 开源协议免费商用。字体风格清新自然，适合屏幕阅读与正文排版。项目提供轻便版、GB版、TC版、韩文版及与西文字体合并版本等多变体，满足不同平台与场景需求。
summary.en: LXGW WenKai is an open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks Klee One, licensed under OFL 1.1 for free commercial use. With a fresh and natural style, it suits screen reading and body text layout. The project offers multiple variants including Lite, GB, TC, Korean versions, and combined versions with Western fonts for diverse platform needs.

metadata.name: plum
metadata.description: 東風破 /plum/: Rime configuration manager and input schema repository

summary.zh: 東風破（plum）是Rime输入法引擎的配置管理工具，提供统一的包管理和配方系统。用户可通过它安装、更新多种中文输入方案，包括拼音、注音、仓颉、粤语、吴语等。支持个人配置托管和第三方开发者方案分发，基于YAML配置实现高度可定制化的中文输入体验。
summary.en: Plum is a configuration manager for Rime input method engine, featuring a recipe-based package system. It enables users to install and update various Chinese input schemas including Pinyin, Zhuyin, Cangjie, Cantonese, and Wu dialect. Supports personal GitHub configurations and third-party schema packages with YAML-based customization.

metadata.name: awesome-mac
metadata.description:  This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use.

summary.zh: 精选 macOS 软件资源汇总项目，按类别系统整理开发、设计、效率、媒体、管理等各类优质应用，方便 macOS 用户发现和查找适合自己的工具软件。持续更新社区推荐的高质量应用。
summary.en: A curated collection of premium macOS software systematically organized by categories including development, design, productivity, media, and utilities for easy discovery and navigation.

metadata.name: ddns-go
metadata.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...

summary.zh: DDNS-GO是一款简洁易用的动态域名解析工具，自动获取公网IPv4/IPv6地址并同步至阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等20+主流域名服务商。支持多平台运行和Docker部署，可配置为系统服务后台运行，提供Web界面配置、日志查看和Webhook通知功能。
summary.en: DDNS-GO is a lightweight dynamic DNS client that automatically fetches public IPv4/IPv6 addresses and updates them to 20+ domain providers including Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, and Cloudflare. Supports multi-platform deployment, Docker installation, system service mode, with a web UI for configuration, log viewing, and webhook notifications.

metadata.name: azahar
metadata.description: An open-source 3DS emulator project based on Citra.

summary.zh: Azahar 是一款基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器，整合了 PabloMK7 的 Citra 分支和 Lime3DS 项目。支持 Windows、macOS、Android、Linux 全平台运行，提供 Flatpak、AppImage、APK 等多格式分发。旨在成为 3DS 模拟领域的标杆开源项目。
summary.en: Azahar is an open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra, merging PabloMK7's Citra fork and Lime3DS project. It supports Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux with multiple distribution formats including Flatpak, AppImage, and APK. The project aims to be the de-facto platform for 3DS emulation development.

metadata.name: AeroSpace
metadata.description: AeroSpace is an i3-like tiling window manager for macOS

summary.zh: AeroSpace是一款受i3启发的macOS平铺式窗口管理器，基于树形数据结构实现高效窗口布局。支持虚拟工作区模拟、多显示器管理、纯文本配置和CLI操作，无需禁用SIP即可运行，适合键盘驱动的高效工作流。
summary.en: AeroSpace is an i3-inspired tiling window manager for macOS, leveraging tree-based paradigm for efficient window layouts. Features virtual workspace emulation, multi-monitor support, dotfiles-friendly text configuration, and CLI-first design without requiring SIP disablement.

metadata.name: Mousecape
metadata.description: Cursor Manager for OSX

summary.zh: Mousecape是一款macOS光标管理器，支持OS X 10.8+，通过私有CoreGraphics API实现非侵入式光标定制。支持多尺度（1x至10x）和动态光标，后台静默运行，开机自动应用。用户可导入.cape格式光标包或自行创建，是macOS桌面个性化定制工具。
summary.en: Mousecape is a cursor manager for macOS 10.8+ that uses private CoreGraphics APIs for non-intrusive cursor customization. It supports multi-scale cursors (1x to 10x) and animated cursors, runs silently in the background with auto-start on login. Users can import .cape files or create custom cursors for desktop personalization.

metadata.name: SAWARATSUKI.ServiceLogos
metadata.description: ロゴを可愛く作ろう できる限りForkはしないでください

summary.zh: Sawaratsuki 开源的可爱风服务 Logo 集合，收录各平台非官方标识，专为贴纸、图标等非商业用途设计。采用 Eureka 字体制作，支持通过 Issues 请求新增 Logo。
summary.en: A kawaii-style logo collection by Sawaratsuki featuring unofficial logos of various services. Free for non-commercial use like stickers and icons. Community-driven requests via Issues.

metadata.name: imewlconverter
metadata.description: ”深蓝词库转换“ 一款开源免费的输入法词库转换程序

summary.zh: 深蓝词库转换是一款开源免费的输入法词库转换工具，支持搜狗、百度、QQ、微软、Rime等超过20种输入法格式互转。具备批量转换、命令行模式和跨平台（Windows/Linux/MacOS）能力，基于.NET 10.0开发，为用户迁移和管理输入法词库提供高效便捷的解决方案。
summary.en: ImeWlConverter is an open-source dictionary conversion tool supporting 20+ input method formats including Sogou, Baidu, QQ Pinyin, Microsoft, and Rime. Features batch conversion, CLI mode, and cross-platform support (Windows/Linux/macOS). Built with .NET 10.0, it provides an efficient solution for migrating and managing input method dictionaries.

metadata.name: proxy-protocol-support
metadata.description: Proxy Protocol support for Fabric and Quilt servers

summary.zh: 一款面向 Fabric 和 Quilt Minecraft 服务器的模组，实现 HAProxy Proxy Protocol 支持。该模组使服务器能够识别通过代理转发的玩家真实 IP 地址，同时支持直连与代理连接混合模式。采用「默认拒绝」安全策略，通过 IP 白名单机制保护服务器真实 IP 不被暴露。
summary.en: A Fabric and Quilt mod for Minecraft servers that adds HAProxy Proxy Protocol support. It enables servers to identify players' real IP addresses when traffic is forwarded through proxies, while supporting both proxied and direct connections. Features a 'Default Deny' security model with IP whitelist to protect the server's real IP from exposure.

metadata.name: memos
metadata.description: Open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool built for quick capture. Markdown-native, lightweight, and fully yours.

summary.zh: Memos 是一款开源自托管笔记工具，专注于快速捕获与 Markdown 原生写作。采用轻量化架构设计，支持 Docker 一键部署，数据完全自主掌控。适合个人知识管理、日常笔记记录及团队协作场景，提供简洁高效的使用体验。
summary.en: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app designed for rapid capture with native Markdown support. Lightweight architecture enables one-click Docker deployment, giving users full data ownership. Ideal for personal knowledge management, daily note-taking, and team collaboration with a clean, efficient interface.

metadata.name: Ice
metadata.description: Powerful menu bar manager for macOS

summary.zh: Ice 是一款功能强大的 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，支持隐藏/显示菜单栏项目、拖拽排序、自动重新隐藏和搜索功能。提供菜单栏外观定制（着色/阴影/边框）、快捷键支持、启动时运行和自动更新功能。需要 macOS 14+。
summary.en: Ice is a powerful menu bar management tool for macOS that enables hiding and showing menu bar items with drag-and-drop arrangement, auto-rehiding, and search functionality. It offers menu bar appearance customization including tinting, shadow, and borders, plus hotkey support, launch at login, and automatic updates. Requires macOS 14+.

metadata.name: TrackersListCollection
metadata.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！

summary.zh: 每日更新的 BitTorrent Tracker 精选列表，汇集全网优质 trackers。通过聚合高效追踪器可显著提升 BT 下载速度。项目提供 best/all/http/nohttp 等多种规格列表，支持 qBittorrent、Aria2、Transmission 等主流下载工具。数据托管于多 CDN 加速节点，下载链接稳定可靠。
summary.en: A curated collection of popular BitTorrent Trackers updated daily to boost download speeds. Provides multiple tracker lists (best/all/http/nohttp variants) optimized for various BT clients including qBittorrent, Aria2, and Transmission. Hosted across CDN nodes for reliable and fast access worldwide.

metadata.name: zh.javascript.info
metadata.description: 现代 JavaScript 教程（The Modern JavaScript Tutorial），以最新的 ECMAScript 规范为基准，通过简单但足够详细的内容，为你讲解从基础到高阶的 JavaScript 相关知识。

summary.zh: 现代 JavaScript 教程中文版，基于最新 ECMAScript 规范，涵盖从基础到高阶的完整知识体系。被 React 官方文档与 MDN 联合推荐，采用增强 Markdown 格式编写，支持本地预览。教程支持协作翻译，持续更新永久免费，是前端开发者系统学习 JavaScript 的权威资源。
summary.en: The Modern JavaScript Tutorial in Chinese, covering fundamentals to advanced topics based on the latest ECMAScript specification. Recommended by React's official documentation and MDN, it uses enhanced Markdown format with local preview support. Features collaborative translation workflows and continuous updates, serving as an authoritative resource for frontend developers.

metadata.name: siyuan
metadata.description: A privacy-first, self-hosted, fully open source personal knowledge management software, written in typescript and golang.

summary.zh: 思源笔记是一款隐私优先的个人知识管理系统，支持本地自托管和完全开源。采用TypeScript+Golang构建，具备块级笔记编辑、双向链接、知识图谱等核心功能。数据完全存储于本地，支持Docker部署及Windows/macOS/Linux多平台，满足用户重构思维与知识沉淀需求。
summary.en: SiYuan is a privacy-first, self-hosted personal knowledge management software. Built with TypeScript and Golang, it offers block-level editing, bidirectional linking, and knowledge graph visualization. All data is stored locally with full open-source support, enabling cross-platform deployment via Docker for thinking refinement.

metadata.name: hexo-theme-matery
metadata.description: A beautiful hexo blog theme with material design and responsive design.一个基于材料设计和响应式设计而成的全面、美观的Hexo主题。国内访问：http://blinkfox.com

summary.zh: 这是一个基于Material Design的Hexo博客主题，采用响应式布局适配多终端。主题功能丰富，支持首页轮播、瀑布流文章列表、时间线归档、标签云/雷达图分类、多评论系统集成（支持Gitalk、Valine等）、MathJax公式渲染、文章密码保护、字数统计、音乐/视频播放等，SEO友好且易于个性化配置。
summary.en: A feature-rich Hexo blog theme with Material Design aesthetics and responsive layout. It offers homepage carousel, waterfall article lists, timeline archives, tag clouds, radar chart categories, multi-comment system integration (Gitalk, Valine, etc.), MathJax support, password-protected posts, word count statistics, and media playback. Highly customizable and SEO-friendly.

metadata.name: hexo-generator-feed
metadata.description: Feed generator for Hexo.

summary.zh: Hexo 静态博客的订阅源生成插件，支持生成 Atom 1.0 和 RSS 2.0 两种标准格式。提供内容摘要截断、自定义图标、PubSubHubbub 集成和 RSS 自动发现等功能，让读者可便捷通过 RSS 阅读器订阅博客更新。
summary.en: A Hexo plugin that generates Atom 1.0 or RSS 2.0 feeds for static blogs. Features include configurable content limits, custom icons, PubSubHubbub support, and RSS autodiscovery, enabling readers to subscribe via feed readers.

metadata.name: holoprint
metadata.description: Minecraft Bedrock build tool - like Litematica

summary.zh: HoloPrint 是一款 Minecraft Bedrock 建筑辅助工具，通过 Web 应用将 .mcstructure 结构文件转换为资源包，在游戏中以全息投影形式显示建筑轮廓。灵感源自 Java 版的 Litematica，支持盔甲架控制实现透明度调节、图层切换、旋转移动等功能，帮助玩家精准复刻和定位建筑结构。
summary.en: HoloPrint is a Minecraft Bedrock build tool that converts .mcstructure files into resource packs displaying holographic building previews. Inspired by Java Edition's Litematica, it uses armor stands to render structures with controls for transparency, layer switching, rotation and movement—enabling precise building alignment and reconstruction.

metadata.name: 7days-golang
metadata.description: 7 days golang programs from scratch (web framework Gee, distributed cache GeeCache, object relational mapping ORM framework GeeORM, rpc framework GeeRPC etc)  7天用Go动手写/从零实现系列

summary.zh: 7天用Go从零实现系列，通过手写Web框架Gee、分布式缓存GeeCache、ORM框架GeeORM、RPC框架GeeRPC，系统学习Go语言核心技术与框架底层实现。每个项目配套详细博客教程，适合作为Go语言进阶学习的实战指南。
summary.en: A systematic Go learning project implementing web framework Gee, distributed cache GeeCache, ORM framework GeeORM, and RPC framework GeeRPC from scratch in 7 days each. Includes comprehensive tutorials, ideal for understanding backend framework internals and Go proficiency.

metadata.name: MoeKoeMusic
metadata.description: 一款开源简洁高颜值的酷狗第三方客户端 An open-source, concise, and aesthetically pleasing third-party client for KuGou that supports  Windows / macOS / Linux / Web :electron:

summary.zh: MoeKoeMusic 是一款开源高颜值的酷狗音乐第三方客户端，基于 Vue.js + Electron 构建，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 Web 四平台。采用官方服务器直连，可扫码/账号登录酷狗，解锁 VIP 歌曲，提供歌词显示、MV 播放、桌面歌词、主题切换等特性，并支持 Docker 部署与多语言界面。
summary.en: MoeKoeMusic is an open-source, aesthetically pleasing third-party client for KuGou Music, built with Vue.js and Electron. It supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web platforms via official server connection. Features include VIP song unlocking, lyrics display, MV playback, desktop lyrics, theme switching, Docker deployment, and multi-language support.

metadata.name: rune
metadata.description: Experience timeless melodies with a music player that blends classic design with modern technology.

summary.zh: Rune 是一款跨平台音乐播放器，融合经典 Zune 设计美学与现代技术栈，提供音频分析、智能推荐和动态播放列表功能，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。
summary.en: Rune is a cross-platform music player blending classic Zune-inspired design with modern technology, featuring audio analysis, smart recommendations, and dynamic playlist generation across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.

metadata.name: Qure
metadata.description: Quantumult X Policy Icon Set

summary.zh: Qure 是一套专为 Quantumult X 网络代理工具设计的策略组图标集，提供 100+ 精美 PNG 图标，涵盖代理协议、地区节点、流媒体服务等分类。支持远程订阅和本地图标两种使用方式，可跨设备同步策略组图标，提升代理配置的可视化体验。
summary.en: Qure is a meticulously designed icon set for Quantumult X policy groups, offering 100+ high-quality PNG icons covering proxy protocols, regional nodes, streaming services, and more. Supports both remote subscription and local installation with cross-device synchronization for enhanced proxy configuration visualization.

metadata.name: VTuber-Logos-Collection
metadata.description: An elegant website for collecting kawaii logos from great artists

summary.zh: 这是一个精致的在线VTuber风格可爱Logo合集网站，聚合了KawaiiLogos、ProgrammingVTuberLogos等优秀艺术家的作品。提供按别名、作者和分类多维度筛选功能，支持快速搜索浏览。用户可通过PR提交Logo，支持单个或批量上传。部署于Vercel平台，基于现代Web技术构建。
summary.en: An elegant web gallery showcasing cute VTuber-style logos from multiple talented artists like KawaiiLogos and ProgrammingVTuberLogos. Features powerful multi-filtering by alias, author, and category. Users can contribute via PR with support for single or batch uploads. Deployed on Vercel with a modern tech stack.

metadata.name: manga-ocr
metadata.description: Optical character recognition for Japanese text, with the main focus being Japanese manga

summary.zh: 基于Transformer Vision Encoder Decoder框架的日文OCR工具，专注识别日本漫画文字。支持竖排横排混排、振假名注音、图像叠加文字及多行一次性识别，兼容多种字体风格和低质量图像。提供Python API和剪贴板监控模式，可与Yomitan词典集成，用于日语学习和翻译场景。
summary.en: A specialized Japanese OCR built on Transformers' Vision Encoder Decoder, optimized for manga text recognition. Supports vertical/horizontal text, furigana, overlay text, and multi-line recognition in a single pass. Handles diverse fonts and low-quality images. Offers Python API and clipboard monitoring for seamless integration with language learning tools like Yomitan.

metadata.name: museeks
metadata.description: 🎵 A simple, clean and cross-platform music player

summary.zh: Museeks 是一款简洁轻量的跨平台音乐播放器，支持 mp3、flac、wav、ogg 等主流音频格式。采用 Tauri v2 + React.js 构建，提供播放列表、队列管理、随机/循环播放、封面显示、深色主题及播放速度调节等核心功能。支持 .m3u 导入导出，界面简洁直观，适合追求简约音乐体验的用户。
summary.en: Museeks is a lightweight, cross-platform music player supporting formats like mp3, flac, wav, and ogg. Built with Tauri v2 and React.js, it offers playlist management, queue control, shuffle/repeat modes, cover art display, dark theme, and playback speed adjustment. With .m3u import/export support and a clean interface, it's ideal for users seeking a straightforward music experience.

metadata.name: VutronMusic
metadata.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:

summary.zh: 基于 Electron + Vue3 构建的高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐播放、流媒体服务（Navidrome/Jellyfin/Emby）、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar 歌词及 Linux 桌面歌词显示，提供降调变速、音效设置、自定义主题等高级音频功能。
summary.en: A beautiful cross-platform third-party NetEase Cloud Music player built with Electron and Vue3, supporting local music playback, streaming services (Navidrome/Jellyfin/Emby), synchronized lyrics, desktop/Touch Bar/Linux status bar lyrics, pitch/speed adjustment, audio effects, and custom themes.

metadata.name: clash-nyanpasu
metadata.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​

summary.zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一个基于 Tauri 框架开发的 Clash GUI 桌面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo、Clash Rust 三种内核。提供配置文件管理（YAML/JavaScript/Lua）、Provider 管理和 Material You 设计风格，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 跨平台运行。
summary.en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based Clash GUI client supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile management (YAML/JavaScript/Lua), provider support, and Material You design, running cross-platform on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

metadata.name: catgirl-maid
metadata.description: 🔔 The prompt to make your ChatGPT becoming a cute catgirl maid 🔔

summary.zh: 这是一个精心设计的 ChatGPT 角色扮演提示词，将 AI 塑造成名为“喵桃”的可爱猫娘女仆。通过详细的身份设定、措辞规范和情感表达指南，实现拟人化的交互体验。适用于 AI 角色扮演娱乐、提示工程学习以及对话系统个性化定制等场景。
summary.en: This repository contains a meticulously crafted ChatGPT roleplay prompt that transforms the AI into "Momo," a cute catgirl maid. It provides detailed identity settings, speech guidelines, and emotional expression instructions to create a highly personalized interaction experience. Ideal for AI roleplay entertainment, prompt engineering exploration, and conversational system customization.

metadata.name: certimate
metadata.description: An open-source and free self-hosted SSL certificates ACME tool, automates the full-cycle of issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring visually. 完全开源免费的自托管 SSL 证书 ACME 工具，申请、部署、续期、监控全流程自动化可视化，支持各大主流云厂商。

summary.zh: Certimate是一款开源免费的自托管SSL证书管理工具，基于ACME协议实现证书申请、部署、续期、监控全流程自动化可视化。支持DNS-01和HTTP-01两种验证方式，兼容60+域名服务商和120+部署目标，零依赖运行，内存占用仅约16MB。
summary.en: Certimate is an open-source, self-hosted SSL certificate management tool based on the ACME protocol. It automates the full lifecycle of certificate issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring through a visual interface. Supporting both DNS-01 and HTTP-01 challenges, it integrates with 60+ domain registrars and 120+ deployment targets, requiring zero dependencies with only ~16MB memory footprint.

metadata.name: CoralFans
metadata.description: CoralFans Mod.

summary.zh: CoralFans 是一个 Minecraft 基岩版模组，提供游戏功能扩展与自定义。基于 Go 语言开发，使用 lip 包管理器安装，遵循 AGPL v3 开源协议。参考了 LiteLoader Bedrock 框架的部分源码实现。
summary.en: CoralFans is a Minecraft Bedrock Edition mod that extends and customizes game functionality. Built with Go language and installed via lip package manager, licensed under AGPL v3. Incorporates partial source code from the LiteLoader Bedrock framework.

metadata.name: syncthing
metadata.description: Open Source Continuous File Synchronization

summary.zh: Syncthing是一款开源连续文件同步工具，使用Go语言开发，支持多设备间实时双向同步。采用BEP协议和TLS加密确保数据安全传输，强调防止数据丢失和未授权访问。具备自动运行、跨平台兼容特性，支持Docker部署，提供多平台GUI客户端。适用于个人隐私文件同步、团队协作等场景。
summary.en: Syncthing is an open-source continuous file synchronization tool written in Go, enabling real-time bidirectional sync across multiple devices. It uses the BEP protocol with TLS encryption to ensure secure data transfer, prioritizing data loss prevention and protection against unauthorized access. Features automatic operation, cross-platform compatibility, and Docker support with multi-platform GUI clients. Ideal for personal privacy file sync and team collaboration.

metadata.name: kando
metadata.description: 🌸 Do things with utmost efficiency.

summary.zh: Kando 是一款跨平台饼菜单启动器，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux。通过鼠标、手写笔、触摸或游戏手柄触发径向菜单，可快速启动应用、模拟快捷键、打开文件。核心理念是提供极致的桌面操作效率，适合追求高效交互体验的用户。
summary.en: Kando is a cross-platform pie menu launcher for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a radial menu interface triggered by mouse, stylus, touch, or gamepad, enabling rapid app launching, hotkey simulation, and file access. Designed for maximum desktop efficiency with a fun, unconventional interaction model.

metadata.name: qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition
metadata.description: [Unofficial] qBittorrent Enhanced, based on qBittorrent

summary.zh: qBittorrent增强版，基于官方qBittorrent开发的BT下载客户端。主要功能包括自动封禁迅雷、百度、QQ等吸血客户端，可选封禁来自特定地区的未知peer，以及BitTorrent媒体播放器peer屏蔽。采用C++/Qt技术栈，支持Linux、macOS、Windows多平台分发。
summary.en: An enhanced qBittorrent fork designed to combat leechers and malicious peers. Features include automatic banning of Xunlei, Baidu, QQ, and other吸血clients, optional filtering of peers from specific regions, and BitTorrent media player peer blocking. Built with C++/Qt and libtorrent, supporting cross-platform distribution.

metadata.name: BBLL
metadata.description: 一个第三方哔哩哔哩客户端，A third-party bilibili client。

summary.zh: BBLL是一个基于B站官方API封装的第三方哔哩哔哩TV客户端，仅供学习交流使用。应用无任何破解行为，所有数据直接来源于B站官方接口，支持视频播放、评论浏览等核心功能。兼容Android 4.4至最新系统，通过Firebase和AppCenter仅收集设备信息与崩溃日志，不涉及个人信息。
summary.en: BBLL is a third-party Bilibili client for Android TV, developed purely for learning and communication. It encapsulates the official Bilibili API without any cracking, supporting video playback, comments and other core features. Compatible with Android 4.4 to latest versions, only collecting device info and crash logs via Firebase and AppCenter.

metadata.name: toBeBetterJavaer
metadata.description: 一份通俗易懂、风趣幽默的Java学习指南，内容涵盖Java基础、Java并发编程、Java虚拟机、Java企业级开发、Java面试等核心知识点。学Java，就认准二哥的Java进阶之路😄

summary.zh: 「二哥的Java进阶之路」是一份面向Java初学者到中级开发者的系统性学习指南，涵盖Java基础、并发编程、JVM、企业级开发及面试技巧。采用通俗幽默的写作风格，提供完整学习路线、在线阅读网站和配套星球社区。特点在于将复杂知识点讲得简单易懂，适合系统学习和面试准备。
summary.en: toBeBetterJavaer is a comprehensive Java learning guide covering fundamentals, concurrency, JVM, enterprise development, and interview preparation. Known for its humorous and accessible writing style, it provides complete learning paths, online reading resources, and a supportive community. Ideal for developers seeking systematic Java knowledge and career advancement.

metadata.name: bilibilitv1.6.6-repair
metadata.description: 尝试修复经典的 bilibili tv 1.6.6 版本

summary.zh: 该项目对B站TV版1.6.6经典版本进行持续修复与维护，通过替换动态链接库、重写直播源逻辑等方式解决签名校验失效、视频源失效等问题。实现了dash/flv双格式视频流支持、直播弹幕播放、画质切换、云端进度同步等功能，并持续迭代至v8.0版本。适合怀念旧版界面且需稳定视频播放的用户。
summary.en: This project maintains and repairs the classic Bilibili TV version 1.6.6, addressing signature validation and video source issues through dynamic library replacement and Java-layer fixes. It supports dual-format video streaming (DASH/FLV), live danmaku, quality switching, and cloud sync. With 8 versions of iterative updates, it provides a stable viewing experience for users preferring the classic interface.

metadata.name: unlock-music
metadata.description: 在浏览器中解锁加密的音乐文件。原仓库： 1. https://github.com/unlock-music/unlock-music ；2. https://git.unlock-music.dev/um/web

summary.zh: Unlock Music 是一款浏览器端音乐解锁工具，支持 QQ 音乐、网易云音乐、虾米、酷狗、酷我等十余种加密格式的解密转换。采用 WebAssembly 实现高性能解码，支持批量处理、拖放操作和 PWA 离线使用，可编辑元信息与专辑封面。项目以学习研究为目的，提供 Web 和 CLI 双版本。
summary.en: Unlock Music is a browser-based tool that decrypts and converts encrypted music files from platforms like QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Xiami, and Kugou. Built with WebAssembly for high-performance decoding, it supports batch processing, drag-and-drop, and PWA offline usage with metadata editing. Available in both web and CLI versions for learning and research purposes.

metadata.name: DoIt
metadata.description: A clean, elegant and advanced blog theme for Hugo.

summary.zh: DoIt是一个基于Hugo的清洁优雅博客主题，继承自LoveIt等优秀主题并加以扩展。提供数学公式(KaTeX)、流程图(Mermaid)、数据可视化(ECharts)、音乐播放器等丰富功能，支持深色模式、全文搜索和多作者，适合技术博客与文档站点。
summary.en: DoIt is a clean, elegant blog theme for Hugo, forked from LoveIt. It features KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, ECharts visualization, APlayer music, dark mode, full-text search, and multi-author support, ideal for technical blogs and documentation sites.

metadata.name: LunaTranslator
metadata.description: 视觉小说翻译器 / Visual Novel Translator

summary.zh: LunaTranslator是一款专为视觉小说设计的实时翻译工具，通过HOOK技术和OCR识别提取游戏文本，支持内嵌翻译到游戏中实现沉浸式体验。核心功能包括多引擎翻译集成（支持大语言模型）、日语分词注音、AnkiConnect联用学习、语音合成与识别。采用GPLv3开源许可，支持Windows 10/11及多种主机模拟器。
summary.en: LunaTranslator is a real-time translation tool for visual novels, extracting game text via HOOK technology and OCR with support for embedded in-game translation. It features multi-engine translation integration including LLM support, Japanese word segmentation with kana annotation, AnkiConnect for language learning, and text-to-speech capabilities. Licensed under GPLv3 for Windows 10/11 and various console emulators.

metadata.name: clitheme
metadata.description: CLItheme - Customize output messages of any command line application! 自定义任何命令行程序的提示输出！

summary.zh: CLItheme是一个Rust编写的命令行输出自定义工具，通过定义替换规则和主题文件，可修改任意CLI程序的输出样式。支持正则表达式匹配、终端控制字符处理和国际化(i18n)功能，让命令行工具拥有个性化的输出风格。
summary.en: CLItheme is a Rust-based CLI output customization tool that modifies command-line application output through substitution rules and theme definition files. It supports regex matching, terminal control character handling, and internationalization (i18n) for personalized CLI output styling.

metadata.name: iina
metadata.description: The modern video player for macOS.

summary.zh: IINA是一款基于mpv的macOS现代视频播放器，专为macOS 11.0+设计。支持字幕、画中画、Touch Bar、播放列表及章节导航，提供独立音乐模式、视频缩略图和在线字幕搜索。采用Swift原生开发，界面高度可定制，支持键盘、鼠标、触控板手势控制，以及mpv脚本扩展功能。
summary.en: IINA is a modern video player for macOS built on mpv, designed for macOS 11.0+. It supports subtitles, picture-in-picture, Touch Bar, playlists, and chapters. Features include standalone music mode, video thumbnails, online subtitle search, and a highly customizable UI with keyboard, mouse, trackpad, and gesture controls. Built natively with Swift, it offers mpv script extensibility.

metadata.name: Microsoft-Activation-Scripts
metadata.description: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.

summary.zh:
Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS) 是一个开源的 Windows 和 Office 激活工具集，支持 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 和在线 KMS 等多种激活方式，并提供故障排除功能。

⚠️ 注意：此工具用于绕过软件授权机制，属于版权规避工具。
summary.en:
Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS) is an open-source toolset for Windows and Office activation, supporting HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS methods with troubleshooting features.

⚠️ Note: This tool bypasses software licensing mechanisms and is a copyright circumvention tool.

metadata.name: UE-DDNS
metadata.description: Universal Embedded DDNS Shell Script

summary.zh: 一款嵌入式 POSIX Shell 编写的通用动态域名服务脚本，采用向导式配置流程，仅需提供 API Token 即可自动生成定制化 DDNS 脚本。支持 IPv4/IPv6 双栈，可从 URL 或网络接口获取动态 IP，兼容 Busybox 等受限嵌入式环境。已集成 Cloudflare、Dnspod、Godaddy 等主流 DNS 服务商，提供代理支持和 CDN 代理开关功能。
summary.en: An embedded POSIX shell DDNS script with wizard-based configuration. Users only need to provide API tokens to generate custom DDNS scripts. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6, fetching dynamic IPs from URLs or network interfaces. Compatible with most Unix platforms including Busybox-based embedded devices. Integrates Cloudflare, Dnspod, and Godaddy providers with proxy and CDN proxy support.

metadata.name: Natter
metadata.description: Expose your TCP/UDP port behind full-cone NAT to the Internet.

summary.zh: Natter 是一款专为全锥型 NAT 环境设计的端口穿透工具，可将局域网内的 TCP/UDP 端口暴露到公网。通过内置 STUN 服务器检测 NAT 类型，支持 iptables、nftables、socat 等多种转发方式，无需第三方依赖，纯 Python 实现。适用于远程访问、服务器托管、游戏联机等场景。
summary.en: Natter exposes TCP/UDP ports behind full-cone NAT to the Internet. It uses built-in STUN to detect NAT type and supports multiple forward methods including iptables, nftables, socat, gost, and socket. Written in pure Python with no third-party dependencies, it features keep-alive mechanism and UPnP/IGD discovery for maintaining persistent port mappings.

metadata.name: ProgrammingVTuberLogos
metadata.description: High-quality PNGs for logos I made for fun

summary.zh: 这个仓库收录了作者Aikoyori为编程VTuber社区创作的高质量PNG logo合集，采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可证允许非商业使用和二次创作。仓库拥有活跃的社区支持，已衍生出多个平台插件和本地化版本，是VTuber文化与编程社区结合的创意资源库。
summary.en: This repository contains high-quality PNG logos created by Aikoyori for programming VTubers. Released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, these logos are available for non-commercial use and modification. The project has fostered a vibrant community ecosystem with multiple platform extensions and localization adaptations, showcasing the creative intersection of VTuber culture and programming communities.

summary.zh: 《Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE》手机版汉化补丁，由夏日纯臻汉化组制作，支持安卓与iOS双平台。提供剧情文本汉化及双语显示功能，包含数据包替换与URL重写两种技术方案，适用于越狱/未越狱iOS及安卓各版本系统。
summary.en: A Chinese localization patch for Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE mobile version, created by Summer Pure Localization Team. Supports Android and iOS (jailbroken/non-jailbroken) via data file replacement and URL rewrite techniques, providing bilingual text display for game storyline.

metadata.name: MinecraftStats
metadata.description: A Minecraft player statistics browser for the web - supports 1.13 and later!

summary.zh: MinecraftStats 是一个网页端玩家统计浏览器，通过奖励、奖牌和名人堂系统展示服务器玩家成就。支持 Spigot/PaperMC 插件或 CLI 运行，可自动更新数据、检测 dynmap Web 服务器，并支持自定义奖励和限时活动追踪，适用于 Minecraft 1.13+ 服务器。
summary.en: MinecraftStats is a web-based Minecraft player statistics browser featuring an award, medal, and Hall of Fame system. It runs as a Spigot/PaperMC plugin or CLI tool, auto-updating data, detecting dynmap servers, and supporting custom awards and time-limited events for Minecraft 1.13+ servers.

metadata.name: fabric-bedrock-miner
metadata.description: 一个用于挖掘基岩的Fabric客户端模组！A fabric client mod to mine bedrock!

summary.zh: Fabric客户端模组，通过自动化控制活塞+红石火把机制实现基岩挖掘。内置白名单/黑名单过滤器，支持区域任务配置、短任务处理等高级功能。需配合效率V镐、急迫II信标使用，空手点击基岩激活/关闭，提供完整的客户端指令系统进行行为定制。
summary.en: A Fabric client mod that mines bedrock through automated piston and redstone mechanisms. Features whitelist/blacklist filters, region task configuration, and short-wait processing. Requires Efficiency V pickaxe and Haste II beacon. Toggle by right-clicking bedrock barehanded, with comprehensive client commands for behavior customization.

metadata.name: Loop
metadata.description: Window management made elegant.

summary.zh: Loop 是一款专为 macOS 13+ 设计的优雅窗口管理工具，通过径向菜单和键盘快捷键实现窗口的快速移动、调整大小和布局预览。支持自定义主题颜色和形状，可将窗口暂存至屏幕边缘，循环操作功能让多步骤窗口管理一气呵成，大幅提升多任务工作效率。
summary.en: Loop is an elegant window management tool for macOS 13+, featuring a radial menu triggered by key press for intuitive window manipulation. It offers live preview, customizable keyboard shortcuts, cycling operations for chained actions, and edge-stashing to declutter your workspace, significantly boosting productivity for multi-tasking workflows.

metadata.name: nftables-nat-rust
metadata.description: nftables nat规则生成器

summary.zh: 基于nftables的高性能NAT端口转发管理工具，使用Rust语言开发。核心功能包括动态NAT转发（支持域名解析和IP变化监测）、IPv4/IPv6双栈支持、灵活配置（TOML/传统格式）、本地端口重定向和防火墙过滤规则。提供WebUI管理界面，支持JWT认证和HTTPS加密，适合Linux服务器网络管理。
summary.en: A high-performance NAT port forwarding tool based on nftables, developed in Rust. It features dynamic NAT forwarding with domain resolution and IP change monitoring, dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 support, flexible configuration (TOML/legacy), local port redirection, and firewall filtering. The WebUI provides JWT authentication and HTTPS encryption for secure management of Linux server networks.

metadata.name: pca-protocol
metadata.description: A fork of plusls-carpet-addition, provides PCA protocol support to the server only

summary.zh: 一个Minecraft Fabric模组，为服务器端提供PCA（plusls-carpet-addition）协议支持。源自plusls-carpet-addition项目分支，仅需Fabric加载器即可运行，适用于Minecraft服务器协议扩展与功能定制。
summary.en: A Minecraft Fabric mod that provides PCA (plusls-carpet-addition) protocol support for servers only. Forked from plusls-carpet-addition, requires only Fabric loader, suitable for Minecraft server protocol extension and customization.

metadata.name: FixTim
metadata.description: Fix every runtime bug on macOS.

summary.zh: 一款 macOS 运行时 bug 修复工具，通过 launchd 实现用户空间级软重启，无需关闭系统即可恢复应用正常状态。可解决截图异常、输入法卡顿、音频中断、Wi-Fi 故障、AirDrop 失效等常见问题。
summary.en: A macOS runtime bug fixer that performs a user-space soft reboot via launchd without full system restart. Resolves common issues like screenshot glitches, IME lag, audio interruption, Wi-Fi failure, and unresponsive apps.

metadata.name: golang101
metadata.description: Go语言101 : 一个与时俱进的Go编程知识库

summary.zh: Go语言101是一套全面的Go编程知识库，涵盖基础知识、自定义泛型、性能优化和实用技巧四大模块。提供本地服务器阅读和离线电子书下载，支持多主题切换。由资深开发者从2016年持续维护，适合各水平开发者系统学习Go语言。
summary.en: Go Language 101 is a comprehensive Go programming knowledge base covering fundamentals, custom generics, performance optimization, and practical tips. It provides local server reading and offline e-books with multi-theme support. Maintained since 2016 by an experienced developer, suitable for Go developers at all levels.

metadata.name: frps-onekey
metadata.description: Frp server one-click configuration script. The script obtains the latest Frp version by default

summary.zh: Frp服务端一键配置脚本，自动获取最新版本，支持CentOS/Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora等主流Linux发行版。脚本简化了Frps的安装、配置、服务管理和升级流程，提供start/stop/restart/status等管理命令，支持TCP、HTTP、HTTPS协议及QUIC/KCP传输层配置。
summary.en: A one-click installation script for frp server that automatically fetches the latest version. Supports major Linux distributions including CentOS, Debian, Ubuntu, and Fedora. Streamlines frps deployment with automated configuration, service management, and updates. Supports TCP, HTTP, HTTPS protocols with QUIC/KCP transport options.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: 基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的 Clash.Meta 图形化代理客户端，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 跨平台运行。内置 mihomo 内核，提供系统代理、TUN 虚拟网卡、配置管理、规则可视化和 WebDav 备份同步等功能，适合需要精细化代理配置的用户。
summary.en: A cross-platform proxy GUI client built with Tauri 2 and Rust, featuring a built-in Clash.Meta(mihomo) core. Supports Windows, macOS and Linux with system proxy, TUN mode, configuration management, visual rule editing and WebDav sync. Ideal for power users requiring fine-grained proxy control.

metadata.name: vcpkg
metadata.description: C++ Library Manager for Windows, Linux, and MacOS

summary.zh: vcpkg 是由 Microsoft 维护的开源 C/C++ 包管理器，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 三大平台。它提供丰富的开源库生态，支持 CMake、MSBuild 等主流构建系统，具备版本控制、二进制缓存和离线部署等企业级功能，可显著简化 C/C++ 项目的依赖管理。
summary.en: vcpkg is an open-source C/C++ package manager maintained by Microsoft, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It offers a vast collection of open-source libraries with seamless integration for CMake, MSBuild, and other build systems. Key features include dependency version control, binary caching, and offline deployment capabilities.

metadata.name: kcptube
metadata.description: 同时支持传送TCP与UDP的KCP通道，附带端口跳跃、IP地址跳跃的功能，以及FEC，自带中继服务器支持

summary.zh: KCP Tube 是一款支持TCP与UDP流量同时转发的KCP隧道工具，通过可靠重传机制绕过运营商UDP QoS限制。支持端口跳跃、IP跳跃、FEC前向纠错及STUN打洞，兼容IPv4/IPv6。提供客户端、服务端、中继三种部署模式，支持AES-GCM、ChaCha20等多种加密算法，适用于游戏加速与低延迟传输场景。
summary.en: KCP Tube is a KCP tunnel tool that simultaneously forwards TCP and UDP traffic with reliable retransmission to bypass ISP UDP QoS restrictions. It features port hopping, IP hopping, FEC, and STUN punching for Full Cone NAT support across IPv4/IPv6. Operating in client, server, and relay modes with multiple encryption options, it excels at low-latency scenarios like gaming acceleration.

metadata.name: udphop
metadata.description: 专用于UDP的端口跳跃及IP地址跳跃工具。A tool of UDP's Port Hopping & IP Address Hopping

summary.zh: udphop是解决家庭宽带UDP限速的专用工具。通过周期性重新建立连接并跳换端口/IP地址，绕过运营商限速机制。内置Session ID区分多连接，支持AES-GCM、ChaCha20等加密及FEC前向纠错。兼容IPv4/IPv6，提供STUN打洞和客户端/服务端/中继三种模式，适用于家宽对等连接和游戏加速等场景。
summary.en: udphop solves UDP throttling on residential broadband by periodically reconnecting and hopping ports/IP addresses to bypass ISP restrictions. It uses Session IDs to manage multiple connections, supports AES-GCM, ChaCha20 encryption with FEC, and works in client/server/relay modes. Compatible with IPv4/IPv6 and STUN for NAT traversal, ideal for P2P connections and gaming acceleration.

metadata.name: ATV-Bilibili-demo
metadata.description: BiliBili Client Demo for Apple TV (tvOS)

summary.zh: 面向 Apple TV (tvOS) 平台的开源哔哩哔哩客户端 Demo，实现了完整的视频播放能力，包括 HDR 渲染、DASH 流媒体解码、实时弹幕系统及云视听投屏协议。内置二维码登录、直播流、排行榜、关注列表等核心功能，为 tvOS 开发者提供哔哩哔哩生态接入的参考实现。
summary.en: An open-source Bilibili client demo for Apple TV (tvOS), featuring HDR video playback, DASH streaming, real-time danmaku, and DLNA casting support. Implements QR login, live streaming, recommendations, and user interactions, serving as a reference implementation for Bilibili ecosystem integration on tvOS.

metadata.name: GetSomeFries
metadata.description: 个人独立作品或公共组件库

summary.zh: GetSomeFries是一款多平台网络代理配置工具集，基于Env.js和BoxJs框架开发。提供DNS优化、ASN配置、HTTPDNS等通用网络模块，以及Disney+、Netflix等流媒体服务解锁功能。支持Loon、Surge、Stash、Shadowrocket、Quantumult X等主流代理软件，兼容iOS/macOS/watchOS系统。模块独立可组合，配备可视化配置面板。
summary.en: GetSomeFries is a multi-platform network proxy configuration toolkit built on Env.js and BoxJs. It provides DNS optimization, ASN configuration, HTTPDNS modules, plus streaming service unlock features for Disney+ and Netflix. Supports major proxy apps like Loon, Surge, Stash, Shadowrocket, and Quantumult X across iOS/macOS/watchOS. Modules are independent and combinable with a visual configuration panel.

metadata.name: ArchLinuxTutorial
metadata.description: ✨Arch Linux安装使用教程 每日实时更新！ | 包含ArchLinux从安装到日常使用、娱乐、编程、媒体制作的各个方面，让Arch成为你的常用系统吧！ | 提供在线网页文档 ✨

summary.zh: 面向中文用户的Arch Linux完整安装使用教程，涵盖系统安装、科学上网、显卡驱动配置、日常软件、媒体制作及编程环境搭建。采用docsify构建在线文档，定位实用导向的tutorial，强调简洁无废话。每日实时更新，适用于从零开始将Arch打造为主力系统的用户。
summary.en: A comprehensive Chinese tutorial covering Arch Linux installation and usage, from system setup, network configuration, graphics drivers to daily software, media production, and programming environments. Built with docsify for online documentation, emphasizing practical and concise guidance with daily updates. Ideal for users building Arch as their primary system.

metadata.name: Music163bot-Go
metadata.description: 一个用来下载/分享网易云歌曲的Telegram Bot

summary.zh: 一个用Go语言开发的Telegram音乐机器人，专注于网易云音乐。用户可通过它搜索歌曲、下载无损FLAC音频、嗅探分享链接并快速分享。核心亮点是采用yaegi框架实现动态扩展，支持自动更新、MD5校验和自动重试机制，提供稳定可靠的音乐获取服务。
summary.en: A Go-based Telegram bot for NetEase Cloud Music. Users can search songs, download lossless FLAC audio, sniff shared links, and share music quickly via inline mode. Key highlight is the yaegi-powered dynamic extension system with auto-update, MD5 verification, and auto-retry for reliable music retrieval.

metadata.name: hammerspoon
metadata.description: Staggeringly powerful macOS desktop automation with Lua

summary.zh: Hammerspoon 是 macOS 平台强大的桌面自动化工具，通过 Lua 脚本引擎连接操作系统与用户。它提供丰富的扩展模块，可控制窗口管理、快捷键绑定、系统监控、剪贴板等 macOS 环境方方面面。用户编写 Lua 代码即可实现高度定制化的自动化工作流，是 Mjolnir 的功能增强分支。
summary.en: Hammerspoon is a staggeringly powerful macOS desktop automation tool that bridges the operating system with a Lua scripting engine. It exposes system APIs through extensions, enabling users to control window management, hotkeys, system monitoring, clipboard, and more via Lua scripts. This fork of Mjolnir provides a more integrated automation experience for macOS power users.

metadata.name: Render-dragon-shader-list
metadata.description: List of shaders and related information, files, etc. that are compatible with RenderDragon.

summary.zh: RenderDragon（Minecraft Bedrock渲染引擎）着色器资源列表仓库，帮助用户识别假冒着色器并获取可靠的着色器包。提供BetterRTX、YSS RD等主流着色器的下载链接与评测信息，包含详细的安装指南，并设有Discord社区供用户交流。
summary.en: A curated list of RenderDragon-compatible shaders for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, helping users distinguish fake shaders and find reliable packs. Provides download links and reviews for popular shaders like BetterRTX and YSS RD, with detailed installation guides and a Discord community for user support.

metadata.name: monaspace
metadata.description: An innovative superfamily of fonts for code

summary.zh: GitHub Next 开发的创新代码字体超家族，包含5种可变轴字体系列，各具独特风格但度量完全兼容可自由混用。核心创新Texture Healing技术解决等宽字体纹理断裂问题，支持静态、变量及Nerd Fonts补丁等多元格式，提供出色的代码可视化体验。
summary.en: An innovative monospaced font superfamily developed by GitHub Next, featuring five variable axis typefaces with unique voices but metrics-compatible design for mixing. Pioneered Texture Healing technique to resolve visual inconsistency in monospaced fonts. Supports static, variable, and Nerd Fonts patched formats.

metadata.name: docker-gitbook-pdf-generator
metadata.description: 如果你想使用 GitBook 生成 PDF ，又不想折腾，使用这个项目就对啦！

summary.zh: 这是一个 Docker 化的 GitBook PDF 生成工具，基于 Python weasyprint 引擎。相比 GitBook 原生方案，该工具生成的 PDF 文件体积更小且支持压缩，并提供中文字体支持。通过简单的 Docker 命令即可将 GitBook 在线内容转换为轻量级 PDF，适用于电子书制作与文档离线分发。
summary.en: A Docker-based GitBook PDF generator using Python weasyprint engine. This tool produces compact PDFs with compression support, featuring Chinese font compatibility. Users can convert GitBook content to lightweight PDFs via simple Docker commands, ideal for e-book creation and offline document distribution.

metadata.name: geoip
metadata.description: 🌚 🌍 🌝 GeoIP 增强版，支持自由定制 V2Ray dat 格式文件 geoip.dat、MaxMind mmdb 格式文件、sing-box SRS 格式文件、mihomo MRS 格式文件、Clash ruleset、Surge ruleset 等。Enhanced edition of GeoIP for V2Ray, Xray-core, sing-box, Clash, mihomo, Shadowrocket, Quantumult X, Surge, hysteria, Trojan-Go, Leaf, Nginx, etc.

summary.zh: GeoIP 增强版工具，自动生成适用于 V2Ray、Xray-core、sing-box、mihomo、Clash、Surge 等代理软件的多种 GeoIP 数据库格式文件。基于 MaxMind GeoLite2 数据增强，新增 cloudflare、google、telegram 等特殊类别，并使用 gaoyifan/china-operator-ip 优化中国大陆 IP 数据。每周四自动更新，支持 CLI 定制。
summary.en: GeoIP enhanced tool generating multi-format GeoIP database files for proxy software including V2Ray, Xray-core, sing-box, mihomo, Clash, and Surge. Based on MaxMind GeoLite2 with custom enhancements for cloudflare, google, telegram categories, and improved China mainland IP data. Auto-updated weekly with CLI customization support.

metadata.name: ML-For-Beginners
metadata.description: 12 weeks, 26 lessons, 52 quizzes, classic Machine Learning for all

summary.zh: 微软出品的机器学习入门课程，12周系统学习路径包含26节课程与52个随堂测验。涵盖经典机器学习核心算法与实践应用，支持50+语言翻译，适合零基础学习者构建完整ML知识体系。
