summary.en: Microsoft's machine learning curriculum featuring 12 weeks of structured learning with 26 lessons and 52 quizzes. Covers classic ML algorithms and practical applications, supporting 50+ languages. Ideal for beginners building a solid foundation in machine learning.

metadata.name: music
metadata.description: a music player forked from YesPlayMusic。高颜值的第三方网易云播放器，支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron/Docker:

summary.zh: R3PLAYX 是一款基于 React + Electron 开发的高颜值第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Docker 部署。核心功能包括网易云账号登录、MV 播放、歌词显示、私人 FM 等，无社交功能干扰，提供纯净专注的音乐体验。
summary.en: R3PLAYX is a high-UI third-party NetEase Cloud Music player built with React and Electron, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Docker deployment. It offers core features including account login, MV playback, lyrics display, and Private FM, providing a distraction-free music experience.

metadata.name: surge-list
metadata.description: Rules for Surge. DOMAIN-SET update daily.

summary.zh: Surge 网络代理工具的域名规则集仓库，托管 AdGuard 等来源维护的过滤规则，支持广告屏蔽、Cookie 弹窗、社交媒体跟踪等过滤场景，规则通过 jsDelivr CDN 分发，每日自动更新。
summary.en: A DOMAIN-SET rule repository for Surge network proxy, hosting AdGuard-maintained filters for ad blocking, annoyances removal, and tracking protection, distributed via jsDelivr CDN with daily automated updates.

metadata.name: QuantumultX-Rewrite
metadata.description: QuantumultX QX quantumult 圈X quanx 重写 脚本 rewrite 规则 分流 破解 解锁

summary.zh: QuantumultX重写规则合集，提供去广告脚本、会员功能解锁、网络分流规则等配置。支持Spotify、WPS、酷我等主流应用的VIP功能破解，包含Emby、番茄小说等娱乐应用的重写规则，一站式满足iOS代理用户的网络优化与功能解锁需求。
summary.en: A comprehensive collection of QuantumultX rewrite rules featuring ad removal scripts, VIP unlocks for Spotify/WPS/Kuwo, and network traffic routing configurations. Covers mainstream apps like Emby and Fanqie Novel, serving as an all-in-one solution for iOS proxy users seeking ad-free experience and premium feature access.

metadata.name: clash-speedtest
metadata.description: clash speedtest

summary.zh: 基于 Clash/Mihomo 内核的代理节点测速工具，可直接读取配置文件或订阅地址进行节点速度测试。支持多协议代理类型，提供延迟、带宽、丢包率等多维度测试指标，支持正则过滤节点和自动筛选优质节点，适用于 OpenWRT 等路由环境。
summary.en: A speed testing tool leveraging Clash/Mihomo core for proxy nodes. It parses config files or subscription URLs to test node performance with metrics like latency, bandwidth, and packet loss. Features regex-based filtering and automatic quality node selection, ideal for OpenWRT and router environments.

metadata.name: Surge
metadata.description: Surge自用配置以及模块和脚本

summary.zh: Surge网络代理工具的自用配置文件仓库，包含分流规则、重写规则及JavaScript脚本。集成blackmatrix7和iRingo等公开脚本库，实现广告拦截、代理分流及Apple服务解锁等功能。专为iOS平台设计，提供稳定版配置和模块供用户参考使用。
summary.en: A personal configuration repository for Surge network proxy tool, featuring分流规则, rewrite rules, and JavaScript scripts. Integrates public script libraries like blackmatrix7 and iRingo for ad blocking, proxy routing, and Apple service unlocking. Designed for iOS platform with stable configs and modules.

metadata.name: server
metadata.description: Revive unavailable songs for Netease Cloud Music (Refactored & Enhanced version)

summary.zh: 增强版网易云音乐解锁工具，通过代理技术解决歌曲地区限制和变灰问题。支持多音源自动替换、HTTP/HTTPS 代理及 PAC 代理模式，可作为系统代理使用。提供 Docker、Node.js 直接运行、Windows 服务等多种部署方式，兼容 Android Xposed 和 OpenWrt 插件。
summary.en: Enhanced Netease Cloud Music unlocker using proxy technology to bypass regional restrictions and greyed-out songs. Supports multi-source replacement, HTTP/HTTPS proxy with PAC mode, and flexible deployment via Docker, Node.js, or Windows service. Compatible with Android Xposed and OpenWrt plugins.

metadata.name: v2ray-agent
metadata.description: Xray、Tuic、hysteria2、sing-box 八合一一键脚本

summary.zh: 集成Xray、sing-box等核心的代理协议一键部署脚本，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Hysteria2、Tuic等8种协议，自动申请续订TLS证书，提供订阅链接生成、流量分流与域名管理功能，适用于VPS网络代理和流媒体解锁场景。
summary.en: An all-in-one proxy script integrating Xray and sing-box cores, supporting 8 protocols including VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Hysteria2, and Tuic with automatic TLS management, subscription generation, and traffic routing for VPS deployment and streaming media unblocking.

metadata.name: phantun
metadata.description: Transforms UDP stream into (fake) TCP streams that can go through Layer 3 & Layer 4 (NAPT) firewalls/NATs.

summary.zh: Phantun是一个轻量级UDP转TCP混淆器，可将UDP流量伪装成TCP流以穿透L3/L4防火墙和NAT限制。它采用100%安全Rust编写，保留UDP的无重传、无流量控制特性，性能优异且支持多核扩展。适用于UDP被封锁但TCP可达的网络环境。
summary.en: Phantun is a lightweight UDP-to-TCP obfuscator that transforms UDP streams into fake TCP packets to bypass L3/L4 firewalls and NATs. Written in 100% safe Rust, it preserves UDP characteristics like out-of-order delivery while avoiding TCP performance killers. Optimized for multi-core scaling, ideal for environments where UDP is blocked but TCP is allowed.

metadata.name: sgmodule
metadata.description: surge module

summary.zh: Surge 网络工具的模块集合，提供 YouTube 去广告与翻译、Bilibili 去弹幕广告、阿里云 DNS 配置及 Keep 去广告等功能。通过模块化设计，用户可针对特定应用实现网络优化与功能增强，提升移动端浏览体验。
summary.en: A collection of Surge modules for network enhancement. Features include YouTube ad-blocking with translation, Bilibili ad and danmaku removal, Aliyun DoH configuration, and Keep app ad elimination. The modular architecture enables selective installation for targeted app optimization.

metadata.name: Adblock4limbo
metadata.description: 毒奶去网页广告计划用户脚本 For Quantumult X & Surge & Shadowrocket & Loon & Stash & 油猴 ；1.导航 2.通过 JS/CSS 移除特定网站网页广告 —— 搜索引擎（Bing/Google）广告及内容农场结果清除/低端影视/欧乐影院/iyf爱壹帆/哔滴影视/Pornhub/Javbus/Supjav/Jable(M3U8)/MissAv/91porn/hitomi/紳士漫畫/禁漫天堂/等视频&ACG&小说&漫画网站上的弹窗广告&视频广告&Gif广告，沉浸式翻译/提取M3U8等，保持网页清爽干净无打扰！ P.S. 欢迎提交issue

summary.zh: 毒奶去广告计划是一款专为iOS代理工具设计的去广告用户脚本，支持Quantumult X/Surge/Shadowrocket/Loon/Stash及油猴。通过JS/CSS选择器精准移除搜索引擎广告、内容农场、视频网站弹窗及成人网站广告，并提供沉浸式翻译、M3U8提取等增强功能，保持网页清爽无打扰。
summary.en: Adblock4limbo is an ad-blocking userscript for iOS proxy tools (Quantumult X/Surge/Shadowrocket/Loon/Stash/Tampermonkey). It removes ads via JS/CSS selectors across search engines, video sites, and adult websites, featuring immersive translation and M3U8 extraction for a distraction-free browsing experience.

metadata.name: Universal
metadata.description: 通用流媒体平台增强及双语字幕解决方案

summary.zh: 通用流媒体平台双语字幕增强工具，支持在各类视频网站同步显示原文与翻译字幕，提升跨语言观影和学习体验。采用用户脚本架构，兼容多浏览器。
summary.en: Universal bilingual subtitle enhancement tool for streaming platforms that displays original and translated subtitles simultaneously, improving cross-language viewing and learning experience with a userscript architecture.

metadata.name: Script
metadata.description: QuantumultX｜Surge｜Loon

summary.zh: iOS网络代理配置脚本仓库，集成QuantumultX、Surge、Loon三款主流代理工具的规则与脚本。汇集NobyDa、chavyleung等多位知名开发者贡献的规则集，支持广告屏蔽、流量分流、代理自动切换等核心功能，为iOS用户提供一站式网络管理方案。
summary.en: A comprehensive iOS proxy configuration repository featuring scripts and rules for QuantumultX, Surge, and Loon. Consolidates contributions from renowned developers like NobyDa and chavyleung, offering ad blocking, traffic routing, and automatic proxy switching capabilities for seamless network management on iOS devices.

metadata.name: Dress
metadata.description: 好耶 是女装 | 备份·接受PR

summary.zh: 一个以女装照片为主题的 Git 学习社区项目，帮助零基础用户通过提交 PR 实践掌握克隆、创建分支、提交代码和合并请求的完整 Git/GitHub 工作流程。无需编程技能，轻松有趣，适合开源新手入门。
summary.en: A community-driven Git learning project themed around crossdressing photos, guiding beginners through the complete Git/GitHub workflow: cloning, branching, commits, and PR merging. No coding skills required—perfect for open-source newcomers to get hands-on experience.

metadata.name: rime
metadata.description: Rime Squirrel 鼠须管配置文件（朙月拼音、小鹤双拼、自然码双拼）

summary.zh: Rime 鼠须管输入法配置仓库，支持朙月拼音、小鹤双拼、自然码双拼等输入方案。集成百万搜狗词库与 Emoji，提供时间日期动态输入功能。跨平台同步备份，保护隐私，开源可定制，适合追求高效中文输入的 macOS 用户。
summary.en: Configuration repository for Rime Squirrel input method on macOS, supporting Luna Pinyin, Double Pinyin (Flypy & Ziranma). Features 1M+ Sogou dictionary, Emoji support, and dynamic date/time input. Cross-platform sync, privacy-focused, open-source and highly customizable.

metadata.name: uPic
metadata.description: 📤uPic is a native, powerful, beautiful and simple picture and file upload tool for macOS.

summary.zh: uPic 是 macOS 原生图片/文件上传客户端，支持 smms、七牛云、阿里云OSS、腾讯云COS、Github 等多种图床。可自动截图上传，上传完成后自动复制链接到剪贴板，支持 URL/HTML/Markdown 多种格式，菜单栏实时显示上传进度。
summary.en: uPic is a native macOS image and file upload client supporting multiple image hosts including smms, Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, and Github. Features include automatic screenshot upload, clipboard auto-copy, multiple link formats (URL/HTML/Markdown), and real-time menu bar upload progress display.

metadata.name: mini
metadata.description: mini icon

summary.zh: 专为Quantumult X、Loon、Pharos Pro等代理工具设计的图标资源库，包含机场订阅、Task、节点地区、策略组等多类型图标，提供彩色(Color)和透明(Alpha)两种风格版本，支持远程URL引用，可用于界面个性化定制与图标管理。
summary.en: An icon resource library designed for proxy tools like Quantumult X, Loon, and Pharos Pro, featuring airport subscription icons, task icons, region icons, and policy group icons. Offers both colorful and transparent versions with remote URL referencing support for UI customization.

metadata.name: surge-rules
metadata.description: 🦄 🎃 👻 Surge 规则集(DOMAIN-SET 和 RULE-SET)，适用于 Surge for iOS 和 Surge for Mac 客户端。

summary.zh: Surge 规则集仓库，提供直连、代理、广告拦截等分类域名列表，支持 DOMAIN-SET 和 RULE-SET 格式。数据整合自 v2ray-rules、domain-list-community 等知名项目，通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动构建更新。适用于 iOS/Mac 版 Surge 用户实现智能分流与广告屏蔽。
summary.en: A Surge rule set repository providing categorized domain lists for direct connection, proxy, and ad blocking. Supports DOMAIN-SET and RULE-SET formats, aggregating data from v2ray-rules and domain-list-community. Auto-built daily via GitHub Actions for iOS/Mac Surge users to enable smart routing and ad filtering.

metadata.name: dufs
metadata.description: A file server that supports static serving, uploading, searching, accessing control, webdav...

summary.zh: Dufs 是由 Rust 编写的轻量级文件服务器，支持静态文件托管、文件夹 ZIP 下载、拖拽上传、断点续传、文件搜索与编辑、精细化访问控制、WebDAV 协议及 HTTPS 加密传输，提供命令行配置与 Docker 部署，开箱即用。
summary.en: Dufs is a lightweight file server written in Rust, featuring static file hosting, folder ZIP download, drag-and-drop upload, resumable transfers, file search and editing, fine-grained access control, WebDAV protocol support, and HTTPS encryption, deployable via CLI or Docker.

metadata.name: my_yesplaymusic
metadata.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器，支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词、Linux-gnome环境状态栏歌词显示。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:

summary.zh: 基于Electron的高颜值第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持Windows/macOS/Linux跨平台运行。核心功能包括本地音乐扫描播放、离线歌单、桌面/Touch Bar/状态栏多形式歌词显示，以及歌曲评论系统。采用Vue.js构建界面，通过UnblockNeteaseMusic解锁灰色歌曲，为海外用户提供流畅的网易云音乐体验。
summary.en: A high-appearance third-party NetEase Cloud Music player built with Electron, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux. Key features include local music playback, offline playlists, multi-format lyrics display (desktop/Touch Bar/status bar), and song comment system. Built with Vue.js and powered by UnblockNeteaseMusic to unblock grayed-out songs, providing seamless experience for overseas users.

metadata.name: pytorch-tutorial
metadata.description: PyTorch Tutorial for Deep Learning Researchers

summary.zh: 面向深度学习研究人员的PyTorch教程仓库，涵盖从基础到高级的完整学习路径。包含CNN、ResNet、RNN等经典模型，以及GAN、VAE、神经风格迁移、图像captioning等前沿技术的简洁实现示例，代码精简至30行以内，适合快速入门与实践参考。
summary.en: A comprehensive PyTorch tutorial repository for deep learning researchers, offering a complete learning path from basics to advanced topics. Features concise implementations of CNN, ResNet, RNN, GAN, VAE, neural style transfer, and image captioning in under 30 lines of code, ideal for quick learning and practical reference.

metadata.name: ShellCrash
metadata.description: Run sing-box/mihomo as client in shell

summary.zh: ShellCrash是一款强大的Shell脚本工具，用于在Shell环境中便捷部署和管理mihomo/sing-box代理内核。支持OpenWrt路由器、Linux服务器及Docker等多种平台，提供订阅配置、Web仪表板、规则管理和自动更新等特性，适合需要快速部署透明代理的用户。
summary.en: ShellCrash is a powerful Shell script tool for convenient deployment and management of mihomo/sing-box proxy kernels in shell environments. It supports OpenWrt routers, Linux servers, and Docker platforms, offering subscription configuration, Web dashboard, rule management, and automatic updates for users needing quick transparent proxy deployment.

metadata.name: Mos
metadata.description: 一个用于在 macOS 上平滑你的鼠标滚动效果或单独设置滚动方向的小工具, 让你的滚轮爽如触控板  |  A lightweight tool used to smooth scrolling and set scroll direction independently for your mouse on macOS

summary.zh: Mos 是一款 macOS 菜单栏工具，通过接管鼠标滚轮事件并插值转换，实现触控板级顺滑滚动体验。支持垂直/水平轴独立配置平滑和反向、按键重映射、按应用覆盖规则，以及 Logi Bolt/Unifying 接收器和蓝牙设备的 HID++ 支持。
summary.en: Mos is a macOS menu bar utility that intercepts mouse wheel events and applies interpolation to deliver trackpad-like smooth scrolling. It supports independent vertical/horizontal configuration, button remapping, per-app rules, and Logi HID++ device integration via Bolt, Unifying or Bluetooth.

metadata.name: vim-galore-zh_cn
metadata.description: Vim 从入门到精通

summary.zh: Vim 从入门到精通教程的中文翻译项目，系统讲解 Vim 编辑器的基础操作、配置技巧与高级用法，帮助开发者高效掌握这款经典终端编辑器。
summary.en: A comprehensive Chinese translation of the Vim tutorial, covering Vim basics, configuration, and advanced usage to help developers master this classic terminal editor efficiently.

metadata.name: Rules-For-Quantumult-X
metadata.description: 适用于 Quantumult X 规则整理集合. 所有内容源自 互联网,仅作为收集和整理

summary.zh: 面向 Quantumult X 用户的规则集合仓库，涵盖分流、Rewrite 重写与去广告功能。支持国内直连、海外加速、Apple 服务加速及海外媒体指定节点，可拦截运营商劫持、欺诈网站和应用广告。提供 CDN 镜像加速，适合追求精细化网络分流与隐私保护的 iOS 用户。
summary.en: A comprehensive rule repository for Quantumult X, featuring traffic routing, URL rewriting, and ad blocking. It supports direct connections for domestic traffic, overseas acceleration, Apple service optimization, and media-specific node selection. Also blocks ISP hijacking, fraudulent sites, and in-app ads with CDN acceleration for reliable updates.

metadata.name: Script
metadata.description: This project is based on the scripting capabilities of several excellent iOS proxy tools (e.g. Surge, Quantumult X)

summary.zh: 面向 iOS 网络代理工具（Surge、Quantumult X、Loon、Stash）的脚本集合，提供电商签到、视频平台任务、漫画签到等自动化功能。通过 MITM 技术增强应用行为，支持策略组切换、流量查询等网络管理能力。
summary.en: A script collection for iOS proxy tools (Surge, Quantumult X, Loon, Stash) providing automated daily bonus tasks for e-commerce, video platforms, and manga apps. Uses MITM to enhance app functionality with policy switching and traffic monitoring capabilities.

metadata.name: ios_rule_script
metadata.description: 分流规则、重写写规则及脚本。

summary.zh: iOS平台网络代理分流规则与重写规则的开源合集，支持Quantumult X、Shadowrocket等主流代理工具。项目整合多个开源规则源，提供分流、重写、广告过滤等功能。内置MagicJS框架编写的自动化脚本，支持什么值得买、百度贴吧、叮咚买菜等主流应用的自动签到、开屏去广告及Apple Store库存监控等实用功能。
summary.en: An open-source collection of iOS proxy routing rules and rewrite rules for Quantumult X, Shadowrocket and other proxy tools. This project aggregates multiple open-source rule sources for traffic routing, request rewriting and ad blocking. Features automation scripts built with MagicJS framework supporting auto check-in, ad removal and inventory monitoring for popular apps like SMZDM, Tieba and Dingdong.

metadata.name: thorough-pytorch
metadata.description: PyTorch入门教程，在线阅读地址：https://datawhalechina.github.io/thorough-pytorch/

summary.zh: DataWhale开源的PyTorch深度学习入门教程，涵盖从环境安装、张量运算、自动求导到模型部署的完整学习路径。教程包含10个章节，配有Jupyter Notebook实战项目，以Markdown形式沉淀知识，通过组队学习模式帮助初学者系统掌握PyTorch框架核心技能。
summary.en: An open-source PyTorch tutorial by DataWhale, covering the complete journey from installation and tensor operations to model deployment. This 10-chapter course features Jupyter Notebook projects and Markdown guides, designed to help beginners master PyTorch through collaborative team-based learning with hands-on practice.

summary.zh: 这是一款创新的二维码字体库，将每个中文字符转换为独立的二维码图形。支持6万多个字符，可用于字面信息隐藏，增加文本阅读难度。用户扫描二维码可逐字获取信息，适合创意文字设计、信息加密等场景。
summary.en: An innovative QR code font library that converts individual Chinese characters into QR code glyphs. Supporting over 60,000 characters, it enables text information hiding and adds reading difficulty. Users scan QR codes character by character for creative typography and information encryption.

metadata.name: BedrockMap
metadata.description: GUI application  for bedrock level (Map biomes and so on)

summary.zh: BedrockMap 是一款 Minecraft 基岩版地图查看与编辑工具，提供图形化界面支持地图渲染和生物群系可视化。用户可通过 GUI 直观浏览、编辑游戏世界数据，适用于地图创作、服务器管理和地形数据分析等场景。
summary.en: BedrockMap is a GUI-based map viewer and editor for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, offering world rendering and biome visualization. It enables intuitive map browsing and editing, suitable for map creation, server management, and terrain data analysis.

metadata.name: giscus
metadata.description: A commenting system powered by GitHub Discussions. :octocat: :speech_balloon: :gem:

summary.zh: giscus 是一个基于 GitHub Discussions 的开源评论系统，让网站访客可通过 GitHub 账号发表评论和反应。无需数据库，所有数据存储在 GitHub Discussions 中。支持多语言、自定义主题，可自动获取新评论。灵感来源于 utterances，支持自托管。
summary.en: giscus is an open-source commenting system powered by GitHub Discussions, enabling website visitors to leave comments and reactions via GitHub accounts. No database required—all data is stored in GitHub Discussions. Supports multiple languages, custom themes, and automatic comment fetching. Inspired by utterances with self-hosting capability.

metadata.name: d2l-zh
metadata.description: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。

summary.zh: 《动手学深度学习》是一本面向中文读者的开源深度学习教材，强调"学以致用"。该书将理论、代码与数学有机结合，通过Jupyter Notebooks提供可执行代码，覆盖从基础到进阶的深度学习核心内容。被全球500多所大学用于教学，是深度学习入门与实践的经典资源。
summary.en: D2L is an open-source deep learning textbook for Chinese readers, emphasizing hands-on learning with executable code. It integrates theory, code, and mathematics through Jupyter Notebooks, covering core deep learning topics from basics to advanced. Adopted by 500+ universities worldwide, it's a classic resource for learning and practicing deep learning.

metadata.name: Dango-Translator
metadata.description: 梦想是做出最棒的生肉翻译软件喵

summary.zh: 团子翻译器是一款开源生肉翻译工具，通过OCR识别屏幕文字或图片内容，支持实时翻译和漫画翻译两种模式。集成离线/在线OCR引擎，可自动识别区域文本并调用多源翻译API输出结果。具备账号云同步、图片消字嵌字等实用功能，已用Golang完全重构。
summary.en: Dango-Translator is an open-source tool for translating untranslated content using OCR to recognize screen text or images, supporting real-time and manga translation modes. It integrates offline/online OCR engines, automatically identifies text in selected regions, and outputs translations via multiple APIs. Features include cloud sync, image text removal and typesetting, rewritten in Golang.

metadata.name: wallpaper-player-mac
metadata.description: A powerful open source live wallpaper app for mac

summary.zh: 一款 macOS 平台的开源动态壁纸播放器，支持将视频设为桌面壁纸，提供流畅的动态桌面体验。项目采用原生开发，性能优异，适合追求个性化桌面的用户。
summary.en: An open-source live wallpaper player for macOS that enables users to set videos as desktop wallpapers. Built with native development for optimal performance, it offers a smooth dynamic desktop experience for personalization enthusiasts.

metadata.name: Paolujichang
metadata.description: 科学上网🕸️之跑路机场名单收集（2020-2026），欢迎投稿。Ad🔗🈲🙅❌

summary.zh: 跑路机场名单收集项目，始于2020年，专注记录已关闭或存在跑路风险的机场服务商。收录2024-2026年快帆云、FCCloud、BoomCloud等数十家机场信息，含警告级别与用户反馈链接。社区可通过GitHub Issues或电报机器人投稿，帮助用户规避风险。
summary.en: A community-driven blacklist of defunct or risky VPN service providers (机场) from 2020-2026. Tracks 40+ services including KuaiFanCloud, FCCloud, and BoomCloud with warning levels and user reports. Submissions via GitHub Issues or Telegram bot to help users avoid unreliable providers.

metadata.name: typescript-tutorial
metadata.description: TypeScript 教程

summary.zh: 这是一个面向初学者的 TypeScript 开源教程，系统讲解 TypeScript 的基本概念、类型系统、语法特性和最佳实践。内容涵盖类型注解、接口、泛型、装饰器等核心知识点，配有丰富的代码示例，帮助开发者快速掌握 TypeScript 开发技能。
summary.en: An open-source TypeScript tutorial designed for beginners, systematically explaining TypeScript's basic concepts, type system, syntax features, and best practices. Covering core topics like type annotations, interfaces, generics, and decorators with abundant code examples to help developers quickly master TypeScript development skills.

metadata.name: CialloResearch
metadata.description: Research project of Ciallo for SIGGRAPH publication

summary.zh: Ciallo是香港科技大学团队开发的GPU加速矢量画笔渲染技术，已发表两篇SIGGRAPH论文。研究聚焦于将笔触数据高效转换为渲染多段线，通过算术序列采样避免重新参数化。提供Web演示和Blender Grease Pencil集成方案，旨在实现工业级开源矢量绘画程序。
summary.en: Ciallo is a GPU-accelerated vector brush stroke rendering research by HKUST team, published at SIGGRAPH 2023 and 2024. It focuses on efficient conversion of stroke data to rendered polylines using arithmetic sequence sampling to avoid reparameterization. Offers web demo and Blender Grease Pencil integration, aiming to create industrial-level open-source vector paint program.

metadata.name: arch-guide
metadata.description: ✨ archlinux 简明指南 | 本指南包含从 archlinux 安装、显卡驱动、日常软件配置、多媒体制作、编程等你可能需要的全部内容 | 提供在线文档 ✨

summary.zh: 这是一份面向 Arch Linux 新手的简明配置指南，涵盖系统安装、显卡驱动、日常软件配置及开发环境搭建。指南采用 VitePress 构建在线文档，详细讲解原理并提供可视化内容。派生自 ArchLinuxTutorial，强调实用性原则，支持 Docker 等多种本地运行方式。
summary.en: A comprehensive Arch Linux guide covering system installation, GPU drivers, daily software configuration, and development environment setup. Built with VitePress for online documentation, it provides detailed explanations with visual content. Derived from ArchLinuxTutorial with a practical approach, supporting multiple local run methods including Docker.

metadata.name: llm-action
metadata.description: 本项目旨在分享大模型相关技术原理以及实战经验（大模型工程化、大模型应用落地）

summary.zh: 这是一个专注于大模型工程化与应用落地的综合性技术仓库，涵盖LLM训练（分布式训练、RLHF对齐）、推理优化（框架、加速）、模型压缩（量化、剪枝、知识蒸馏）以及LLMOps全流程。提供从6B到65B模型的实战教程，包含LoRA、QLoRA等高效微调技术的原理与代码实现，是AI工程师学习大模型工程实践的重要资源。
summary.en: A comprehensive repository focused on LLM engineering and application deployment, covering training (distributed training, RLHF alignment), inference optimization (frameworks, acceleration), model compression (quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation), and LLMOps workflows. Offers practical tutorials from 6B to 65B models with efficient fine-tuning techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, serving as a key resource for AI engineers mastering LLM engineering practices.

metadata.name: yabai
metadata.description: A tiling window manager for macOS based on binary space partitioning

summary.zh: yabai 是一款基于二进制空间分割（BSP）算法的 macOS 平铺式窗口管理器。它作为 macOS 内置窗口管理器的扩展，通过命令行界面实现窗口、空间和显示器的灵活控制，支持键盘快捷键绑定、焦点跟随鼠标等功能，显著提升多任务处理效率。
summary.en: yabai is a tiling window manager for macOS based on binary space partitioning. It extends macOS's built-in window manager, providing intuitive command-line control over windows, spaces, and displays with support for keyboard shortcuts and focus-follows-mouse, dramatically improving multi-tasking productivity.

metadata.name: PyQuickInstall
metadata.description: :zap::zap::zap:超好用的pip下载加速工具，谁用谁知道！

summary.zh: pqi是一个Python包管理加速工具，通过快速切换PyPi源（清华、豆瓣、阿里云、中科大等国内镜像）解决pip下载速度慢、超时失败的问题。支持py2/py3及全平台，提供ls、use、show、add、remove等命令管理pip源，一键提速效果显著。
summary.en: pqi is a Python package manager acceleration tool that solves slow pip download speeds and timeout failures by quickly switching PyPi sources to domestic mirrors (Tuna, Douban, Aliyun, USTC). Supports py2/py3 across all platforms with commands like ls, use, show, add, and remove for managing pip sources, delivering significant speed improvements.

metadata.name: rmtrash
metadata.description: rmtrash 是linux和mac下命令行版本rm的回收站，安装后对用户透明，符合正常使用rm的习惯(支持rm -fr file哦)，有了他再也不怕rm时候手颤抖了(能自动拒绝 rm -fr / 哦)。 rmtrash stands for "rm trash" which acts just like the system built-in rm command,and just moves the file to the trash for recovery when needed.

summary.zh: rmtrash 是 Linux/macOS 命令行 rm 的安全替代工具，通过 alias 机制透明替换 rm 命令，将删除操作改为移动文件到回收站。支持 rm 所有常用参数（-rf、-fr 等），并自动拒绝危险操作如 `rm -fr /`。提供列表、恢复、清空等回收站管理功能，有效防止命令行误删文件。
summary.en: rmtrash is a safe replacement for Linux/macOS command-line rm utility. It transparently intercepts rm commands via alias, moving files to trash instead of permanent deletion. Supports all common rm flags including -rf and -fr, with built-in protection against dangerous operations like rm -fr /. Provides trash management with list, restore, and empty functions.

metadata.name: Dress
metadata.description: 好耶  是女装

summary.zh: 一个以「女装」为主题的趣味仓库，基于二次元网络文化中的经典梗「好耶 是女装」创建。仓库内容轻松幽默，可能包含女装相关的图片、素材或社区分享内容，适合ACG文化爱好者与女装社群交流探讨。
summary.en: A fun repository themed around crossdressing culture, based on the popular internet meme 'Yay, it's crossdressing!' from the anime community. This lighthearted project likely contains crossdressing-related images, materials, or community shares, catering to ACG enthusiasts and crossdressing communities.

metadata.name: Locale_Remulator
metadata.description: System Region and Language Simulator.

summary.zh: 系统区域和语言模拟器，通过 API Hook 技术为单个应用程序注入指定区域设置，解决因系统区域不匹配导致的乱码、兼容性等问题。支持 32/64 位程序，右键菜单一键切换区域配置，适用于运行海外游戏或测试软件跨区域兼容性场景。
summary.en: A system region and language simulator that injects specified locale settings into individual applications via API Hooking, solving encoding and compatibility issues caused by system locale mismatches. Supports 32/64-bit programs with right-click menu integration for quick locale switching, ideal for running overseas games or testing software cross-region compatibility.

metadata.name: Dress
metadata.description: 好耶  是女装

summary.zh: 一个独特的Git学习与实践项目，通过收集参与者女装照的方式激发学习动力。无需编程基础，通过提交Pull Request即可掌握克隆、创建分支、提交、同步和合并等Git全流程操作。无关性别，人人可参与，适合Git初学者入门协作开发，采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0开源许可。
summary.en: A unique Git study and practice project that motivates learning through collecting participants' crossdressing photos. No coding skills required - contributors learn the full Git workflow by submitting Pull Requests. Open to anyone regardless of gender, perfect for Git beginners to learn collaborative development, licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.zh: bunwv是基于Bun.WebView的无头浏览器自动化CLI工具。采用持久守护进程设计，保持浏览器实例存活，支持DOM状态、模态框、表单、认证和Cookie跨命令持久化。macOS默认使用原生WebKit引擎（零依赖），Linux和Windows自动切换至Chrome/Chromium。专为AI编程助手设计：操作成功时静默输出，错误以JSON格式返回stderr，配合稳定退出码，便于Claude Code、Cursor等工具通过离散工具调用驱动浏览器执行复杂任务。
summary.en: bunwv is a headless browser automation CLI for Bun powered by Bun.WebView. It maintains a persistent daemon keeping browser state alive—DOM, modals, forms, auth, cookies—across commands. Cross-platform: native WebKit on macOS (zero dependencies), Chrome on Linux/Windows. Agent-first design: successful action verbs are silent, errors are JSON on stderr with stable exit codes. Built for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor to drive browser automation through discrete tool calls.

metadata.name: Dress-Backup-Detached
metadata.description: 这里仅做备份！现在最活跃的repo是：https://github.com/Cute-Dress/Dress

summary.zh: 这是一个有趣的Git学习社区项目，参与者通过提交女装照片的方式练习Git操作全流程，包括克隆仓库、创建分支、提交修改和发起Pull Request。项目无需编程技能，适合初学者熟悉Git/GitHub协作规范与工作流。
summary.en: A fun Git learning community project where participants practice the complete Git workflow by submitting crossdressing photos. Users learn cloning, branching, committing, and pull requests without coding skills. Perfect for beginners to master Git/GitHub collaboration.

metadata.name: TrollStore-IPAs
metadata.description: A collection of IPA files from many different sources, for TrollStore!

summary.zh: 面向iOS TrollStore用户的IPA文件集合仓库，收录多源第三方iOS应用。提供ESign、Appdb、TrollApps等平台的一键导入功能，按日期持续更新IPA资源。该项目已于2025年4月宣布EOL停止维护。
summary.en: A curated collection of IPA files for iOS TrollStore users, aggregating apps from various sources. Supports quick import via ESign, Appdb, and TrollApps platforms with daily releases. This project was officially EOL'd in April 2025.

metadata.name: book-cn
metadata.description: Rust  程序设计语言 中文版——Chinese translation of The Rust Programming Language (Book)

summary.zh: 《Rust程序设计语言》中文翻译版，由Rust中文翻译项目组维护，100%完成翻译。基于mdBook构建，托管于rustwiki.org，支持中英双语切换阅读。内容与英文原版同步更新，涵盖Rust基础、所有权系统、生命周期、错误处理、并发编程等核心主题，是系统学习Rust语言的权威中文资源。
summary.en: Chinese translation of The Rust Programming Language, the official Rust book. 100% translated and maintained by the Rust Chinese Translation Project. Built with mdBook, hosted on rustwiki.org with bilingual support. Covers Rust fundamentals, ownership, lifetimes, error handling, concurrency, and more. Dual-licensed under MIT and Apache 2.0.

metadata.name: BedrockReplay
metadata.description: A Minecraft: Bedrock Edition proxy replay system

summary.zh: BedrockReplay 是一个 Minecraft: Bedrock Edition 代理重放系统，支持玩家录制和回放游戏过程。用户可通过聊天命令控制录制、停止和播放重放，支持自定义播放速度和相机模式，并可分享重放文件给其他玩家。系统使用 Java 17 开发，以代理架构拦截游戏数据实现录制功能。
summary.en: BedrockReplay is a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition proxy replay system that enables players to record and replay gameplay sessions. Users control recording, stopping, and playback through chat commands, with support for customizable playback speed and camera modes. Built with Java 17, it uses a proxy architecture to intercept game data for recording functionality.

metadata.name: FiraCode
metadata.description: Free monospaced font with programming ligatures

summary.zh: Fira Code 是一款免费的开源等宽编程字体，核心特性是支持编程连字（ligatures），将 `->`、`<<=`、`:=` 等多字符符号渲染为单一逻辑符号，减少代码阅读时的认知负担。它兼容主流编辑器，附带多样字形变体、Unicode数学符号和进度条显示等扩展功能。
summary.en: Fira Code is a free monospaced programming font featuring ligatures that merge multi-character operators like `->` and `<=` into single logical symbols, reducing cognitive load while maintaining ASCII compatibility. It supports major code editors, offers stylistic variants, extensive Unicode coverage for math, and special glyphs for progress bars.

metadata.name: ChuanhuWallpaper
metadata.description: A GUI for Wallpapper, generates dynamic wallpapers for macOS

summary.zh: 为 Wallpapper 命令行工具打造的 macOS 图形界面应用，支持生成 .heic 格式动态壁纸。壁纸可按系统亮暗模式、太阳日照或时间自动切换背景。该应用使用 Swift 5.2 开发，支持中英文界面，适用于 macOS 11.0 及以上系统。
summary.en: A macOS GUI wrapper for Wallpapper that generates dynamic wallpapers in .heic format. Wallpapers can automatically switch based on system appearance (light/dark mode), sun position, or time. Built with Swift 5.2, supporting both English and Chinese interfaces for macOS 11.0+.

metadata.name: console-minecraft-launcher
metadata.description: 一个在命令行上运行的 Minecraft Java 版启动器 A Minecraft Java Edition Launcher Running on the Command Line

summary.zh: 这是一个纯命令行运行的Minecraft Java版启动器，支持正版/外置/统一通行证多方式登录，集成模组与整合包搜索安装功能，提供游戏版本管理、自定义皮肤披风配置，采用JSON文件管理设置，支持Windows/macOS/Linux多平台，另有Kotlin重构版本。
summary.en: A command-line Minecraft Java Edition launcher with multi-auth support (official/Official-yaml/Universal), mod/modpack search & installation, version management, custom skin/cape options, JSON-based config, cross-platform packages (Windows/macOS/Linux), with a Kotlin alternative available.

metadata.name: VisualNovelUpscaler
metadata.description: 一键将视觉小说/Galgame以高分辨率重制，现已支持Kirikiri2/Z及Artemis引擎

summary.zh: Visual Novel Upscaler是一款专用于视觉小说/Galgame的高分辨率重制工具，支持Kirikiri2/Z及Artemis引擎。该程序集成waifu2x、Real-CUGAN、Real-ESRGAN等多种AI超分辨率算法，可一键完成游戏拆包、图像放大、图像重建的完整流程，大幅提升游戏画质，适用于游戏汉化与高清化重制。
summary.en: Visual Novel Upscaler is a one-click tool for upscaling visual novels and Galgames to high resolution, supporting Kirikiri2/Z and Artemis engines. It integrates multiple AI super-resolution algorithms including waifu2x, Real-CUGAN, and Real-ESRGAN, providing a complete pipeline from game unpacking to image upscaling for game remastering and localization.

metadata.name: BetterRenderDragon
metadata.description: 更好的渲染龙

summary.zh: BetterRenderDragon 是一款针对 Minecraft: Bedrock Edition 的 RenderDragon 渲染引擎增强模组。支持延迟渲染、禁用光线追踪以优化性能，并可从资源包加载自定义着色器。提供 ImGui 配置界面，通过 F6 快捷键快速访问。最低需要 Direct3D 11，完整延迟渲染功能需 Direct3D 12。
summary.en: BetterRenderDragon is an enhancement mod for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition's RenderDragon engine. It enables deferred rendering, allows disabling raytracing for performance optimization, and loads custom shaders from resource packs. Features an ImGui configuration interface accessible via F6 key. Requires Direct3D 11 minimum, with full deferred rendering needing Direct3D 12.

metadata.name: CleanMyWechat
metadata.description: 自动删除 PC 端微信缓存数据，包括从所有聊天中自动下载的大量文件、视频、图片等数据内容，解放你的空间。

summary.zh: CleanMyWechat 是一款专为 Windows PC 微信用户打造的缓存清理工具，自动识别多账号并删除聊天中自动下载的图片、视频、文件等缓存数据。可自定义清理时间范围（默认365天），删除文件暂存回收站防止误删，每年可释放数十GB存储空间。该工具采用 Python 开发，支持所有 Windows 微信版本。
summary.en: CleanMyWechat is a Windows desktop utility that automatically cleans WeChat cache by removing auto-downloaded images, videos, and files from chat history. It supports multi-account management with customizable time ranges (default 365 days), safely moving files to recycle bin. Built with Python, this tool can free up dozens of gigabytes annually while preserving text messages.

metadata.name: hexo-filter-mathjax
metadata.description: 💯 Server side MathJax renderer plugin for Hexo.

summary.zh: Hexo 博客框架的服务端 MathJax 渲染插件，无需前端依赖即可在文章中渲染 LaTeX 数学公式。支持行内公式、块级公式、CJK 字符宽度调整等丰富配置选项，推荐配合 hexo-renderer-pandoc 使用以获得最佳渲染效果。
summary.en: A server-side MathJax renderer plugin for Hexo that enables LaTeX math rendering without front-end dependencies. Supports inline/block formulas, CJK width adjustment, and integrates seamlessly with Hexo. Recommended to use with hexo-renderer-pandoc for optimal results.

metadata.name: so-vits-svc-fork
metadata.description: so-vits-svc fork with realtime support, improved interface and more features.

summary.zh: 基于SoftVC VITS架构的歌声声音转换工具，支持实时变声处理。相比原版so-vits-svc，此fork改进了交互界面，增加了更多功能特性。支持4.0和4.1版本模型，采用PySimpleGUI提供图形化操作体验。适用于音乐制作、语音合成、变声应用等场景。
summary.en: A SoftVC VITS-based singing voice conversion tool with real-time processing support. This fork enhances the original so-vits-svc with improved UI, real-time capabilities, and additional features. Compatible with v4.0 and v4.1 models. Ideal for music production, voice synthesis, and voice metamorphosis applications.

metadata.name: LAVFilters
metadata.description: LAV Filters - Open-Source DirectShow Media Splitter and Decoders

summary.zh: LAV Filters是基于FFmpeg libavformat/libavcodec库构建的开源DirectShow媒体分离器和解码器，支持MKV、AVI、MP4、TS、BluRay等几乎所有常见音视频格式。提供智能自动流选择功能，可根据语言偏好和画质自动选择最佳视频、音频和字幕轨道，是Windows平台多媒体播放的核心组件。
summary.en: LAV Filters is an open-source DirectShow media splitter and decoder built on FFmpeg's libavformat and libavcodec libraries. It supports virtually all common media formats including MKV, AVI, MP4, TS, and BluRay. The filters feature intelligent automatic stream selection based on language preferences and quality metrics for video, audio, and subtitle tracks, serving as an essential component for Windows multimedia playback.

metadata.name: vnote
metadata.description: A pleasant note-taking platform in native C++.

summary.zh: VNote是一款基于Qt框架的原生C++笔记应用，专注于Markdown编辑与笔记管理。它提供优秀的编辑体验，支持Linux、Windows、macOS跨平台运行。作为开源项目，VNote致力于为用户提供愉悦的笔记记录平台，代码基于GNU LGPLv3许可。
summary.en: VNote is a Qt-based, native C++ note-taking application focused on Markdown editing and note management. It offers an excellent editing experience with cross-platform support for Linux, Windows, and macOS. As an open-source project, VNote aims to provide a pleasant note-taking platform, licensed under GNU LGPLv3.

metadata.name: MaterialBinTool
metadata.description: MCBE RenderDragon着色器解包/打包/编译工具

summary.zh: MaterialBinTool 是一款针对 MCBE RenderDragon 着色器的专业工具，支持 .material.bin 文件的解包、打包及 sc 着色器编译。具备多平台支持（ESSL/Direct3D/Metal/Vulkan）、Variant Flag 自动解析、自定义宏定义规则及多线程编译等功能，通过 Java 实现跨平台运行，适用于游戏资源逆向与着色器定制开发。
summary.en: MaterialBinTool is a professional tool for unpacking, repacking, and compiling RenderDragon .material.bin shader files in Minecraft Bedrock Edition. It supports cross-platform compilation across ESSL, Direct3D, Metal, and Vulkan with automatic Variant Flag parsing, customizable macro definitions, and multi-threaded compilation. Built with Java for cross-platform compatibility.

metadata.name: Structura
metadata.description: This is a project to make a sort of analog to litematica for bedrock

summary.zh: Minecraft Bedrock 建筑辅助工具，将 .mcstructure 结构文件转换为 .mcpack 资源包。通过修改盔甲架模型渲染所有方块，配合幽灵方块引导玩家精准放置真实方块，类似 Litematica 的建筑辅助功能。使用 Python 构建，支持命令行批量转换。
summary.en: A Minecraft Bedrock building assistant inspired by Litematica that converts .mcstructure files into .mcpack resource packs. It renders structures using modified armor stand models with all blocks as bones, using ghost blocks to guide block placement. Built with Python, supports CLI operations.

metadata.name: CS_CCME_Posts
metadata.description: 公众号推送备份

summary.zh: 微信公众号推送内容备份仓库，用于存档和管理公众号发布的图文资源。仓库结构简洁，通过资源索引文件集中管理备份内容，适合个人或组织进行内容归档和知识沉淀。
summary.en: A repository for backing up WeChat Official Account posts, archiving published articles and multimedia content. Features a simple structure with a centralized resource index for managing backed-up materials.

metadata.name: RLE-wiki
metadata.description: RLE.wiki is a free, open, and continuously updated transgender real-life-experience site.

summary.zh: RLE.wiki 是由 Project Trans 团队发起的跨性别者与性别多元群体真实生活体验指南平台，采用 CC BY-SA 4.0 协议开放共享。使用 VitePress 构建并部署于 Cloudflare Pages，为 MtF、FtM、酷儿等群体提供 RLE 指导与探讨空间，致力于构建包容性知识社区。
summary.en: RLE.wiki is a free, open, and continuously updated transgender real-life-experience guide platform initiated by Project Trans team. Built with VitePress and deployed on Cloudflare Pages, it provides RLE guidance for MtF, FtM, queer and gender-diverse communities under CC BY-SA 4.0 license, committed to building an inclusive knowledge community.

metadata.name: rust-by-example-cn
metadata.description: Rust By Example 中文版(包含在线代码编辑器)

summary.zh: Rust By Example 官方中文翻译版，通过丰富的代码示例帮助开发者学习 Rust 编程语言。支持在线阅读（中英双语切换、在线代码编辑器）和本地 mdBook 构建。100% 汉化率，遵循 Rust 文档翻译指引规范，适合系统学习 Rust 语法、特性和最佳实践。
summary.en: Official Chinese translation of Rust By Example, a comprehensive tutorial teaching Rust programming through practical code examples. Features online reading with bilingual support, integrated code editor, and local mdBook build. 100% localized, following Rust documentation translation guidelines for systematic learning of Rust syntax and best practices.

metadata.name: live2d-widget
metadata.description: 把萌萌哒的看板娘抱回家 (ノ≧∇≦)ノ | Live2D widget for web platform

summary.zh: 一个轻量级的网页 Live2D 看板娘组件，使用 TypeScript 开发，无额外运行时依赖。通过 CDN 一行代码即可集成到网页中，支持拖拽交互、提示对话框和模型切换。兼容 Cubism 2/3+ 版本，可与 Hexo 等博客平台无缝结合，为网站增添互动性和趣味性。
summary.en: A lightweight web widget for adding interactive Live2D characters to websites. Built with TypeScript with no runtime dependencies beyond Live2D Cubism Core. Integrates via a single CDN script tag, supporting drag interaction, tooltip dialogs, and model switching. Compatible with Cubism 2 and Cubism 3+ models, ideal for blog platforms like Hexo to enhance user engagement.

metadata.name: pacvis
metadata.description: Visualize pacman local database using Vis.js, inspired by pacgraph.

summary.zh: pacvis 是 Arch Linux pacman 本地数据库的可视化工具，基于 Vis.js 将包依赖关系以交互式图形展示，灵感来自 pacgraph。支持查看依赖链、optdepends、可移除空间估算及包名搜索，通过 Web 界面在 localhost:8888 展示本地软件包结构。
summary.en: pacvis visualizes Arch Linux pacman local database using Vis.js, inspired by pacgraph. It renders package dependency graphs interactively, supports optdepends visualization, removable size estimation, and package name search via a web interface on localhost:8888.

metadata.name: hexo-theme-fluid
metadata.description: :ocean: 一款 Material Design 风格的 Hexo 主题 / An elegant Material-Design theme for Hexo

summary.zh: 一款 Material Design 风格的 Hexo 博客主题，专注于优雅与实用。内置评论系统、访问统计、本地搜索、代码高亮、LaTeX 公式、Mermaid 流程图等丰富功能，支持暗色模式与多语言。文档详实，适合技术博客搭建。
summary.en: An elegant Material-Design theme for Hexo blogs, featuring lazy loading, multiple code highlighting schemes, comment plugins, web analytics, local search, dark mode, LaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams. Well-documented for easy setup.

metadata.name: HMCL
metadata.description: A Minecraft Launcher which is multi-functional, cross-platform and popular

summary.zh: HMCL是一款功能丰富的开源Minecraft启动器，支持Windows、Linux、macOS等多平台及x86、ARM、RISC-V等多种CPU架构。提供Mod管理、ModLoader安装（Forge/Fabric等）、整合包创建、UI定制等功能，是玩家管理Minecraft的热门工具。
summary.en: HMCL is an open-source, cross-platform Minecraft launcher supporting Windows, Linux, macOS and various CPU architectures. It offers Mod management, ModLoader installation (Forge/Fabric/Quilt), modpack creation, and UI customization. A popular tool among Minecraft players with 120+ contributors since 2015.

metadata.name: learn-regex
metadata.description: Learn regex the easy way

summary.zh: 正则表达式系统性学习教程，涵盖基础匹配、元字符、字符集、重复、分组、断言等核心概念。教程支持15种语言，提供交互式在线测试与可视化图解，适用于文本处理、表单验证、数据提取等场景，是编程开发者必备的字符模式匹配工具指南。
summary.en: A comprehensive regex tutorial covering basic matchers, meta-characters, character sets, repetitions, grouping, lookarounds, and greedy vs lazy matching. Available in 15 languages with interactive testing and visual diagrams, serving as an essential guide for text processing, form validation, and data extraction in software development.

metadata.name: Aria2-Trackers
metadata.description: 自动获取tracker文件并转换为Aria2可用格式

summary.zh: Aria2-Trackers 是一款高效的BT/磁力下载加速工具，自动抓取ngosang等数据源的tracker列表并转换为Aria2可用格式。通过jsdelivr CDN加速解决国内访问问题，有效解决BT下载无速度、速度慢的痛点，可显著提升下载体验。配套docker-aria2项目支持自动更新trackers。
summary.en: Aria2-Trackers automatically fetches tracker lists from sources like ngosang and converts them to Aria2-compatible format. It solves the common problem of slow or stalled BT/magnet downloads by providing optimized trackers. With jsdelivr CDN acceleration for China access, this tool significantly improves download speeds. Also offers a companion docker-aria2 solution with auto-updating trackers.

metadata.name: WDControl
metadata.description: Windows Defender 状态设置工具

summary.zh: Windows Defender 状态管理工具，专为解决 Windows 1909+ 版本默认启用"篡改保护"导致注册表/组策略失效的场景而开发。支持禁用、启用及完全移除 WD，采用绕过篡改保护机制，不破坏系统文件、无副作用且可恢复。适用于系统封装、运维自动化及需要临时关闭 WD 安装其他杀软的场景。
summary.en: A Windows Defender management utility designed to bypass tamper protection in Windows 1909+, which renders traditional registry/group policy methods ineffective. Supports disable, enable, and complete removal of WD through a non-destructive mechanism with no side effects. Ideal for system imaging, IT automation, and deploying third-party antivirus solutions.

metadata.name: explorerTool
metadata.description: Custom Windows Explorer background image

summary.zh: Windows文件资源管理器背景自定义工具，通过Shell扩展技术为Explorer设置自定义背景图片。支持多图随机切换、透明度调节、9种显示位置（角落/居中/拉伸/缩放填充）。可针对特定路径或CLSID特殊文件夹（如此电脑、快捷访问）设置独立背景，并兼容文件对话框。需以管理员权限注册DLL组件，修改配置后刷新即可生效。
summary.en: A Windows shell extension that customizes File Explorer background with images. Supports random multi-image switching, adjustable alpha (0-255), and 9 display positions (corners, center, stretch, zoom-fill). Enables path-specific backgrounds via INI config, works with file dialogs, and registers as a COM DLL. No restart needed—refresh window after config changes.

metadata.name: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI
metadata.description: Video, Image and GIF upscale/enlarge(Super-Resolution) and Video frame interpolation. Achieved with Waifu2x,  Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, RTX Video Super Resolution VSR, SRMD, RealSR, Anime4K, RIFE, IFRNet, CAIN, DAIN,  and ACNet.

summary.zh: 这是一个Windows平台的AI图像/视频超分辨率工具，支持图片、GIF和视频的智能放大及帧插值。集成Waifu2x、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN等12+种算法引擎，支持AMD/NVIDIA/Intel全系列GPU。提供一键预设、多GPU加速和智能参数自动调整功能，零门槛实现动漫插画和真实照片的高质量4K/8K放大。
summary.en: A Windows GUI application for AI-powered image/video super-resolution and frame interpolation. Supports images, GIFs, and videos with 12+ built-in algorithms including Waifu2x, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, RTX VSR, and more. Fully compatible with AMD, NVIDIA, and Intel GPUs. Offers one-click presets, multi-GPU acceleration, and intelligent auto-configuration for effortless 4K/8K upscaling.

metadata.name: favorite
metadata.description: 东方本命角色测试

summary.zh: 一个面向东方Project粉丝的在线本命角色测试网页应用。通过趣味问答形式，帮助用户发现自己的「本命角色」。采用静态网页架构，支持多站部署，适合粉丝社区互动与角色推荐场景。
summary.en: An online quiz web application for Touhou Project fans to discover their favorite character through fun Q&A. Built with static web architecture, supports multi-site deployment, ideal for fan community engagement and character recommendation.

metadata.name: YesPlayMusic
metadata.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器，支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:

summary.zh: 高颜值的第三方网易云音乐播放器，基于 Electron + Vue.js 构建，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 三大平台。除基础播放功能外，还提供 MV 播放、歌词显示、私人 FM、音乐云盘等丰富特性，并支持 UnblockNeteaseMusic 解锁灰色歌曲，界面美观且功能完整。
summary.en: A beautiful third-party Netease Cloud Music player built with Electron and Vue.js, available on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers comprehensive features including MV playback, lyrics display, private FM, music cloud storage, and UnblockNeteaseMusic support for gray songs. The interface design is elegant and the feature set is complete.

metadata.name: CMWTAT_Digital_Edition
metadata.description: CloudMoe Windows 10/11 Activation Toolkit get digital license, the best open source Win 10/11 activator in GitHub. GitHub 上最棒的开源 Win10/Win11 数字权利（数字许可证）激活工具！

summary.zh: 一款使用C#编写的Windows 10/11数字许可证激活工具，提供图形界面操作，可通过数字权利方式激活系统。作为开源解决方案（GPL-2.0），是GitHub上较为知名的Windows激活工具，支持快速激活和管理Windows授权状态。
summary.en: A digital license activation toolkit for Windows 10/11 written in C#. It features a GUI for activating Windows systems using digital entitlement, being one of the popular open-source activation solutions on GitHub with GPL-2.0 license.

metadata.name: Magpie
metadata.description: A general-purpose window upscaler for Windows 10/11.

summary.zh: Magpie是一款轻量级Windows窗口放大工具，支持全屏和窗口模式缩放。内置Anime4K、FSR、CRT着色器等多种算法，基于DirectX 11渲染，界面采用WinUI设计，支持明暗主题和多显示器。主要用于解决老游戏或低DPI应用的画面放大问题，提升视觉体验。
summary.en: Magpie is a lightweight window upscaling tool for Windows 10/11. It supports fullscreen and windowed modes with built-in algorithms like Anime4K, FSR, and CRT shaders. Powered by DirectX 11 and WinUI, it offers light/dark themes and multi-monitor support, ideal for enhancing legacy games and low-DPI applications.

summary.zh: 基于Qt框架开发的轻量级课程表桌面工具，替代传统黑板手写课表。核心功能包括实时显示当前课程与时间、支持CSV批量导入课程、精确到秒的倒计时提示，以及可自定义的UI样式（字体、颜色、背景图片）。支持多窗口显示、托盘常驻运行和Windows 11亚克力特效，提供Qt5/Qt6双版本兼容。
summary.en: A lightweight desktop timetable application built with Qt framework, designed to replace traditional chalkboard schedules. Key features include real-time course display, CSV import, second-precision countdown timers, and fully customizable UI styling. Supports multi-window display, system tray mode, and Windows 11 acrylic effects, with Qt5/Qt6 cross-version compatibility.

metadata.name: Luma3DS
metadata.description: Nintendo 3DS "Custom Firmware"

summary.zh: Luma3DS 是一款 Nintendo 3DS 自定义固件，通过修补和重写系统核心代码实现大幅功能增强。提供 Rosalina 覆盖菜单（截图、滤镜、作弊码）、游戏 mod 支持（LayeredFS、3GX 插件、语言覆盖）及完整 GDB 调试桩，显著延长 3DS 生命周期。
summary.en: Luma3DS is a custom firmware for Nintendo 3DS that patches and reimplements core system software. It provides Rosalina overlay menu (screenshots, filters, cheats), game modding support (LayeredFS, 3GX plugins, locale emulation), and a full GDB stub for debugging, greatly extending the console's lifespan.

metadata.name: lshort-zh-cn
metadata.description: A Chi­nese edi­tion of the Not So Short Introduction to LaTeX2ε

summary.zh: lshort-zh-cn 是经典《Not So Short Introduction to LaTeX2ε》的中文翻译版，由 CTeX 组织维护。系统讲解 LaTeX 基础语法、文档排版、宏包使用等核心知识，提供完整源码和多种编译方式，是中文用户学习 LaTeX 的权威入门教程。
summary.en: lshort-zh-cn is the Chinese translation of the classic "Not So Short Introduction to LaTeX2ε", maintained by the CTeX organization. It comprehensively covers LaTeX syntax, document typesetting, and package usage, serving as an authoritative tutorial for Chinese-speaking users learning LaTeX.

metadata.name: LeviLamina
metadata.description: A lightweight, modular and versatile mod loader for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, formerly known as LiteLoaderBDS

summary.zh: LeviLamina是一款轻量级、模块化的Minecraft Bedrock Edition mod加载器，原名LiteLoaderBDS。它提供全面的API支持、强大事件系统与丰富工具接口，让开发者可使用C++轻松编写mod，无缝扩展游戏功能与玩法体验。
summary.en: LeviLamina is a lightweight, modular mod loader for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, formerly LiteLoaderBDS. It provides comprehensive API support, powerful event system, and extensive utility interfaces, enabling developers to write mods in C++ and seamlessly extend game functionality.

metadata.name: OnStep
metadata.description: Arduino telescope goto for equatorial and alt/az mounts

summary.zh: OnStep是一款开源天文望远镜goto控制器，基于Arduino/Teensy平台，通过步进电机实现赤道仪和地平式支架的自动寻星功能。支持USB、蓝牙、WiFi等多种连接方式，兼容ASCOM/LX200协议，可与Sky Safari、Stellarium等主流天文软件配合使用，提供Android应用和内置网页控制界面。
summary.en: OnStep is an open-source telescope goto controller based on Arduino/Teensy, using stepper motors for automatic star-finding on equatorial and alt-az mounts. It supports USB, Bluetooth, WiFi connections and is compatible with ASCOM/LX200 protocols, working with Sky Safari, Stellarium and other astronomy software, featuring Android app and web interface.

metadata.name: WorldEdit-BE
metadata.description: WorldEdit-BE-LL

summary.zh: WorldEdit-BE 是一款面向 Minecraft 基岩版的方块编辑器插件，提供区域选择、批量方块替换、地形生成等核心功能。该工具适用于服务器地图快速构建与地形修改，可显著提升建筑与地图编辑效率。
summary.en: WorldEdit-BE is a block editor plugin for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, offering region selection, batch block replacement, and terrain generation features. Ideal for server map construction and terrain modification.

metadata.name: BedrockConnect
metadata.description: Join any Minecraft Bedrock Edition server IP on Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PS4/PS5

summary.zh: BedrockConnect 是一款 Minecraft Bedrock Edition 服务器软件，为主机玩家提供第三方服务器列表功能。通过 DNS 重定向技术，让 Xbox One、Switch、PS4/PS5 玩家可便捷连接任意第三方服务器，解决主机平台不支持第三方服务器的痛点，全程免费开源。
summary.en: BedrockConnect is a Minecraft Bedrock Edition server software providing a server-list interface for console players. It enables Xbox One, Switch, and PS4/PS5 users to connect to any third-party Bedrock servers via DNS redirection, solving the native server-list limitation on console platforms. Free and open-source since 2019.

summary.zh: 一款针对 Minecraft 基岩版的高性能史莱姆区块查找工具。使用 Rust 开发，在 i9-14900K 处理器上搜索速度超过 35 亿区块/秒，5 分钟内可遍历边境之地全部区块。支持自定义刷怪范围形状，适用于服务器管理或刷怪农场设计。
summary.en: A high-performance slime chunk finder for Minecraft Bedrock Edition built with Rust. Achieves over 3.5 billion chunks/second on i9-14900K, scanning the entire world border within 5 minutes. Supports custom spawn range shapes for server management or farm design.

metadata.name: Ventoy
metadata.description: A new bootable USB solution.

summary.zh: Ventoy是一款开源可启动USB制作工具，支持ISO/WIM/IMG/VHD(x)/EFI等多种镜像格式。无需反复格式化磁盘，一盘多启，可同时存放多个镜像文件并通过启动菜单自由选择。支持x86 Legacy BIOS、IA32/x64/ARM64/MIPS64EL UEFI等多种启动模式，兼容MBR和GPT分区格式。已通过1300+ ISO文件测试，覆盖distrowatch.com上90%以上的主流Linux发行版。
summary.en: Ventoy is an open-source bootable USB creation tool supporting ISO/WIM/IMG/VHD(x)/EFI formats. It enables multi-boot functionality without reformatting, storing multiple images on one USB with a boot menu. Supports Legacy BIOS and UEFI variants (IA32/x64/ARM64/MIPS64EL), compatible with MBR/GPT partitions. Tested with 1300+ ISO files and 90%+ distrowatch.com distributions.

metadata.name: WebGAL
metadata.description: A brand new web Visual Novel engine | 全新的网页端视觉小说引擎

summary.zh: WebGAL 是一款全新的网页端视觉小说引擎，支持可视化编辑与脚本两种开发方式。引擎内置美观界面与丰富交互效果，集成 Pixi.js 渲染能力，可实现自定义特效。采用 MPL-2.0 开源协议，允许商业使用，适合独立开发者与团队快速构建网页视觉小说游戏。
summary.en: WebGAL is a cutting-edge web-based visual novel engine featuring both visual editor and scripting approaches for game development. The engine delivers elegant UI with rich interactive effects and integrates Pixi.js for custom rendering capabilities. Built on MPL-2.0 open source license with commercial usage permitted, it enables rapid creation of web-based visual novel games for indie developers and teams alike.

metadata.name: mobile-export
metadata.description: Enables Minecraft world exporting on mobile.

summary.zh: 这是一个Minecraft辅助工具，实现了移动端导出游戏世界的功能。用户可以在手机或平板设备上提取并保存游戏存档，便于备份或分享游戏世界数据。
summary.en: This is a Minecraft utility tool that enables world exporting functionality on mobile devices. It allows players to extract and save their game worlds from phones or tablets for backup or sharing purposes.

metadata.name: kirikiroid2
metadata.description: kirikiroid2资源整理

summary.zh: kirikiroid2是Kirikiri2视觉小说引擎的Android移植版本及资源整理项目。该项目使开发者能够在Android设备上运行基于Kirikiri引擎制作的视觉小说游戏，支持KAG脚本解析和多媒体播放功能，为移动端视觉小说开发提供技术基础。
summary.en: kirikiroid2 is an Android port and resource collection project for the Kirikiri2 visual novel engine. It enables developers to run Kirikiri-based visual novel games on Android devices, supporting KAG script parsing and multimedia playback, providing a technical foundation for mobile visual novel development.

metadata.name: clash-rs
metadata.description: custom protocol network proxy

summary.zh: Rust编写的多协议网络代理工具，支持基于源/目标IP、域名、GeoIP的灵活规则路由。内置本地DNS反欺骗，支持Trojan/Vmess/VLESS/Shadowsocks等主流出站协议及TLS/WebSocket/gRPC等传输层。提供TUN/TProxy透明代理模式，覆盖Linux/macOS/Windows/iOS全平台。
summary.en: A Rust-based multi-protocol network proxy with flexible rule-based routing (IP/Domain/GeoIP). Features local anti-spoofing DNS and supports major outbound protocols (Trojan/Vmess/VLESS/Shadowsocks) with various transports (TLS/WebSocket/gRPC). Offers transparent proxy via TUN/TProxy across Linux/macOS/Windows/iOS.
